author: superalesha
title: Hedgehog in the Fog Animated Short
prompt:
make an animated short that felt like Hedgehog in the Fog. I didn’t want to copy Yuri Norstein’s film, so we went with a new story.

It runs for 6.5 minutes. All 9363 frames are drawn by JavaScript code written by Opus. No video or image generation models, just canvas.

It follows a little mouse in a red scarf. Her grandfather, an old mole, is out fishing when fog rolls over the lake. She goes looking for him with a walnut-shell lantern and a sleeping firefly inside. They have a secret knock to help them find each other: short, short, long. It means "I’m here".

Norstein used paper cutouts on layers of glass, filmed frame by frame. I wanted some of that paper texture to come through in code. So the scenes use different styles: torn-paper collage, chalk on black paper, tissue paper underwater. There’s even sand on a light table and a pop-up book.

Opus wrote the music too. It found Steinway piano samples in my Logic library and used Python to compose the score around the rhythm of that knock.

title: Seedance 2.5 Kinetic Fight Scene
prompt:
References:
@[char1 ref]: Mina. Long black hair, green striped crop top, baggy orange cargo pants with black graffiti, white sneakers, black fingerless boxing gloves on both hands, chain bracelet.
@[char2 ref]: Rue. Long pink hair, black crop top, black cargo shorts with chains and tags, bare knuckles with silver rings, skin visible on both hands, chunky lime sneakers, dog tag necklace.

Visual style: High-sakuga flat-color 2D anime, bold linework, hard cel shading, flat blue and teal backgrounds that flash hot pink or orange on impact, speed smears, impact frames, deep foreshortening.

Energy: Within every shot the camera keeps moving: it spirals around crossing limbs, dives under kicks, skims the floor, and whips between faces, often following a fist or a sole within inches of the lens. Every movement flows straight into the next strike, block, or counter. Every landed hit plays as sakuga impact: a two-frame impact frame, then the struck body whips away in a long smear, elastic recoil, immediate re-entry into her own attack. Heads snap, torsos fold, feet leave the ground, bodies skid across concrete. Each impact throws a color flash, dust, flying hair and cloth, and radiating speed lines.

Avoid: No subtitles. No slow motion, no idle posing, no pauses between actions, no freeze frames, no held two-shots.

Mina and Rue trade one relentless brawl on an empty concrete rooftop with a chain-link fence at the back and a steel vent box at center right. Mina starts screen left, Rue screen right. Whenever they close, one body is nearer the camera and the other clearly behind it with air between. No dialogue; hits, shoe scuffs, chain rattle, wind. Shot list: 4 shots, about 30 seconds, every shot packed edge to edge with exchanges.

Scene 1: 连续时间，天台。
Shot 1: 大全景起，地面高度，低角度；镜头从水泥地面猛然升起，穿过两名已经腾空扑向对方的格斗者之间，然后贴着Mina的拳套甩进中景，并绕着两人交错的手臂急速环绕。Mina的右勾拳与Rue抬起的膝盖在半空撞上，冲击帧，两人同时被震成拖影向后飞开，滑步落地的瞬间已经再次扑上；Mina左直拳，Rue下潜躲过并打出上勾拳，Mina用前臂接住，前臂被顶上自己的下巴，头向后一甩成拖影，她借着仰头的势头打出一记一二连击，第二拳砸开Rue的防守，冲击帧，Rue的头横向甩出，粉发拉成一道弧，她踉跄一步就从踉跄里踢出正蹬，踢中Mina的拳套，把Mina推得双脚在地上滑出一道痕。快速细节切：Rue眯起的眼睛，Mina收紧的拳套，狗牌甩动，然后镜头钻到Rue旋踢的下方。Rue的脚跟掠过Mina低下的头顶，Mina从内侧起身的身体勾拳把Rue整个人折弯在拳套上，冲击帧，Rue的双脚离地，她顺着折弯的势头甩出肘击，Mina双拳套挡住，拳套却被顶进自己的脸，她向后踉跄两步，Rue追上来一记戴戒指的直拳擦着镜头砸过，Mina侧滑，把一记短右拳埋进Rue的肋部，冲击帧，Rue半边身体塌陷成拖影，双脚在地面打滑，她就从打滑里顶出一膝，砸在拳套上，把Mina的胳膊震到自己胸口。

Shot 2: 跟拍起，位于Rue身后腰部高度；镜头随她冲向铁丝网，沿着网向上扫，在她蹬离时翻转，然后落到地面高度，贴着天台地面疾驰穿过两人相撞的缝隙。Rue推开Mina的胸口转身冲向铁丝网，在网上蹬两步，蹬离，后空翻越过从下方冲进来的Mina，落下的膝盖砸中Mina的肩膀，冲击帧，Mina被砸成一个拖影般的前滚翻，从翻滚里起身时顺势扫向Rue落地的那条腿，Rue跳过扫踢，撑手后空翻，落地时Mina的直拳已经到了，Rue格挡，格挡把她自己的手臂震开，Mina的第二拳穿过空档擦中她的太阳穴，冲击帧，Rue半转过身，粉发横扫镜头。快速细节切：荧光绿鞋底填满镜头，橙色工装布料猛甩，铁丝网剧烈震颤，然后镜头贴地。两人再次相撞：Mina低身滑过Rue的飞跃拳，两人在另一侧旋转成背对背，同一瞬间各踢出一记后蹬，鞋底对撞，冲击帧，两人都被踢得向前扑倒撑地，撑起后同时转身甩出旋转背拳，拳套撞上指节，粉色闪光，两人的头各自甩向一侧成拖影，Rue先回过身勾住Mina的腿，Mina跳脱的同时抡出过顶拳，擦过Rue的太阳穴，把她打得转了半圈，Rue转完这半圈的势头直接变成一记反手肘，砸在Mina的肩上，Mina的肩膀被压得一沉。

Shot 3: 高角度俯冲起；镜头向通风箱俯冲，压低绕到箱侧，然后在两张脸之间左右急甩，每一拳都跟着拳头从一张脸甩到另一张脸。Mina，戴黑拳套，跃上通风箱，膝盖朝下砸落；Rue，赤手戴戒指，侧步闪开，一记侧踢踹进箱体，箱体轰然凹陷；Mina从压扁的边缘跃起打出飞身直拳，Rue后仰躲过，扫掉Mina的支撑手臂，Mina侧手翻落地的同时勾拳打中Rue的下颌，冲击帧，Rue的头甩过去，整个人被带得转了半圈，脚步踉跄，又从踉跄里反扑一记直拳，震得Mina的下巴一晃。快速细节切：弯折的金属，断裂的电缆冒着火花，拳套在箱顶打滑，然后镜头切进两张脸之间。隔着废墟的近身对轰：刺拳，格挡，直拳，侧闪，没有一拳停在半路；Rue的膝盖顶进Mina垂下的拳套，把她推退一步；Mina的头槌砸在Rue的眉骨上，冲击帧，Rue的头向后甩成拖影，她的身体先于意识反击，戴戒指的勾拳打在Mina的拳套上；Mina的反击肘撞上Rue的脸颊，冲击帧，粉发炸开，Rue踉跄两步，膝盖一软又撑住，从撑住的那一下里直拳回敬，打得Mina的头偏过去，Mina的头偏到一半就已经转回来，两人同时下蹲。

Shot 4: 高角度大全景起，倾斜成荷兰角；镜头在两人跃起时螺旋下降，在最高点从两人之间穿过，再翻到两人侧面，并在两人上升时继续旋转。两人同时向上爆发，拳头在前，Mina的黑拳套与Rue戴戒指的拳头冲向画面中央同一点，头发向后飞扬成拖影，速度线向中心汇聚，拳头进入触及范围的瞬间背景炸成全屏亮粉色；拳头仍在逼近，头发仍在甩动，镜头仍在旋转，画面在此切断。

author: EvoLinkAi
title: Consistent-Character New York Day Selfie Vlog
prompt:
SCENE: A day in New York shot entirely by the subject herself: waking in her hotel suite, coffee, getting ready, out into the city, back to the room at night.

ACTIVE REFERENCES: @image1 — the hotel suite. Curved cove ceiling with warm LED coving, deep red carpet, cream walls, two black organic sculptures above a light wood headboard, white bedding with red pillows, twin bedside lamps, pale sofa, oval coffee table, sheer curtains, dark door. @image2 — the subject. Young woman, shoulder-length wavy blonde hair with curtain bangs and highlights, light freckles, thin gold necklace, silver ring, dark brown off-the-shoulder knit with white diamond-stripe pattern. 100% matches the reference.

CAMERA OWNERSHIP LOCK: Only two positions exist. HELD: arm extended, camera 0.4–0.7m from her face, visible arm tension, tilt and step-bounce. PROPPED: camera on a surface she placed it on, crooked and fixed, with her moving in and out of frame. No operator shots, no tracking, nothing she could not have filmed alone.

FORMAT: Eight shots, 30s, seven hard cuts, no fades. Real-time.

0–4s SHOT 1 — PROPPED, morning room. Camera on the sideboard 3m from the bed at 1.1m, static and tilted. The suite matches @image1: cove light on, curtains half open, cool daylight across the red carpet. @image2 is visible at 0.0s, sitting up on the bed edge. She rubs her face and says to the running camera: “It’s seven. In New York. Why am I awake.” She stands and walks out screen-right. HARD CUT.

4–7s SHOT 2 — HELD, window light. Arm’s length, above eye line. She pulls the curtain, squints at the street below, then looks into the lens: “Okay. It’s actually happening.” Arm wobble throughout. HARD CUT.

7–11s SHOT 3 — PROPPED, coffee. Camera on the oval coffee table, low, looking up past a cup. She sits into frame, pours, tastes, and says: “Hotel coffee. We’ll fix that outside.” Steam bends in the light. HARD CUT.

11–15s SHOT 4 — HELD, mirror. Camera at chest height reflected in the suite mirror. She works through her hair with the other hand. At 13s: “This is as good as it gets. Let’s go.” HARD CUT.

15–18s SHOT 5 — HELD, leaving. Camera held low at waist height, turned forward. She crosses the red carpet to the door. She opens it and corridor light floods the frame. Off-frame: “Downtown first.” HARD CUT.

18–22s SHOT 6 — PROPPED, street. Camera on a stoop rail, static and crooked. A New York block behind her: brownstone steps, fire escapes, yellow cabs, steam from a vent. She walks in from screen-left, stands in frame, and says: “Look at this street.” Then walks to the lens and takes it. Passers-by cross the foreground. HARD CUT.

22–26s SHOT 7 — PROPPED, diner. Camera on the counter behind a plate, looking up. She sits into frame, takes a bite, eyes widen, and says: “Okay, that’s the one.” She laughs and keeps eating. HARD CUT.

26–30s SHOT 8 — HELD, night, back in the room. She lies back across the white bedding, hair spread, in the brown knit again. Bedside lamps and cove light are the only sources. Into the lens: “Twenty thousand steps. Everything hurts.” Softer: “Same time tomorrow.” She waves as she lowers the camera. 30.0s black.

SPEECH: Only the quoted lines are spoken, at the timings given, all in her voice. Lips still at all other times. No voiceover, no second speaker, no offscreen voices. Delivery is casual, unrehearsed, mid-breath, sometimes trailing off.

CONTINUITY: The suite matches @image1 in both interior sequences. Hair, necklace, ring, face, body proportions, and outfit details remain identical throughout.

PHYSICS: Loose knit slides on the shoulder with every arm movement. Wavy hair lags a frame behind head turns. Bedding creases under her weight. Step energy is visible in every HELD frame.

LIGHTING: Shots 1–4 use cool daylight from the curtains as key and warm cove LED as fill. Shot 5 uses corridor light. Shots 6–7 use hard street daylight and warm diner practicals. Shot 8 uses lamps and cove light only.

AUDIO: Diegetic only, from the same camera — room tone, footsteps, door, traffic, sirens, steam vents, diner clatter, and wind. Ambience ducks under her lines. No music.

LOCKS: Photoreal live action, 4K detail, fine grain, warm consumer-camera color, mild rolling shutter and auto-exposure hunting. She is the only person who speaks. Background figures are anonymous and unfocused. No subtitles.

title: A realistic day-in-the-life with DV camera shake
prompt:
プロンプト①　設定と人物

2000年代初期の家庭用DVカメラで撮った、超リアルなホームビデオを作成。

ソウルの古い住宅街で、若い韓国人女性が何気ない1日を過ごす。

添付画像をキャラクター参照にして、顔と見た目を一貫させる。

ピンクのクロップトップに白のショートパンツ、シンプルなサンダルと小さなブレスレット。

手には透明な水のボトル。

プロンプト②　前半の流れ

家を出てドアを閉め、ボトルを手に静かな住宅街を歩く。

途中、近所の人たちに自然な笑顔で小さく手を振ってあいさつ。

公園に着いてベンチに座り、サッカーをする子どもたちをなんとなく眺める。

そこへボールが転がってくる。

拾って笑い、そっと蹴り返して「Enjoy」と言う。

子どもたちは笑って遊びを続ける。

プロンプト③　後半の流れ

公園を出て、ボトルを持ったまま通りを歩く。

とうもろこしの屋台で1本買い、歩きながらうれしそうに最初のひと口。

食べている途中、ボトルが手から滑って歩道に落ちる。

立ち止まって小さく笑い、拾ってもうひと口かじり、家へ歩き出す。

ラストは片手にボトル、片手にとうもろこしで住宅街をゆっくり歩く。

カメラの方を見て自然に笑い、「Bye bye」と言って去っていく。

プロンプト④　画質と音

映像は2000年代初期の家庭用DVカメラの生素材。

・手持ちの揺れ
・ずれた構図
・オートフォーカスの迷い
・わずかな露出の揺れ
・柔らかいデジタル感と軽いノイズ
・自然なモーションブラー
・ときどき入る不器用なズーム

本物のホームビデオの空気感、リアルな肌、自然な表情と動き。

音は住宅街の環境音だけ。

足音、鳥の声、遠くの車、子どもたちのサッカー、近所の話し声、自転車、屋台のざわめき、ボトルの音、そよ風。

音楽・ナレーション・字幕・美肌フィルター・CG・CM風の映像・滑らかなカメラワークはすべてなし。

author: johnAGI168
title: Vertical Immersive Bedside Kiss & Shy Gaze
prompt:
Duration: 30秒
Aspect ratio: 9:16

SUBJECT / REFERENCE
@图片1＝男主，只参考面容与五官，保持身份一致。
@图片2＝女主，只参考面容与五官，保持身份一致。
两人为成年恋人。角色卡不提供服装、姿势和背景。以下正文只使用男主、女主指代。

WARDROBE
男主穿深墨蓝色柔软长袖睡衣，翻领、纽扣前襟，领口自然松开一颗纽扣。
女主穿奶油白色柔软长袖睡衣，小翻领、细窄滚边。
睡衣只在画面边缘露出少量领口和肩部，不为展示服装扩大景别。

STORY
男主以为女主睡着，俯身看她，稍微拨一下她脸旁的头发，低头轻吻。
女主醒来，发现男主近在眼前，害羞地拉起被子遮住脸。
男主停在近处，低头笑着看她。
女主躲了片刻，又觉得不对，自己把被子拉下来，重新看他。
两人短暂对视，男主再次俯身，女主回应，两人投入地吻在一起，持续到结束。

核心摄影要求
这是一场以大特写和极近特写组成的枕边戏。

开场就贴近人物，不拍房间全景，不交代走到床边的过程。
单人镜头以面部占满画幅为准：允许裁掉头顶、部分发际线、脸侧与肩膀。不要把完整头部、双肩和胸口全部装进画面。
双人镜头让女主侧脸位于左下、男主面部从右上贴入，两人的脸共同填满竖幅，房间背景几乎消失。
藏被动作也在脸部附近完成，只出现脸、被沿和抓住被沿的局部手指。

摄影机已经在近处。镜头以固定机位（Locked-off camera）为主，仅有极轻的自然呼吸感，不反复慢推，不环绕。
用硬切（Hard cut）在男主大特写、女主大特写、双人侧面极近特写之间转换。
让眼神方向、画外视线和局部入画交代两人的位置，不依赖中景解释空间。

ENVIRONMENT / LIGHTING
夜晚卧室，灰米色枕头与被褥，深色床头。
床头暖白色灯光从侧后方照来，在鼻梁、脸颊边缘与睫毛上留下柔和亮部；另一侧面部保留自然阴影。
皮肤温暖但不过度泛黄，背景暗而柔软。枕头在画面边缘形成一小块浅色，衬托近处的脸。
浅景深，眼神和接触处清楚，保留真实皮肤纹理。
画面中不出现完整台灯、床头柜或大面积卧室陈设。

AUDIO
无对白、无旁白、无内心独白、无字幕。
低音量、无歌词的柔和R&B氛围配乐，节奏轻，不做强烈卡点。
自然呼吸、被子和衣料摩擦声贴近画面，不添加夸张喘息或放大的亲吻音效。

CONTINUITY
男主一直从女主面对的一侧俯身，身体由撑在床垫上的手臂承重；支撑动作在画外成立，不专门切镜展示。
女主头部始终由枕头承托。
女主自己拉被遮脸，也自己把被子拉下来。
第一次吻轻，第二次吻投入而持续；两次之间完整保留醒来、害羞、藏脸和重新对视。
头发只做一次简单拨开，不增加整理、反复抚摸等动作。

SHOT 01｜0.0–2.0秒
女主睡颜大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
女主侧躺的脸占据画面主体，头顶和一部分脸侧出框，下边缘最多露到下巴与少量睡衣领口。背景只有贴着头部的枕面。
摄影机就在枕边，略高于她的脸，沿她躺卧的方向拍摄。

动作：
女主闭眼，面部放松，呼吸轻而均匀。
镜头末尾，男主模糊的脸侧从右上边缘靠入，只出现一小部分，不把画面撑成双人中景。

SHOT 02｜2.0–5.5秒
硬切男主大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
男主俯下的脸斜着铺满竖屏，从左上向右下形成倾斜构图。
头顶和右侧部分脸颊出框，下方贴近下颌，仅在左下角留下女主虚化的局部轮廓。
摄影机处于接近女主视线的位置，看他俯身靠近的脸。

动作：
男主垂眼看着女主，目光停留，嘴角缓缓放松。
他以为她睡着了，眼神里带着不急于离开的温柔。
保持这个大特写，让他看她的时间真实发生，不急着接吻。
摄影机不推进，变化只来自他的目光、呼吸与轻微低头。

SHOT 03｜5.5–7.5秒
硬切女主面部特写（Close-up）

画面：
回到女主枕边的近距离，女主的脸占左侧和下方。
男主只在右上方露出局部下颌，右手从画外进入，构图始终围绕女主的脸。

动作：
男主轻轻拨一下她脸旁的散发，手随即退出画面。
女主仍闭眼，没有额外反应。
男主的脸开始从右上方降低，下一镜承接这次靠近。

SHOT 04｜7.5–13.5秒
硬切双人侧面极近特写（Extreme close-up）

画面：
机位降到接近枕面高度。
女主的侧脸从左下方占住画面，男主从右上方斜着贴入。
两人的头顶和部分脸侧自然出框，只留贴近的面部轮廓。背景被两张脸遮住，剩下一点虚化的枕面。
摄影机固定，不拉远容纳完整头部。

动作：
7.5–10.0秒：
男主缓慢低头，两张脸之间的空隙一点点缩小。他轻微调整头部，鼻尖自然错开，在将要碰到时有很短的迟疑。

10.0–12.0秒：
男主轻轻吻住女主的嘴唇，保持一次柔和的吻。动作小，距离近，画面始终停在两人面部。

12.0–13.5秒：
男主略微抬头，嘴唇分开，但脸没有离远。
女主睫毛轻动，开始睁眼。

SHOT 05｜13.5–15.5秒
硬切女主醒来的大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
女主的眼睛、鼻梁和嘴唇清楚可见，枕头只剩窄窄一圈。
男主虚化的脸侧留在右上前景，挡住一小部分画面，让观众感觉他仍在她眼前。

动作：
女主睁眼，先看清男主，再短暂停住。
她的目光在他脸上停留，随后轻轻抿唇、避开一点视线，羞意从眼神和嘴角浮出来。
男主没有离开，没有大幅后退。

SHOT 06｜15.5–17.5秒
女主近距离拉被遮脸（Close-up）

画面：
仍贴着女主拍摄，只比上一镜多容纳一点被沿。
不切成能看清两人上半身的镜头。

动作：
女主抓住胸前的被沿，快速往上一拉，遮住自己的整张脸。
被子在近处掠过镜头视野，替代她的面部占住画面。
男主顺势稍微抬头，给被子留出空间。
抓着被沿的手指停在画面边缘，保留一小段藏起来后的安静。

SHOT 07｜17.5–19.5秒
硬切男主含笑的大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
回到前面男主斜着俯身的同一近机位。
他的脸再次占满画面，被沿虚化在下方前景，脸与被子之间距离很近。
不出现完整肩膀和手臂。

动作：
男主低头看着藏在被子里的女主。
眼尾先放松，嘴角随后扬起来，笑意越来越明显，但不笑出声，不做夸张挑眉。
他停在原处等她，没有伸手扯被子。

SHOT 08｜19.5–21.0秒
硬切女主拉下被子的特写（Close-up）

画面：
开头被子仍遮住女主的脸，和前一个遮脸镜头保持同样近的距离。

动作：
女主躲了一会儿，自己把被子直接拉回下巴以下，重新露出整张脸。
动作带一点“怎么就停了”的迟疑和急切，但没有台词。
她看向男主，这次目光停住，没有继续躲，也不再把被子拉回去。
不要增加先露眼睛偷看、反复升降被子的过程。

SHOT 09｜21.0–22.5秒
硬切男主回应的大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
男主的眼睛与嘴角同时清楚，面部依然斜着贴满竖屏。
女主只是左下角一小块虚化前景。

动作：
男主接住她的目光，笑意短暂停在嘴角。
他没有再长时间等待，顺着这个对视直接低下头，脸朝画面左下方靠近。
在低头动作进行中切下一镜，动作不断开。

SHOT 10｜22.5–26.5秒
双人贴脸极近特写（Extreme close-up）

画面：
恢复女主左下、男主右上的双人侧面构图，比第一次吻略紧。
两张脸填满画幅，头顶、后脑和肩膀都不要求完整入镜。
仍能看到女主闭眼的变化，以及男主靠近时的面部反应。

动作：
男主俯身吻上去，女主轻轻抬起下巴迎接，自然闭眼，明确回应。
第二次吻比第一次更投入，靠近更直接，两人不再试探。
保持连续的亲吻，头部随着彼此的动作自然小幅调整，不演成重复点一下就退开的啄吻。
摄影机停在近处，让人物的靠近与回应充满画面。

SHOT 11｜26.5–30.0秒
同侧切入更紧的双人面部特写（Tighter close-up）

画面：
在同一次亲吻中硬切，摄影机仍留在原轴线同侧，只调整少量侧面角度。
两张脸几乎没有周围留白，允许裁掉额头上部与下巴边缘。
眼睫、脸颊、鼻梁与相贴的嘴唇组成整个画面，保持两人的面部轮廓独立。
这仍然是两个人的面部亲密镜头，不拍成孤立的嘴部微距。

动作：
承接同一次持续的吻，两人保持投入和相互回应。
女主头部在枕上自然微动，男主顺着她的变化调整，动作连贯、有呼吸。
不重新起吻，不分开对视，不额外加笑或拥抱。
保持这个极近距离直到30秒结束。

NEGATIVE

title: 2003 MiniDV Korean Lazy Evening Home Video
prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean home video from around 2003, casually recorded by a friend using an early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder. Capture an ordinary, slightly lazy evening with spontaneous moments, imperfect framing, and authentic everyday behavior.

**CHARACTER:** A young adult Korean woman in her early 20s with natural beauty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, and long black hair loosely tied in a messy side ponytail. She wears a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, and a simple silver necklace. Maintain consistent facial identity, outfit, and body proportions throughout.

**STORY:**

She wakes up from an evening nap in her modest Seoul apartment, looking sleepy and confused. She sits on the bed, rubs her eyes, stretches lazily, and checks the time on an old bedside clock. Her messy ponytail is half undone, and she yawns at the camera before saying, “Wait… is it evening already?”

She slips on her sneakers, grabs a little shopping bag, and leaves the apartment. The camera follows her down the stairs and through a narrow residential street filled with parked bicycles, overhead wires, small shops, and warm evening sunlight.

She visits a tiny neighborhood convenience shop, picks up potato chips, chocolate, instant noodles, and a bottled drink, then examines a snack packet suspiciously before laughing at the camera. She pays at the counter and walks outside with her purchases.

Feeling thirsty, she stops at an outdoor public water tap beside a small neighborhood park. She unties her ponytail, lets her long black hair fall naturally around her shoulders, splashes a little water onto her face, and drinks directly from the running tap with her hands cupped beneath it. Water drips from her fingers, and she laughs when a little splashes onto her top. She wipes her face with her hand and shakes her loose hair back casually.

She sits on a low concrete wall beneath the trees, opens her chips, takes a crunchy bite, and watches children playing and neighbors walking past. She offers a snack toward the camera as if sharing it with her friend filming.

Finally, she walks back home along the quiet street, carrying her snacks. At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera with a sleepy but happy smile and says, “Okay, now I'm ready for the evening!” The footage ends abruptly as her friend laughs and the camera tilts toward the ground.

**CAMERA & FOOTAGE:** Authentic 4 3 early-2000s MiniDV footage, handheld shake, imperfect framing, delayed camera reactions, accidental zooms, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild compression noise, and natural motion blur. No polished cinematography or smooth tracking shots.

**SETTING:** A modest Seoul apartment and an older Korean residential neighborhood circa 2003, narrow lanes, small convenience shops, public outdoor water taps, concrete walls, bicycles, overhead wires, and leafy neighborhood corners.

**AUDIO:** Natural evening ambience, birds, distant scooters, footsteps, shop door chime, snack packaging, coins, running water, splashing, crunching chips, neighborhood chatter, and spontaneous laughter. Casual natural English dialogue. No background music or narration.

**REALISM & CONTINUITY:** Natural sleepy expressions, believable hand movements, realistic water flow and splashes, consistent clothing and accessories, and a single continuous character identity. Her ponytail is untied only when she stops at the water tap and remains loose afterward. The video must feel like a forgotten personal recording from 2003, not a staged production.

author: Just_sharon7
title: Try This Roadster Film Commercial
prompt:
TITLE: "TRY THIS ROADSTER". A 28-second high-budget live-action car commercial, filmed for real on location by a professional crew with camera cars, a drone, a runway crane and an air-to-air camera jet. Shot on 35mm film: warm natural light, soft halation, fine grain, real motion blur, smooth stabilised moves with subtle handheld life. Every shot is at real-time speed with no slow motion, cut fast and punchy. The effects are flawless and invisible. Nothing looks digital or animated.

ASSETS:
- Roadster: the car, with the same shape, silver-white colour, scale and RDSTR plate in every shot.
- Character: the woman, with the same face, hair and outfit throughout.
- Racer: the man, an original racing driver in a plain white-and-silver race suit with no logos.
- Interior: the cabin, left-hand drive, with her always seated on the left behind the yoke.
- FlightFX: whenever the car hovers or flies, exactly four thin, semi-transparent white cold-gas vapour jets blow straight down from beneath it. They are soft and misty, with no glow and no flame.
- Courtyard, Desert and Runway: the locations. Each scene stays strictly in its own location.
Use every image for appearance only, never its background.

PHYSICAL REALISM: the car is always lit by the scene's own sun, casts a real moving shadow, reflects its surroundings, and is a normal 4.5 m sports car in scale. The camera always physically moves with the action.

SCENE 1, COURTYARD [0s-7s], location Courtyard (old stone college building, soft overcast daylight):
[0-1.5s] LOW DETAIL: the camera glides past the car's front wheel and sculpted silver flank, with the two people walking toward it in the background.
[1.5-3.5s] MEDIUM, OVER THE SHOULDER: Racer rests a hand on the car's roof, smiles and says, "Try this Roadster." Character, facing him, lights up and replies, "It looks amazing!"
[3.5-5.5s] MEDIUM: she opens the driver's door, slides into the left seat and runs her hand over the yoke, admiring the cabin.
[5.5-7s] LOW WIDE: the door closes with a solid thunk and the car starts with a soft electric hum.

SCENE 2, DRIVE-AWAY [7s-8s]: LOW TRACKING on a leafy street. The car accelerates past the lens with a rush of air, a light smoky haze curling off the tyres toward camera.

SCENE 3, DESERT CAMELS [8s-12s], location Desert (golden-hour highway, dunes, acacias):
[8-9s] CHASE behind the car: about 12 real camels scattered naturally on and beside the road turn their heads toward it, and one groans.
[9-10s] LOW REAR: the four vapour jets fire downward, smoke and sand billow out from beneath the car, and it lifts off the asphalt.
[10-11s] LOW ANGLE among the herd: a camel's head fills the foreground. Behind it, the car flies overhead and completes one smooth barrel roll around its nose-to-tail axis, with thin vapour trails behind it.
[11-12s] LOW REAR CHASE: the car lands softly on the road in a burst of smoke and dust and drives on.

SCENE 4, STREET SWEEPER [12s-15s], suburban autumn street:
[12-13s] MEDIUM WIDE: a tired street sweeper in an orange high-visibility vest stands beside a huge pile of leaves. The car hovers low beside the kerb, and she smiles at him from her open window.
[13-15s] LOW GROUND: the jets blast the pile into a swirling cloud of orange leaves and vapour. It clears to reveal a spotless sidewalk and the sweeper laughing in amazement.

SCENE 5, APPLE TREE [15s-17s], sunny green orchard:
[15-16s] WIDE TRACKING: the car flies in low and hovers beside a big apple tree heavy with red apples, its jets rustling the grass.
[16-17s] MEDIUM CLOSE-UP at her window: she reaches out, twists and plucks a shiny red apple, the branch springs back, and she smiles at it.

SCENE 6, CABIN [17s-18s]: MEDIUM INTERIOR side profile. She drives with one hand on the yoke and a relaxed, happy smile, warm light streaming through the glass.

SCENE 7, RUNWAY TO THE SKY [18s-28s], location Runway (golden sunset, unbranded white private jet):
[18-19.5s] LOW WIDE: the car rolls on its wheels down the runway beside the jet, both accelerating, the jet's engines shimmering with heat.
[19.5-21s] DETAIL with RACK FOCUS: the car's vapour jets blast down onto the runway, smoke billows out, its tyres lift, and focus racks to the jet's nose rotating up.
[21-22.5s] WIDE: both lift off together and climb toward golden clouds. The car pulls ahead, vapour streaming continuously.
[22.5-24s] CHASE: the car punches through a cloud and bursts out above a glowing sea of clouds.
[24-25.5s] WIDE AIR-TO-AIR: six to eight real white geese glide in on both sides of the car, flying alongside it.
[25.5-26.5s] TIGHT, SHALLOW FOCUS at her window: a goose in the soft foreground. She smiles and waves goodbye.
[26.5-28s] HIGH WIDE: the car tilts its nose down and descends through the clouds toward the golden land below, vapour trailing.

SOUND: real location audio only. Footsteps and dialogue in the courtyard, a door thunk and electric hum, a whoosh as the car passes, camel groans, the deep hiss and whoosh of the thrusters, leaves roaring, the sweeper's laugh, birdsong and an apple snap, a jet-engine roar, rushing wind, goose wing flaps and calls. No music, so it can be added in the edit.

Avoid: slow motion, CGI, an animated look, a plastic look, the car changing shape or size, glowing jets, rocket flames, fire, an evenly front-lit or pasted-in car, missing shadows, a front flip, a backflip, the woman on the right, a round steering wheel, team or sponsor logos, real celebrities, cartoon animals, birds frozen in the air, a white or studio background, text, watermark. #DomoAI #DomoAICPP

author: HeyAbhishek
title: Raccoon Riko 3D Animated Comedy Short
prompt:
Create an exactly 30-second vertical 9:16 premium 3D animated comedy short. Use the attached Riko character sheet as the exact visual reference for Riko. Maintain his identical face, amber-brown eyes, charcoal facial mask, silver-gray fur, cream muzzle and chest, small messy forehead tuft, compact agile body, short sturdy legs, nimble paws and exact fluffy tail-ring pattern throughout every frame. The reference defines Riko’s appearance only. If a storyboard board is also provided, use it only as a sequence and composition guide. Every storyboard panel represents a different moment in time, so never combine multiple Riko poses from separate panels into one frame.
Riko is the only visible character for approximately the first 26 seconds. He is a natural young raccoon with no clothing, thief costume, hat, mask accessory, belt, gloves, backpack, tools or gadgets. His “professional thief” personality comes entirely from cautious movement, intense observation, serious facial expressions, freeze reactions and overconfidence.
The final reveal introduces a second raccoon named Moku. Moku is a completely separate individual and must never look like a duplicate of Riko. Moku is slightly smaller, has darker cool-gray fur, no forehead tuft, narrower amber eyes, a cleaner symmetrical charcoal face mask and a slightly shorter fluffy ringed tail. Moku remains entirely inside the picnic basket until the final reveal. Do not show any part of Moku before approximately 0:26. No paws, ears, eyes, fur or tail from Moku may be visible before that point.
The entire story takes place in one quiet sunny countryside picnic clearing during consistent warm daylight. A large tree stands near one side of the clearing. Several meters away is one sturdy rectangular wooden picnic table with two permanently attached benches. The table remains completely stationary throughout the entire video. One large deep rectangular wicker picnic basket sits securely on the tabletop near the far end. The basket has a broad flat base and does not slide, tilt, rotate or fall. Its lid is attached by one fixed hinge along the far edge of the basket. The lid opens upward and backward. The hinge has enough resistance to hold the lid open after Riko raises it, so the lid does not randomly fall shut. Riko deliberately lowers the lid again during the final second.
The tabletop contains only three other visible picnic objects. One white ceramic plate lies flat on the tabletop, one metal spoon lies flat beside the plate, and one tall closed green thermos stands securely upright farther away. The plate never moves. The thermos never moves, tips or falls. The spoon is the only small tabletop object that moves, and it moves exactly once after Riko accidentally nudges it.
Inside the picnic basket is exactly one oversized sandwich. The sandwich is large enough for both raccoons to grip opposite sides but still small enough to fit comfortably inside the basket. Moku begins crouched low inside the deep basket with the sandwich in his paws. The basket walls and closed lid completely hide Moku from every exterior camera angle until the final reveal. The sandwich remains inside the basket until Riko opens the lid and grabs it.
Use a premium realistic 3D CGI animated-film aesthetic with detailed soft raccoon fur, realistic wicker fibers, natural weathered wood, rich green grass, warm sunlight, cinematic shadows and expressive but physically controlled character animation. The overall presentation should feel like a serious miniature heist played for comedy. Maintain believable body weight, gravity, climbing, friction, object contact and momentum. Every moving object must have a visible physical cause. Avoid exaggerated rubbery anatomy or impossible acrobatics.
From 0:00 to 0:02, open immediately on a close low-angle shot of Riko partially hidden behind the trunk of the large tree. Only his head, one shoulder and part of his ringed tail are visible. Riko cautiously leans around the tree and scans the clearing with intense concentration. Camera shifts with his gaze to reveal the picnic table several meters away. The wicker picnic basket sits on top. Its lid is almost closed but has one narrow natural gap of only a few centimeters. Through that gap, Riko can see only a small edge of the oversized sandwich. Moku is completely invisible. Riko’s expression instantly changes from curiosity to total focus.
From 0:02 to 0:05, use a low lateral tracking shot. Riko leaves the tree and sprints low through the grass toward the picnic table. His body stays close to the ground and his ringed tail streams naturally behind him. As he reaches the near bench, he lowers his body further and quickly scurries underneath the fixed bench rather than jumping over it. The bench never moves. Riko emerges safely on the other side and stops close to one thick wooden table leg.
From 0:05 to 0:08, use a clear side shot showing the full table leg. Riko places both front paws against the rough vertical wood and begins climbing. His front paws grip the wood while his hind paws push upward. His body remains close to the table leg. His tail hangs naturally beneath him and reacts only to his body movement. Riko climbs directly from the ground to the tabletop level. He does not jump, teleport or use the bench as a floating step. He reaches the upper edge and pulls himself safely onto the tabletop using both front paws.
From 0:08 to 0:11, show Riko crouched low on the tabletop. The wicker basket is visible farther ahead. Between Riko and the basket are the white ceramic plate, the flat metal spoon and the upright green thermos. These objects remain in their established positions. Riko lowers his body and begins moving slowly across the tabletop with careful deliberate steps. He looks at each obstacle before placing his paws. His expression is extremely serious, as if this is a major operation.
From 0:11 to 0:13, use a low close side shot of Riko moving beside the plate. His front paws pass safely around it. As his rear body follows, the edge of one rear paw accidentally touches the handle of the metal spoon. The spoon rotates only a few centimeters around one contact point on the tabletop and its bowl lightly taps the edge of the ceramic plate with one clear metallic CLINK. The plate stays fixed. The spoon immediately stops moving after the tap. Nothing falls. Riko freezes completely in place. His eyes widen. One paw remains suspended slightly above the tabletop. His tail stops moving.
From 0:13 to 0:16, hold the tension for a brief beat. Riko slowly moves only his eyes from side to side, checking the clearing. Nothing else happens. No humans appear. No additional animals appear. The plate, spoon and thermos remain still. Riko slowly relaxes. His raised paw lowers gently onto the tabletop. He resumes moving toward the basket, even more cautiously than before.
From 0:16 to 0:19, Riko reaches the picnic basket. Use a medium side shot showing the basket clearly resting flat and securely on the tabletop. Riko crouches beside the near edge and studies the narrow gap beneath the lid. He places one paw lightly against the wicker side to stabilize his own body, not to move the basket. He peers into the gap but can see only darkness and part of the sandwich. Moku remains completely hidden below the rim and behind the sandwich.
From 0:19 to 0:22, show the complete lid-opening action clearly. Riko places both front paws underneath the near edge of the hinged basket lid. His hind paws remain planted firmly on the tabletop. He slowly pushes upward using both front paws. The lid rotates upward around its fixed far-side hinge. The basket itself does not move. The lid remains permanently connected to the hinge. Riko raises the lid until it is open at roughly 80 degrees. The hinge resistance keeps it in that open position after Riko releases it. The lid does not fall back down.
From 0:22 to 0:24, use an over-the-shoulder view from behind Riko looking into the deep basket. The oversized sandwich sits near the upper center of the basket. Because of Riko’s shallow viewing angle, the basket rim and sandwich block the lower interior from view. Moku remains completely hidden below and behind the sandwich. Riko’s eyes widen with delight. He slowly reaches both front paws into the basket toward the near side of the sandwich.
From 0:24 to 0:26, Riko grips the near side of the sandwich with both front paws and pulls it toward himself. The sandwich moves only about 10 centimeters toward Riko, then stops. Riko freezes. He looks confused. He adjusts his grip and gives one second gentle pull. The sandwich resists because Moku is physically holding the opposite side inside the basket. The sandwich never moves by itself. It never levitates. It never leaves the basket during this interaction.

Character B — Decayed Antlered Warrior, reference image 2:
Preserve the ivory skeletal body, skull face, enormous branching antlers, intertwined dead branches, weathered off-white robes, ornaments, and sheathed swords. Visibly taller than the ninja. Heavy, devastating physical power. Maintain the same anatomy, costume, and silhouette throughout the battle.

A Manhattan intersection at blue hour: towering glass facades, yellow taxis, streetlights, steam rising from subway grates, and long views between skyscrapers. Keep the action within this recognizable intersection and the airspace immediately above it.

TIMELINE — EXACTLY 15 SECONDS

0.0–2.0 seconds — IMMEDIATE IMPACT
Begin on the antlered warrior’s fist already striking the ninja’s armored torso. The impact launches the ninja backward over a yellow taxi and into a building facade. Glass and masonry burst outward.

Start with a low, wide-angle street-level shot, then accelerate alongside the airborne ninja. Show the impact clearly before the debris expands. No introduction or preparatory posing.
2.0–5.0 seconds — SMOKE TELEPORT COMBAT
The warrior charges toward the damaged facade. Just before his follow-up punch connects, the ninja dissolves into black smoke.

The ninja reforms behind the warrior and lands a powerful rising knee, lifting him off the street. He immediately dissolves again and reappears overhead, driving a heel downward. Establish lingering ember-filled smoke clouds at the departure positions.

Use an over-the-shoulder view, a motivated whip-pan to the rear attack, then a wider upward view between the skyscrapers. Both fighters remain identifiable through each transition.

5.0–8.0 seconds — BRUTAL REVERSAL

Follow the downward motion from above, then cut to a low angle for the ground impact. The ninja disappears inside black smoke and rising dust. The warrior stands over the crater, apparently victorious. Let the impact sound decay into a brief hush.

8.0–12.0 seconds — THE SMOKE TRAP

12.0–15.0 seconds — DECISIVE FINISH

A short still beat. A crack races through the warrior’s skull and antlers. His skeletal body and branches fracture into dry ivory fragments and collapse completely. The warrior is definitively defeated.
The ninja remains standing and begins to sheath his sword as damaged masonry falls behind him. End on a sharp close-up of the fox mask’s glowing red eye.

GLITCH AND NOISE

During disappearance, the ninja’s silhouette briefly tears sideways before dissolving into smoke.
During reappearance, a red chromatic afterimage resolves into the solid body.

CAMERA AND SOUND

SETTING

A quiet old-fashioned café at sunset. Warm orange sunlight pours through the large windows. Vintage décor, wooden tables, soft curtains moving in the breeze, only a few distant customers. The entire story takes place in this single room.

The scene begins with a wide establishing shot. Adrian sits alone at a table, nervously stirring untouched coffee. Evelyn enters the café and notices him. The camera cuts between Adrian's hopeful eyes and Evelyn's uncertain expression before she slowly walks toward him.

The camera alternates between intimate close-ups, profile shots through the café window, low-angle table shots, and soft side tracking shots, emphasizing every glance and every pause.

In the final moments, they continue holding hands across the table without saying another word. The camera slowly dollies backward, revealing the warm café around them while the golden sunset fills the room. They never break eye contact.

6-8s: [Handheld Over-the-Shoulder] Three fast cuts in a row: diagonal slash across the chest, spinning slash across the ribs, rising slash under the jaw. Each cut sprays smoke and red embers.

8-10s: [Overhead Top-Down] Beast slams both fists into the ground. The meadow cracks open, a chunk of the cliff edge breaks off and falls with its waterfall. The samurai leaps across the crack at the last moment.

10-12s: [Orbiting Wide] The samurai jumps off the falling rock onto the nearest floating island, runs along its edge between the pine trees. The beast leaps after him, smoke stretching like a comet tail.

12-14s: [Dutch Angle Close Combat] On the floating island: beast swipes, splinters a pine tree; samurai ducks, draws the short sword with his left hand, now fighting with both blades.

14-16s: [Crash Zoom] Twin-blade flurry: katana to the shoulder, short sword stabbed into the glowing red eye. The beast roars, the red embers flare.

16-18s: [Low Angle Slow-Motion Ramp] Beast grabs him by the torso and hurls him off the island. He falls through the waterfall spray, catches a hanging root, swings and launches himself back up.

18-20s: [Tracking Side Shot] The samurai runs straight down the giant rock wall, through the hanging roots, and drops onto the beast's back from above, driving the katana between its shoulders.

20-22s: [Handheld Frenzy] Beast thrashes, smoke tendrils whip around him and lash his back, drawing blood. He rides it, stabbing three times with the short sword, then rips the katana free.

22-24s: [Wide Push-In] Both crash back down onto the meadow in an explosion of dirt and smoke. The beast rises on its hind legs, arms raised for a final smash.

24-26s: [Slow-Motion Impact] The samurai runs between its legs and delivers a spinning horizontal slash that cuts the beast in half at the waist; then a leaping two-handed overhead cut that splits its head down the middle.

26-28s: [Wide to Tight] The beast's entire body bursts into a storm of black smoke and dying red embers, swept over the cliff edge by the wind and down the waterfalls. The samurai lands on one knee at the edge, blades lowered.

28-30s: [Hard Cut Reverse Extreme Close-Up] Blurred samurai fills the foreground, chest heaving, sweat and dirt streaking his oni mask. Sharp background: on the nearest floating island, the scattered smoke pulls itself back together into the beast, two red eyes igniting one after the other, staring at him.

author: AIwithSynthia
title: Ultimate American Snack Shot From Summit
prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic 16 9 cinematic comedy short film featuring a young American woman in her 20s attempting an absurd long-distance snack trick from a snowy Colorado mountain summit to a cozy ski resort lodge below. Use the uploaded reference image for her exact facial identity and appearance. She wears a fitted black winter outfit, gloves, and snow boots on the mountain, then a cream oversized sweater, dark jeans, and winter boots inside the lodge. Her friends wear colorful ski jackets: a red-haired woman in pink, a man in an orange jacket, a bearded man in blue, and a friend wearing a silver puffer jacket and ski goggles.

On the mountain summit, she lies dramatically on a snow-covered viewing platform, carefully lining up a harmless oversized novelty marshmallow launcher toward a giant open snack bucket displayed on the lodge patio below. She bites her lip nervously, squints through a ridiculous toy-style scope, then gives the camera a confident grin. Extreme close-up of her eye, followed by a fast whip-pan and a bright white flash.

Inside the lodge café, her friends sit at a wooden counter with steaming mugs of hot chocolate. The marshmallow bounces harmlessly off the exterior window and lands directly in an open bowl of mini marshmallows on the patio table. Everyone looks outside in confusion.

Cut to the woman inside the café, now wearing her cream sweater, sitting innocently with her mouth open as if she expected the snack to arrive. Her friends exchange suspicious looks.

Suddenly, the lodge's outdoor snack bucket tips slightly in the wind, and a single marshmallow rolls through the open patio doorway and lands perfectly in her mouth. She closes her eyes and chews triumphantly while everyone stares at her in disbelief.

She opens one eye, smiles, and says, “Delivery confirmed.” Her friends burst into laughter, and the final shot holds on their stunned expressions.

AUDIO: Mountain wind, distant chairlift sounds, lodge chatter, a playful launcher pop, marshmallow bounce, hot chocolate cups clinking, surprised gasps, and spontaneous laughter. Light playful background music, with natural dialogue and accurate lip synchronization.

NEGATIVE: Subtitles, on-screen text, watermarks, blood, real weapons, injury, dangerous stunts, beauty filters, CGI appearance, animation, cartoon styling, flicker, changing faces, changing clothes within each location, duplicated characters, distorted hands, morphing props, and impossible character movements.

author: Aqsahere_
title: Indonesian Market Woman Stops Harasser
prompt:
A busy Indonesian street market in daytime. Small food and vegetable stalls, wooden carts, pedestrians, bicycles, tropical plants, realistic village-market atmosphere.

CAMERA: Third-person movie-style footage filmed by another person. She does NOT hold the camera. Natural handheld movement, subtle camera shake, realistic reframing and focus changes. The scene should feel like a raw, realistic action movie sequence rather than a polished music video. No selfie perspective, no vlog style, no slow motion, no exaggerated visual effects.

00:00–00:03 — Market Confrontation
The woman walks through a busy street market. Ahead, a local man is aggressively bothering another adult woman near a market stall. The woman notices what is happening and stops, watching for a moment.

00:03–00:06 — She Intervenes
She steps forward and calmly tells the man to stop. The man turns toward her, surprised and irritated. He steps closer and challenges her. She remains composed and firmly gestures for him to back away.

00:06–00:10 — Fight Begins
The man suddenly tries to shove her. She quickly steps aside and pushes him away to create distance. He comes toward her again, and a short, intense but non-graphic fight breaks out. She uses quick defensive movements to protect herself and force him backward.

00:10–00:13 — She Overpowers Him
The woman confidently gains the upper hand, pushing the man off balance and forcing him down onto the ground. She immediately steps back rather than continuing the attack. The other woman moves away safely.

00:13–00:15 — Crowd Intervenes
Several nearby market-goers rush over and separate them. The man gets back up, visibly frustrated but not seriously injured. The woman stands calmly, catching her breath, then checks that the other woman is okay. The scene ends naturally as the crowd gathers around them.

FIGHT STYLE: Realistic defensive choreography, quick movements, believable reactions and physical momentum. No weapons, no blood, no graphic injuries, no killing, and no excessive violence.

AUDIO: Natural Indonesian market ambience — vendors calling out, footsteps, bicycles, distant conversations, crowd reactions, natural shouting, and market sounds. No background music or artificial cinematic sound effects.

IMPORTANT: Keep the action grounded and realistic. The woman is defending another person, not looking for a fight. Maintain her exact identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and outfit throughout the entire video.

author: craftian_keskin
title: A short story about Revenge (Western)
prompt:
Style: Hyper-realistic cinematic Western revenge film,  grounded gunfight choreography, realistic body mechanics, dramatic facial acting, dusty frontier atmosphere, sweeping cinematic camera, emotional storytelling, ultra-detailed costumes, practical effects, realistic physics.

Duration: 30 seconds

Aspect Ratio: 16:9

IMPORTANT

Keep the SAME characters exactly as the reference sheets.

— RED: long crimson coat, red hat covering his eyes, twin revolvers, calm, controlled, emotionally scarred.

— SKULLY: black suit, skull mask, black hat, twin revolvers, cold and merciless.

Everything must feel like a real Western film.

No exaggerated action.

Realistic gun handling.

Heavy emotional acting.

Fast cinematic editing during the flashback.

------------------------------------------------

[00:00–00:03]

Extreme close-up of RED's face beneath the brim of his hat. Only his mouth and clenched jaw are visible. Wind blows his red coat gently. Dust drifts across the empty main street.

Cut to an extreme close-up of SKULLY's skull mask. His fingers slowly tighten around his revolver grip. Silence except for wind and creaking wooden signs.

------------------------------------------------

[00:03–00:10]

Rapid flashback montage.

Fast multishots with quick cuts and bright white flash transitions.

— RED is violently pinned to the muddy ground by three ruthless outlaws.

— His hands claw desperately through the dirt.

— SKULLY drags RED's terrified wife toward a waiting horse.

— Close-up of her tear-filled face.

— She stretches her hand toward RED.

— She screams:

"REEEEED!!"

— RED screams back, struggling violently.

— Boots stomp him back into the dirt.

— Close-up of their fingertips almost touching but never reaching.

— SKULLY mounts the horse with her.

— Horse gallops away through clouds of dust.

— RED continues screaming helplessly as the flashback burns away into white.

------------------------------------------------

[00:10–00:17]

Back to the present.

Wide cinematic shot of the deserted Wild West main street.

Citizens quietly gather on wooden porches, balconies and outside the saloon.

Bartender freezes while cleaning a glass.

A child is pulled indoors.

The sheriff watches silently.

Dust devils roll between RED and SKULLY.

Their coats sway gently.

No one speaks.

------------------------------------------------

[00:17–00:21]

Alternating close-ups.

RED's hand hovers beside his revolver.

SKULLY smiles beneath the skull mask.

Close-up on his mouth.

He quietly says:

"You will meet your wife soon."

Silence.

Only wind.

A loose tumbleweed rolls between them.

Extreme close-up of both trigger fingers.

------------------------------------------------

[00:21–00:25]

The duel.

Ultra-fast multishots.

Boots planting.

Coats whipping.

Hands drawing revolvers.

Extreme close-up of spinning cylinders.

Simultaneous gunshots.

Massive muzzle flashes.

Echoes across the town.

Silence immediately follows.

One second passes.

SKULLY slowly drops to his knees.

His revolver slips from his hand.

He collapses face-first into the dusty street.

------------------------------------------------

[00:25–00:30]

Ground-level POV beside the fallen SKULLY.

His vision blurs.

RED slowly walks into frame.

His long crimson coat fills the screen.

He stops over SKULLY.

Camera tilts upward from the ground as RED points his revolver directly down at him.

Close-up of RED's expression.

Calm.

Cold.

Without emotion.

He quietly says:

"Not yet."

A final gunshot.

Cut instantly to black.

Audio

No music.

Only cinematic Western sound design:

constant desert wind, distant crows, creaking wooden buildings, leather movement, boots on dirt, horse snorts in the flashback, muffled crowd breathing, clothing rustle, revolver hammers cocking, realistic gunshots with long canyon echoes, shell casings hitting the ground, SKULLY collapsing into dust, and complete silence after the final shot.

Negative prompts

No slow motion except subtle emphasis during the flashback. No superhero movement. No unrealistic gunplay. No floating cameras. No modern objects. No blurry characters. No cartoon effects. No excessive blood. Prioritize emotional facial acting, cinematic framing, realistic pacing, and frequent shot changes with strong visual storytelling.

title: Wrong Alley Genga-Break Fight Effect
prompt:
(Put your own character in as @[image1]. The trick: mark the key poses and put the pencil frame only on those, and write one camera move into every shot, or you get one flat wide shot. Keep the last 3 paragraphs as they are.)

Use @[image1] as the exact character reference. Keep her face, red eyes, long straight black hair with heavy bangs falling over her eyes, the black peaked officer cap with its crimson band and the red and gold cross emblem, the dark military uniform with gold buttons, crimson collar and shoulder board, the red and gold cross emblem on the collar exactly as in @[image1], the black choker, and the black stockings with garters, exactly as in @[image1]. She also carries a military saber in a black sheath at her hip. Her face stays exactly on-model as in @[image1] in every shot, wide shots and mid-slash included: the same eyes, nose, mouth and jaw, never stretched, melted or distorted.
At the start she wears a long black hooded cloak over all of it, the hood pulled deep so her face is hidden.
THE THUGS: five masked street thugs in dark hoodies with black cloth masks over the lower half of their faces, holding a baseball bat, steel pipes and a bike chain. The biggest one is a head taller than the rest.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL: a 15-second hand-drawn anime reveal and fight scene, cut like a TV anime action scene: fast hard cuts on the beat, with one frame trick on top: GENGA BREAK.
GENGA BREAK: on a marked key pose, the frame drops for 3 frames into the rough pencil key drawing of that exact pose, her included: white paper, black pencil line art, blue and red pencil construction lines, perspective guides and loose circles on the joints, no color and no ink fill. Then it snaps straight back to the finished color cels and the move continues. There are exactly 4 genga breaks: one on the red-eye close-up and one on each of the three hits in the fight, and none anywhere else.

SET: the back alley of a convenience store at night in heavy rain. Wet asphalt, puddles, a flickering vending machine, steam from a vent, the store's green sign above the back door. Cold blue colors with the warm light of the vending machine.

EDIT: hard cuts are allowed and should land hard on the action. The camera moves inside every shot, one move per shot. Never a locked-off frontal wide shot.

(0–2s) SHOT 1, THE REVEAL, the very first frame: low angle, the five masked thugs close in around her in the alley, tapping their weapons, while she stands in the rain in the long black hooded cloak, the hood so deep that only her lips and chin show. At once she grabs the front of the cloak and flings it off in one wide, confident sweep, straight into the face of the nearest thug. The cloak flies past the lens, a big flat black shape that fills the frame for a moment, and when it clears she is standing there in the full outfit from @[image1], cap on, the hood gone, the thugs freezing. Fast push-in as the cloak passes. CUT.
(2–4.5s) SHOT 2: she lifts her head. The camera pushes in to an extreme close-up of her eyes under the brim of the cap. KEY POSE 1: her red eyes looking up straight into the lens from under the brim, exactly the look of @[image1]. GENGA BREAK. CUT.
(4.5–6.5s) SHOT 3: close-up on her hand at her hip. She draws the saber out of the black sheath in one slow, clean pull; the blade comes into frame with one thin flat white highlight running along its edge. Tilt up with the blade to her face behind it. CUT.
(6.5–15s) SHOTS 4 to 7, FINISH, the fight: very fast cuts between angles, one hit per shot. The thugs rush her all at once. Her blade only ever cuts their weapons and their masks; the thugs are knocked out by the force of the hits and her kicks, never cut, no wounds:
- SHOT 4, side angle: the first thug swings the baseball bat at her head; she cuts the bat clean in half in one rising diagonal slash and kicks him into a pile of trash bags. KEY POSE 2: end of the slash, blade high above her head, the two halves of the bat flying. GENGA BREAK.
- SHOT 5, high angle: three thugs come from three sides with pipes and the chain; she spins on one foot in a wide horizontal slash that cuts all three weapons at once, and they are thrown back into the puddles. KEY POSE 3: end of the spin, arm fully extended, the cut pipes spinning in the air. GENGA BREAK.
- SHOT 6, low front angle: the biggest thug charges straight at the camera; she meets him with one downward slash; his black cloth mask splits in two and falls away and he drops to his knees and collapses face down. KEY POSE 4: end of the slash, blade pointing at the lens, the big thug falling past her. GENGA BREAK, the longest one, 6 frames.
- SHOT 7: back to color for the last second, wide: all five thugs lie knocked out on the wet ground around her, she flicks the rain off the blade and turns away, and the shot ends on the motion.

Timing: fast and snappy, every cut on the beat, a short hold only on the 4 key poses. She keeps moving until the last frame.

Sound: heavy rain, the heavy flap of the cloak as it is flung away, boots on wet asphalt, the saber leaving the sheath with a long metal ring, a sharp whoosh on every slash, wood and metal snapping as the weapons are cut, bodies hitting puddles, and a sharp pencil scratch on every genga break. No music, no voice, no narration. No 3D, no realistic look, no motion blur, no nudity, no gore, no blood, no wounds, no characters other than her and the five thugs, no subtitles, text or watermark.

The cloak, the rain, the cut weapons and the sword trails are all drawn as flat hard-edged shapes, no glow, no halo, no light rays, no particles, no sparkles.

六、色彩与光影脚本
0–4s 冷青绿与火橙对比,精灵村晨光 → 4–12s 焦林火光与烟尘,暖橙与深绿并存 → 12–20s 气场压迫,色调转冷,雷蓝微光渐起 → 20–30s 雷蓝、圣金、火橙三色对撞,彩虹光晕峰值,最后收束定格。

七、镜头语言规范
景别:【脚部局部特写→半身像→近景→面部特写→手/拳/剑局部特写】,对打段允许全身中景展示四人站位;严禁脱离角色的空镜。
非常规机位库(核心要求,每镜选用):脚部行走低角度跟拍、贴地滑行仰拍、右后脑/左后脑角落越肩拍、耳侧近距离贴脸、蛇视角树冠俯拍、剑身侧面贴拍、拳锋怼镜头、垂直俯拍四人交错、半身环绕。
镜头时长:剧情段每镜2–3.5秒,对打段每镜2秒,快速切换。
帧率策略:主体24fps;树冠伏击被挡、首次拳剑对撞、终极对撞三处内嵌120fps高速摄影慢镜,各占该镜约40%时长后硬切回全速。
光学规范:彩虹棱镜光晕与蓝色拉丝光斑随动作强度出现;强风与冲击镜头加方向性动态模糊;浅景深,焦外火星光斑与烟尘体积光。

八、分镜时间轴(S1–S13)
S1｜0–2.5s｜精灵村·弟弟察觉
脚部行走低角度跟拍:@ Image4靴子踏过巨树枝干,缓缓上摇至半身;远处天际有圣光痕迹,左侧森林燃烧、烟柱翻涌。@ Image4抬眼望天,尖耳微动,背后灵蛇缓缓游动。对话(日语,少年音,带不屑):
@ Image4:「兄さん、空の連中が降りてきたみたいだよ。バカな人間どもが戦ってばかりいるからさ。」(哥哥,天上的家伙们好像降下来了。都是因为那些愚蠢的人类总是打仗。)
角色锚定:@Image4红棕翘发异色瞳尖耳蓝色骷髅披肩灵蛇;背景为@ Image3的精灵村与大火。

S2｜2.5–4.5s｜兄长回应
右后脑角落越肩近景至面部特写:@Image5左绿右蓝异色瞳微眯,指尖雷弧一闪,背后火光与烟柱流动。对话(日语,青年低沉男声):
@ Image5:「ああ、お前の言う通りだ。あいつらの気配を感じる。」(嗯,你说得对。我感觉到了他们的气息。)
角色锚定:@ Image5深红棕乱发右脸焦痕古铜肩甲绿宝石圆核。

S3｜4.5–7s｜焦林行进·寻找幸存者
脚部低角度跟拍:@ Image1与@ Image2的靴子并肩踏过焦土与未燃尽的草地,火星从镜头前飞过;切左侧耳旁角落近景,两人穿行于半边燃烧的森林,巨翼与披风被热浪微微掀动。对话(日语):
@ Image1(温柔少女音,轻声):「……生き残りを探しましょう。」(……我们去找找幸存者吧。)
角色锚定:@ Image1淡金白长发金色新月光环骷髅金甲圣焰巨剑;@ Image2浅金长发金骨鸟首羽冠金色光轮蓝金长袍金弓。

S4｜7–9.5s｜树冠伏击·单剑挡下
蛇视角树冠俯拍:@Image4伏在高处树枝间,灵蛇探头对准下方两人;切@Image4与灵蛇同时俯冲突袭——@ Image1头也不回,单手挥起燃烧巨剑一记横斩,120fps慢镜半秒:剑火拖出长弧,灵蛇被轻松扫开,@ Image4空中翻身落回树枝,表情惊讶不甘。彩虹光晕在镜头边缘扫过。
角色锚定:@ Image4灵蛇与异色瞳;@  Image1骷髅金剑圣焰。

S5｜9.5–12s｜御姐判断
@Image2面部近景,火光映亮半张脸,嘴角带笑,护在@ Image1侧后方半个身位;背景火焰跳动、灰烬飘落。对话(日语,御姐音,带笑):
@Image2:「あら……この大地にも、まだ文明の名残があるみたいね。」(哎呀……这片大地上,似乎还残存着文明的痕迹呢。)
角色锚定:@ Image2金骨鸟首羽冠金色光轮脸颊红色划痕。

S6｜12–15.5s｜兄长登场·气场压迫
脚部行走低角度跟拍:@ Image5的靴子缓步踏过焦土,草叶被气场压伏外倒、火焰向两侧偏斜、灰烬绕身旋转、脚边雷弧细跳;缓缓上摇至半身,披风被气流掀起,@ Image4跳落至他身侧,灵蛇环绕。镜头转右后脑角落,@ Image5直视前方的两位天使,气势逼人。对话(日语,低沉男声,压迫感):
@ Image5:「お前たち、なぜここへ降りてきた。ここはお前たちの領域ではない。」(你们为什么降到这里?这里不是你们的地盘。)

S7｜15.5–17.5s｜天使回应
@Image1面部特写:新月光环在气场中微微震颤,蓝色瞳光不动,神情平静。对话(日语,温柔少女音,轻而坚定):
@ Image1:「あら……まだ人間が残っていたのですね。」(哎呀……原来还有人类留下来了呢。)
@ Image2在侧后方半身,依旧带笑,手搭弓弦。

S8｜17.5–20s｜兄长蓄势
耳侧贴脸近景:@ Image5对话(日语,低沉男声):
@ Image5:「ああ。俺は最初から、エルフの里で暮らしてきたからな。」(是啊。因为我从一开始就和精灵村一起生活。)
话音落,拳局部特写:@ Image5握拳,蓝白雷电从指尖爬满前臂,地面雷纹蔓延,草叶与火星被吸引上扬;@ Image4在旁侧摆开架势,灵蛇昂首。彩虹光晕在镜头边缘亮起。

S9｜20–22s｜雷拳突袭
贴地滑行仰拍:@ Image5徒手裹雷一个突进,雷光残影拖尾;拳锋怼向镜头,切@ Image1举起骷髅金剑硬接——120fps慢镜半秒:拳剑对撞,环形雷浪与火焰同时炸开,彩虹光晕在强光中绽放,草地被气浪压平,火焰倾斜。

S10｜22–24s｜弓蛇交锋
左耳侧角落近景:@ Image4与灵蛇同时扑向@Image2;@ Image2后跃拉满金弓,近距离连发金光箭,@ Image4空中翻转避开,灵蛇盘身拦下光箭,金色涟漪与鳞片火星四散,@ Image2嘴角仍带笑。

S11｜24–26s｜剑雷对撞
剑身侧面贴拍→面部近景:@ Image1圣焰巨剑与@ Image5雷拳连续快速交锋,火线与雷弧交织;两人僵持于一点,彼此近距离对视,@ Image1眼神平静温柔、@ Image5眼神凌厉,火星雷花溅在脸上。

S12｜26–28s｜四人交错
垂直俯拍转半身环绕:四人在燃烧的森林中交错换位——@ Image2一箭逼退@ Image4,@Image4借灵蛇缠绕树干反弹回攻,@Image5从侧面突进,@Image1挥剑斩出火弧挡住雷拳;背景火焰、烟柱、树叶、藤蔓全部随冲击卷动。

S13｜28–30s｜终极对撞·定格
半身大特写:@ Image1圣焰巨剑与@ Image5雷霆重拳在画面中央硬撞,同时@ Image2弓弦拉满对准@Image4,灵蛇扑向箭尖——120fps慢镜半秒:四人同时对撞,巨大环形冲击波向四周炸开,气浪吹飞火星与树叶,彩虹光晕在强光中绽放后向镜头边缘收束,画面定格后渐暗。无对白。

九、配音与音效设计
配音语言:日语,各角色声线固定:@ Image1温柔少女音、@ Image2成熟御姐音(与前篇一致);@ Image4清亮少年音(男)、@ Image5低沉青年男声。在风声与火焰声中保持清晰,不喊叫,仅对打段允许短促气声与喘息。
音效:森林燃烧的噼啪声、浓烟翻涌的低频声、草叶被气场压伏声、脚步踏碎焦土声、火焰剑挥动与火花声、雷拳蓄力的电流嗡鸣与爆闪声、金光箭破空声、蛇鳞摩擦与嘶声、拳剑对撞的低音爆与环形冲击波声、树叶与灰烬飘落声。
配乐:无BGM。

十、画质与风格
电影级大片质感,超写实3D动画,IMAX级画面;极致材质细节——羽毛层次、发丝逐根飘动、火焰与火星粒子、雷电弧光、蛇鳞折射、焦土与树皮纹理、烟尘体积散射;圣金、雷蓝、火橙的强烈色对比;电影级调色,浅景深,体积光,高动态范围;动作快而清晰,有重量感与真实物理感;全片背景自然鲜活、层次丰富。

十一、禁止清单
禁止镜头脱离角色(严禁无角色空镜);禁止四位角色外观、声线与参考图及前篇不一致;禁止巨剑、金弓、灵蛇、雷拳形态变形或漂移;禁止火焰凭空熄灭;禁止翅膀形态漂移或羽毛细节丢失;禁止变身、换装;禁止多余角色;禁止字幕、文字、水印、Logo;禁止血腥与残肢;禁止画面抖动变形、手部畸形、多余肢体;禁止背景静止;禁止@ Image1与 @ Image2姿态狼狈,须保持庄严从容。

prompt:

author: Adnan_Ai2
title: Japanese Classroom Flying Kick Comedy
prompt:
🎬 Long Video Generation Prompt 

Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic Japanese school action-comedy video that closely follows the reference video, preserving the same characters, clothing, classroom layout, lighting, camera angles, and exact sequence of events. The video takes place in a bright Japanese high school classroom with large windows, wooden desks, chairs, a green bulletin board, classroom cabinets, and an open wooden classroom door.

Scene 1 — The Boy's Angry Confrontation: Begin with a medium-wide cinematic shot of a young Japanese male student with messy, bright red hair wearing a black school uniform, white shirt, and dark trousers. He stands near the open classroom doorway, holding a dark navy schoolbag with tan-colored straps. Flames begin flickering around the bag as he looks angrily toward a calm, silver-blue-haired female student sitting at her desk. He shouts, “How dare you hit me!” His facial expression shows anger and disbelief. In the foreground, the girl remains seated, looking down at her notebook as if she is completely uninterested in his threats.

Scene 2 — The Girl Remains Calm: Show a close-up of the young woman with straight, shoulder-length silver-blue hair, delicate facial features, and a small hair accessory. She wears a light-gray school blazer, white shirt, pale-blue ribbon tie, and dark pleated school skirt. She quietly studies her open notebook while holding a pen. The red-haired boy remains visible in the background near the door, holding the burning schoolbag. Other students in matching gray school uniforms sit at nearby desks, watching the confrontation with surprise. Maintain the natural daylight coming through the large classroom windows.

Scene 3 — The Sudden Martial Arts Kick: The silver-blue-haired girl suddenly springs into action. Using a nearby wooden desk for balance, she performs an extremely fast, powerful spinning kick across the classroom. Show her body rotating naturally through the air, her long silver-blue hair flowing with the movement, and her dark pleated skirt moving realistically. Capture the kick with dynamic side-angle camera movement and a brief slow-motion moment as her leg extends horizontally toward the red-haired boy. The surrounding students react with shocked expressions. Keep the action choreography physically believable and the girl's facial appearance consistent with the opening shot.

Scene 4 — The Burning Schoolbag: Cut to the red-haired boy gripping the navy schoolbag as bright orange flames rise around its tan straps and upper surface. He struggles to control the burning bag, leaning backward with a startled expression as the flames grow larger. The warm orange firelight reflects across his black uniform and face, contrasting with the cool natural daylight in the classroom. Show realistic flickering flames, glowing embers, subtle smoke, and heat distortion. Keep the schoolbag visually consistent throughout the scene.

Scene 5 — The Boy Falls Near the Doorway: Show the red-haired student losing his balance and falling backward toward the open wooden classroom doorway. The burning schoolbag moves with him as he drops down near the entrance. Use a low-angle shot to capture the fall, followed by a medium shot of him crouched or down on the floor beside the bag, with flames still flickering around it. Avoid excessive destruction; the classroom furniture, windows, desks, and door should remain intact.

Scene 6 — The Girl Returns to Her Notebook: Finish with a calm, cinematic wide shot of the original classroom composition. The silver-blue-haired girl is seated at her desk in the foreground, quietly returning her attention to her open notebook and pen as though nothing unusual has happened. Her expression is neutral and composed. Other female students in gray blazers turn their heads toward the doorway in shock. In the background, the red-haired boy remains down near the entrance beside the burning schoolbag. The camera holds on the girl as she continues studying, creating a humorous contrast between her peaceful behavior and the chaos behind her.

Visual Style and Technical Requirements: Photorealistic live-action Japanese school drama, cinematic action-comedy, highly detailed human faces, consistent character identity, realistic hair movement, natural body proportions, accurate school uniforms, believable martial arts choreography, realistic fire simulation, warm orange firelight, soft daylight through classroom windows, shallow depth of field, smooth tracking shots, dynamic camera movement, brief slow motion during the kick, natural facial expressions, realistic shadows, and professional movie-quality visual effects.

Strict Consistency Instructions: Use the same silver-blue-haired girl, the same red-haired boy, the same gray school uniforms, the same navy schoolbag with tan straps, the same wooden classroom desks, the same large windows, and the same open wooden doorway throughout. Follow the scene order precisely: the boy shouts angrily while holding the burning bag, the girl remains calm, she performs a powerful flying kick, the boy struggles with the flaming bag and falls near the doorway, and the girl calmly returns to her notebook while the other students stare in shock. Do not add extra characters, magical fireballs, supernatural powers, new locations, or unrelated action scenes.

Output: 4K photorealistic video, cinematic 16:9 composition, smooth 24–30 FPS motion, realistic sound-design atmosphere, consistent character appearances, and seamless transitions. Aim to recreate the reference video as closely as possible.

author: KrishnaBio1
title: Tokyo scramble time-freeze encounter
prompt:
Cinematic ultra-realistic sci-fi superpower short film, 16:9, 30 seconds, 24fps, shot like a high-budget streaming drama, soft overcast daylight with warm highlights, a huge Tokyo-style pedestrian scramble crossing surrounded by tall buildings and glowing billboards, shallow depth of field, crisp detail, subtle film grain, calm blue-grey color grade.
Character 1: A young Japanese woman in her early 20s, shoulder-length black hair with soft bangs, natural makeup, wearing a beige trench coat over a white sweater, dark pleated skirt and brown loafers, carrying a small shoulder bag. Quiet, observant, a little tired of hiding her secret.
Character 2: A young man in his mid-20s, short dark messy hair, sharp but kind eyes, wearing a charcoal hoodie and black jeans with a canvas backpack. Calm, curious and slightly amazed.
Keep both faces, hairstyles and outfits identical in every shot.
Setting: A crowded city crossing that suddenly freezes in time, with people, cars, birds and falling raindrops all stopped in mid-motion.
🌧️ 0–4s: Wide shot of a packed crossing, hundreds of people walking in every direction, umbrellas opening in light rain. The woman stands at the edge of the crowd, glances at her wristwatch and takes a slow, deep breath.
⏳ 4–8s: Close-up of her eyes. She blinks and the entire world stops at once: raindrops hang in the air, people freeze mid-step, a bus halts in the middle of the road, a flock of pigeons stays frozen in the sky. Sound drops into deep silence. Slow 360-degree camera orbit around her.
✨ 8–13s: She walks calmly through the frozen crowd, gently touching a floating raindrop that ripples into tiny sparkles. She smiles faintly, clearly used to this secret escape. Smooth low tracking shot, dreamy light.
😲 13–17s: She suddenly stops. In the distance, a young man in a grey hoodie is also walking through the frozen crowd, completely unfrozen. Her eyes widen in shock. She whispers: "You can move?"
💓 17–22s: He turns around, equally stunned. They slowly walk toward each other between frozen people and hanging raindrops. Alternating close-ups of their faces, wind-less silence, a faint heartbeat sound.
🤝 22–26s: They stop face to face in the centre of the crossing. He says softly: "I thought I was the only one who could stop time." She answers: "So did I." Wide shot, the frozen city glowing around the two of them.
😊 26–30s: They look up at the frozen rain. She lifts her hand, and with a gentle snap of her fingers time restarts: rain falls, the crowd flows, the bus rolls on, and the two of them are left standing still in the middle of the moving city, smiling at each other. Slow pull-back, cut to black.
🎧 Audio: Soft rain and city noise that cut to deep silence when time stops, a faint heartbeat, gentle footsteps, a subtle emotional piano-and-strings score, clear natural English dialogue.
🎬 Style: Realistic grounded sci-fi drama, smooth physics, natural human movement, emotional performances, non-graphic, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

author: Adnan_Ai2
title: Bleachers prank backfires: phones stuck on goalpost
prompt:
🎬 Long Cinematic AI Video Prompt

Prompt 

A cinematic teen drama short film, shot in warm golden-hour autumn light on the aluminum bleachers of a high school football stadium. The overall tone is naturalistic and emotionally intimate with a sudden comedic-revenge twist. Shallow depth of field, soft bokeh from sunlight hitting metal bleacher rails, handheld documentary-style camera with gentle drift, 24fps film grain, warm orange-and-teal color grade, lens flares from low sun.

**Shot 1 (0–5s):** Close-mid shot of a teenage girl with soft blonde hair pulled into a messy bun, wearing an off-shoulder cream sweater over a black tank top. She sits on metal bleachers scrolling intently on her phone. Beside her, a teenage boy in a light blue oversized hoodie with shaggy brown hair leans in close over her shoulder, peering at the screen with mild curiosity. Soft rim lighting from the setting sun behind them, blurred silver bleacher rows in the background, a few autumn leaves scattered on the seats.

**Shot 2 (5–9s):** Sudden jump cut — a burst of red smoke or colored powder explodes into frame, enveloping a small group of three teens sitting further down the bleachers. They flinch back in surprise, hands raised defensively to shield their faces, hair and loose strands whipped by the gust of the blast. Golden sunlight scatters through the red haze creating a hazy, dreamlike, slightly chaotic visual. Quick, reactive camera shake sells the surprise.

**Shot 3 (9–14s):** Intimate close-up portrait of a different girl — wavy, sunlit flyaway hair, delicate gold hoop earrings and a thin gold necklace, wearing a white knitted top. She looks down at her phone with a quiet, pensive, slightly worried expression, warm backlight haloing her hair, skin tones glowing in the low sun. The mood shifts from chaos to a quieter, tense beat.

**Shot 4 (14–20s):** Low-angle wide shot looking straight up at a bright yellow steel goalpost crossbar cutting diagonally across a clear, deep-blue late-afternoon sky. Below it, three teenagers stand on the field looking upward with concern and frustration — one boy in a grey hoodie with a black backpack reaches up and starts climbing the vertical post, straining to reach something lodged at the top. 0—5秒——特写镜头，她的眼睛充满画面，处于失焦状态。对焦环精准地推至虹膜，她的睫毛随之扬起。长镜头，静态。右上方的温暖阳光捕捉到了她太阳穴的湿睫毛和细毛; 她脸上的阴影面保持柔软和开放，被蓝色背景的反弹所填充。潮湿的发束在镜头上漂移，在脸颊上投下清晰的行进阴影。

5-11s-相机向后拉，逆时针缓慢弧线，露出她裸露的肩膀对着粉蓝色的田野。在框架的边缘，低握在她的手中，flacon进入-严重偏离焦点，仅阅读为通过厚玻璃折射的温暖蜂蜜光芒。风力机以缓慢的弧度抬起她的头发; 单个水滴从末端释放并悬挂在空中，每个水滴都像坚硬的白色针一样捕捉太阳。她一动不动地站着，下巴微微抬起，目光望向画面左侧之外。

11-17秒——她将香水瓶举至颈侧。焦点从她的脸上架到玻璃上: 多面的肩膀将坚硬的阳光分成干净的棱柱形边缘，蜂蜜汁从内部发光，凝结在表面上。她按下-细雾以慢动作释放，雾化的液滴悬浮在明亮的银色云层上，在蓝色上飘过锁骨，沉淀在光滑的皮肤上。她一接触便闭上了眼睛。

17-23s-相机保持电弧，直到它本身摆动到阳光下: 框架绽放成柔和的温暖过度曝光的白色，粉蓝色洗涤到接近白色的节拍，头发边缘溶解成纯净的光。然后，曝光回落，她从另一侧的花朵中重新组合，现在从左侧照亮，头发在温暖的边缘光中光晕。她把脸转向阳光，缓慢而深思熟虑，嘴唇轻柔地呼气。

23-27s-flacon在她的下巴旁边上升到框架中，两者都在同一平面上锋利。镜头缓缓推进，幅度约为6%。温暖的阳光划过玻璃，并在她的肩膀上抛出移动的折射苛性碱。她微微颔首，第一次将目光直视镜头——凝视着，一动不动，双目炯炯。除了一缕头发和飘散的雾气，一切都是一动不动的。

27-30岁-她轻轻地偏离了焦点，相机独自落在了flacon上，站在淡蓝色的田野上，站在苍白的潮湿表面上，背后的烈日将蜂蜜汁燃烧成温暖的光芒，并在地板上长时间清洁苛性碱。一滴水珠顺着瓶身滑落。画面在最后一拍上完全静止不动。

title: 15s psychedelic horror music video that melts your brain
prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9 psychedelic horror music video: 30 distinct animated compositions, an average of 0.5 seconds per shot. Start at full intensity on the first frame. Make the supplied artworks come violently alive inside a corrupted, hypnotic nightmare.

REFERENCE DIRECTION
Use all supplied images as visual references. Preserve their recognizable silhouettes, intricate ornament, chrome surfaces, skulls, horns, jeweled details, printed textures, deep blacks, blood-red accents and electric rainbow colors. Develop additional compositions from these motifs to reach 30 shots. Preserve the mix of photographic detail and graphic illustration. Each shot fills the screen.
MOTION PRIORITY
The subjects themselves must move, not just the camera. Use one dominant, instantly readable action per shot:

Horned figures snap their heads toward the viewer; metallic blindfolds ripple and ribbons whip outward.
Chrome mouths open abruptly; keys twist, chains swing and skull-shaped jewelry vibrates.

Uncanny deer jerk forward; antlers branch rapidly and nearby plants coil inward.
Skeletal warriors slash across the frame; armor plates shift and radial patterns spin behind them.
A psychedelic mechanical tunnel contracts and pulls the camera through its center.
Giant cybernetic skulls loom over a neon city; jaw mechanisms snap and buildings bend around them.
Chrome bird-skull creatures thrust their beaks toward the lens; segmented necks coil and unfold.
A skeletal astronaut snaps toward camera as neon vapor pours through the helmet.
Striped cakes twist like living sculptures; cream stretches, cherries levitate and red syrup flows upward.
Horned skull idols rotate abruptly; ornaments orbit their faces and printed layers slip out of registration.
An ornate oiran-like figure turns sharply; hair ornaments vibrate, sleeves whip and metallic ribs expand.
A jeweled black cat fixes its gaze on the viewer, then lunges toward the lens as its ornaments scatter into light.
Use different actions and framing when a motif returns. Make every scene visibly animate from its first frame. Keep the main subject recognizable beneath the distortion.
EDITING / 15-SECOND STRUCTURE
0.0-3.0s: 5 shots, approximately 0.6s each. Open with an extreme close-up of a horned face snapping toward camera on the first kick. Cut through a metallic mouth, a deer, a skeletal warrior and a tunnel. Immediate impact; no intro.
3.0-6.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Neon city skulls, chrome bird creatures, astronaut and cat. Hard cuts, whip-pan transitions and sudden changes of scale.
6.0-9.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Warping desserts, horned idols and the ornate figure. Surfaces stretch, liquefy and snap back. Push through an eye, mouth or spiral into the next composition.
9.0-12.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Return to earlier motifs with more aggressive actions, extreme close-ups, inverted viewpoints and brief kaleidoscopic multiplication.
12.0-15.0s: 7 shots: six approximately 0.4s shots followed by a 0.6s final shot. Maximum kinetic intensity. End with a horned skull rushing into the lens, the image tearing into chromatic fragments, then an abrupt cut to black on the final distorted impact. No fade.

GLITCH / NOISE
Dense, deliberate analog and digital corruption: RGB channel separation, horizontal scanline tears, VHS tracking errors, CRT interference, granular static, datamosh trails, pixel-sorting streaks, block displacement, color inversion, frame skipping and short motion echoes. Place strong glitches on cuts, kicks and snare fills. Use brief 1-3-frame disruptions and textured noise bursts while keeping the subjects visible. Distortion must react to moving forms. Alternate crisp, disturbing detail with explosive corruption. Avoid prolonged full-screen white flashes.

CAMERA
Aggressive crash zooms, rapid lateral whip pans, short barrel rolls, macro-to-wide jumps and forward dives through openings. Choose one main camera move per shot. Preserve clear focal points and deep layered motion.
AUDIO
Original instrumental EDM / dark psychedelic trance at 150 BPM. Start immediately with a heavy four-on-the-floor kick and tight rolling sixteenth-note bass. Add distorted acid arpeggios, unsettling resonant synths, metallic percussion, reverse swells and granular digital noise. Synchronize cuts, subject impacts and glitches to beats and offbeats. Increase density toward the final second. No vocals, speech or narration.
AVOID
Static slideshow frames, simple Ken Burns motion, slow motion, gentle crossfades, long establishing shots, cute cheerful mood, generic smooth plastic rendering, persistent split screens, contact-sheet layouts, added captions, titles, subtitles, logos and watermarks.

A realistic South Korean high school classroom during the daytime. Large windows cover one side of the classroom, allowing soft natural sunlight to enter through cream-colored curtains. She wears a perfectly realistic Korean school uniform consisting of a dark navy blazer with white piping, a white collared shirt, a dark tie, a dark pleated skirt, black socks, and black school shoes.

Several Korean male students wear matching navy school uniforms. They behave like arrogant school bullies, lounging in their chairs and laughing among themselves.

SCENE 1 — ESTABLISHING THE CLASSROOM (0–3 SECONDS)

Begin with a cinematic wide shot of a sunlit Korean high school classroom.

The Korean girl sits quietly at her desk near the large windows. Her notebook lies open, and a pink pen rests on the wooden desk. She looks forward with a calm, serious expression.

Behind her, several male students are laughing and behaving disrespectfully. One boy leans back in his chair with an arrogant smile while his friends exchange amused looks.

The camera slowly moves toward the girl, establishing the contrast between her quiet composure and the disruptive students behind her.

Natural daylight, realistic classroom ambience, subtle curtain movement, authentic Korean school atmosphere.

She does not shout or display exaggerated anger. Her silence communicates confidence and intimidation.

Cut briefly to a male student smirking at her. He leans forward, believing she will not react.

Use shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural eye movements, and cinematic close-up framing.

The girl remains focused and composed.

She sidesteps his attack, pivots smoothly, and uses a controlled martial-arts combination to send him stumbling into an empty desk.

【出力仕様】シンプルなキャラクターシートを1枚生成する。アスペクト比は16:9固定。完成画像を1枚だけ生成する。文字、タイトル、ラベル、数字、ロゴ、説明文、枠線、装飾は入れない。ポスター風デザイン、雑誌風デザイン、制作過程、比較画像、分割比較レイアウトは生成しない。\
【入力】本指示書と同時に、完成済みのアンカー画像を1枚だけ添付する。添付画像を唯一の人物・顔・髪・体型・衣装参照として使用する。\
【目的】アンカー画像の人物と衣装を正確に維持したまま、動画制作で使用しやすい、シンプルで見やすい16:9のキャラクターシートを作成する。人物と衣装の立体構造確認に加え、顔立ちや髪の印象も確認しやすい資料とする。\
【構成】1枚の16:9画面内に合計6ビューを整理して配置する。画面の左から中央にかけて、全身三面図を左から「正面全身／側面全身／背面全身」の順に横並びで3つ配置する。画面右側には、顔アップを上から「やや左向き／正面／やや右向き」の順に縦方向で3つ配置する。\
【人物同一性】アンカー画像の人物の顔立ち、目元、鼻筋、口元、輪郭、年齢感、肌、髪型、髪色、髪の長さ、前髪、体型、身長感、頭身、肩幅、胴体幅、腰幅、脚の長さ、脚の太さを維持する。全身三面図と顔アップ3点のすべてを同一人物として自然に揃える。\
【全身三面図】全身三面図は同一人物を3方向から見たものとして統一し、頭頂から足元まで切れずに収める。アンカー画像の衣装を主たる参照として、襟、袖、胸元、胴体部分、腰周辺の装飾、スカートやボトムの丈、スリット位置、布の重なり、色、柄、素材感、靴の形状をできる限り整合的に維持する。正面図はアンカー画像の人物と衣装を基準に最も忠実に再現する。側面図は人物と衣装の立体構造が分かる自然な真横向き、背面図は髪の後ろ姿、肩、背中、衣装背面、脚、靴の後ろ側を自然に再構成する。側面図と背面図はアンカー画像に見えていない部分を推定で補完してよいが、正面図と矛盾しないようにする。\
【顔アップ】顔アップはアンカー画像を主たる参照として、参照人物の顔立ち、目元、鼻筋、口元、髪型、髪色、雰囲気をできる限り維持する。3つの顔アップを同一人物として自然に揃える。髪の流れや顔まわりの印象はアンカー画像と矛盾しないように整える。衣装の襟元や肩周辺は適度に見えてよいが、顔の確認を優先する。「やや左向き」「やや右向き」は完全な横顔ではなく、顔立ちが十分に分かる程度の軽い角度にする。\
【姿勢】全身三面図は3方向すべてニュートラルな直立姿勢とする。正面図は真正面を向き、両腕は身体からわずかに離して自然に下ろし、両脚は軽く間隔を空けて立つ。側面図は真横から見た姿勢とし、腕で胴体の輪郭を完全に隠さない。背面図は完全に後ろを向き、顔をカメラ側へ振り返らせない。特徴的なポーズは取らず、身体と衣装の構造確認を優先する。\
【背景】背景は無地の明るい白、またはごく薄いライトグレー。装飾や模様は入れない。床表現も最小限にし、人物確認を優先する。\
【レイアウト】画面幅の約4分の3を全身三面図、約4分の1を顔アップ縦3点に使用する。全身三面図3体が主役として十分な大きさで見えるように画面左から中央の横長領域を広く使い、顔アップ3点は画面右側の縦列に上から下まで均等な間隔で並べる。全身と顔アップが干渉せず、衣装確認と顔確認の両方がしやすい構成にする。余白は適度に確保し、各ビューが十分な大きさで見えるようにする。\
【全体トーン】シンプル、クリーン、実用的。動画用資料として見やすく、人物と衣装の構造確認を優先する。デザインポスター化しない。\
【禁止】文字、タイトル、ラベル、番号、ロゴ、説明文、装飾フレーム、背景演出、ポスター風演出、過度な陰影演出、別人化、衣装変更、配色変更、柄の簡略化しすぎ、特徴的なポーズ、脚の交差、腕上げ、全身三面図を小さくしすぎるレイアウト、顔アップを横並びにするレイアウト、側面図や背面図で正面図と矛盾する構造、手足の欠損、人物同士の重なり。

Title: SHARED_KARATE_SPEED_ACTION_LOCATION_SEPARATION_v1_2_COMPACT

※動画生成プロンプト
👇️👇️👇️
[DECLARATION]
15秒・1:1スクエア。PHOTOREAL CINEMATIC HIGH-SPEED KARATE ACTION。
広大な木造修練場で、主人公が離れた地点間を爆発的に横断し、到着地点ごとに鋭い空手技を完成させる。大胆なコマ落ち、位置飛び、残影、強烈な打撃とインパクトフレーム、巨大木柱の破壊。終盤は空中高くで圧倒的な存在感を放ち、巨大な衝撃と圧力波で締める。

[REFERENCE]
@image1 主人公のキャラクターシート1枚。顔・頭部形状・髪・体型・衣装・靴・全身シルエットを唯一の人物参照として全編維持する。各ビューは同一人物。シート背景・枠線・文字・管理レイアウトは映像化しない。

[CONDITION]
巨大な古い木造修練場。高い梁天井、太い木製柱、遠方まで続く木板床、格子窓、冷たい自然光、薄い粉塵。柱間は数十メートル級に広く、複数の柱列で奥行きと横幅を見せる。
地点は同一空間内に固定：A＝左手前、B＝右奥の開けた床、C＝左奥の柱列付近、D＝右手前の巨大木柱前。地点名は画面表示しない。柱と地点の位置関係を維持し、移動距離が背景の遠近感から分かる画角にする。A→B→C→Dの地点変更は同一空間内の高速横断で描く。
移動と空手を完全に分離する。移動SHOTは固定広角で長い柱間を瞬間横断。通常の走行描写を短縮し、中間姿勢を大胆に省略して2〜3段階の位置飛びを作る。後方には時間差で薄く消える短い残影を複数残し、移動した方向と距離を示す。残影は別人ではない。床に粉塵の軌跡、空気の圧縮線と風圧。背景の柱は動かさない。人物本体だけが到着地点に達し、移動中は技を出さない。
空手SHOTは到着後、その地点で足場を固めて行う。正拳突き、下段受け、上段回し蹴り、連続打撃、跳躍回転蹴り。踏み込み、腰と軸足の回転、重心移動、技の起点と終点を明確にし、打撃動作は省略しない。全身ローアングルや近接構図で見せ、重要な打撃の決め瞬間のみ、極短い高コントラストのインパクトフレームを挿入し、直後は通常映像へ戻す。
終盤は白金色の強い光、空気の歪み、放射状の光線、巨大な圧力波、粉塵と木片を大胆に用いる。実写的な質感と空中の主人公の威圧感を維持する。

[SHOT FLOW]
[Shot 1｜0.00~0.70秒]
[START]
固定超広角。左手前Aの主人公と遠方右奥B、広い柱間を同時に見せる。
[MAIN EVENT]
主人公がA→Bを瞬間横断。中間姿勢が大胆に飛び、短い残影と粉塵の軌跡を残す。カメラと背景は固定し、人物だけが一気に右奥へ移る。
[END]
Bで急制動した瞬間にハードカット。

[Shot 2｜0.70~2.15秒]
[START]
B地点、ローアングル全身。移動は完了している。
[MAIN EVENT]
強い踏み込み、鋭い下段受けから腰を回した正拳突き。足から拳への力の伝達を見せる。拳の振り抜きに極短い白のインパクトフレーム。圧縮空気の衝撃波と粉塵が前方へ爆発的に走る。
[END]
突きを完成させ、次の移動方向へ切り返した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 3｜2.15~2.85秒]
[START]
Bと遠方左奥Cを収める固定広角。
[MAIN EVENT]
B→Cを横方向に瞬間横断。走行の中間を大胆に間引き、位置が2〜3段階で飛ぶ。時間差で消える短い残影、床の粉塵の筋、通過する風圧。移動中の技はない。
[END]
Cに到着し、足を踏みしめた瞬間にカット。

[Shot 4｜2.85~4.55秒]
[START]
C地点、横からのローアングル全身。
[MAIN EVENT]
重心を低く落として鋭く受け、軸足と腰を回して爆発的な上段回し蹴り。脚の伸展と蹴りの軌道を明瞭に見せる。振り抜きに極短い高コントラストのインパクトフレーム、白い衝撃光と横方向の圧縮波。粉塵が飛び、衣装が遅れて翻る。
[END]
脚を引き戻し、移動方向へ切り返した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 5｜4.55~5.30秒]
[START]
Cと右手前Dの巨大柱を見渡す固定ロングショット。
[MAIN EVENT]
C→Dを斜め手前へ瞬間横断。遠景の人物が前景へ急拡大する。大胆な位置飛び、時間差の残影、長い粉塵の尾、空気の圧力線で移動距離と速度を見せる。技は出さない。
[END]
Dの巨大柱前で急制動した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 6｜5.30~6.85秒]
[START]
D地点、巨大木柱を背景にしたローアングル全身。
[MAIN EVENT]
下段受けから高速の正拳突き、反対腕による追撃の正拳突き。足場を保ち、腰の回転と重心移動で2発を明確に成立させる。各拳の振り抜きに短い衝撃閃光と圧縮空気の波。技の途中では長く静止しない。衣装と粉塵が強く揺れる。
[END]
連打を完了し、軸足に力を集中した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 7｜6.85~8.65秒]
[START]
同じD地点。主人公と巨大木柱が見える斜め側方の広角全身。
[MAIN EVENT]
その場で床を蹴って爆発的に跳躍。空中で鋭く回転し、巨大木柱へ強烈な回転蹴りを放つ。体幹、脚の伸展、蹴りの方向を明確に描く。白金色の空気の筋が蹴りに沿い、粉塵と衣装が激しく巻き上がる。
[END]
蹴りが柱へ命中する直前にハードカット。

[Shot 8｜8.65~10.65秒]
[START]
蹴りと巨大木柱を捉える迫力ある斜めローアングル。
[MAIN EVENT]
命中時に極短い白のインパクトフレーム。直後に通常映像へ戻り、柱全体へ亀裂が走り、木片と粉塵が爆発的に飛散。巨大柱が折れて倒れ始め、床面へ衝撃波が走る。主人公は蹴りの反動で崩壊する柱から離れ、上空へ跳ね上がる。
[END]
柱が崩壊し、主人公が上昇を始めた瞬間にカット。

[Shot 9｜10.65~12.55秒]
[START]
巨大な梁天井を見上げるローアングル。主人公は破壊された柱の上方へ上昇中。
[MAIN EVENT]
主人公がさらに高く舞い上がり、回転を収束させて空中で威圧的な空手の決め姿勢を取る。衣装は激しく翻り、白金色の光と圧縮空気の渦が集まる。低いカメラから主人公の全身を大きく印象的に捉え、威圧するシルエットを強調する。下方では柱が崩落し、木片と粉塵が舞う。背後の強烈な光芒が天井と柱列を照らす。身体は停止したように見えるが、周囲の破片・光・衣装は動き続ける。
[END]
空中の主人公に光と圧力が極限まで集中した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 10｜12.55~15.00秒]
[START]
空中高くの主人公を正面下方から捉える。背後は梁天井と強烈な白金色の光。
[MAIN EVENT]
威圧的な決め姿勢の完成と同時に、画面全体を支配する巨大なインパクトフレーム。白・黒・金の極端な高コントラスト、主人公の強烈なシルエットと放射状の衝撃線・光の爆発を極短く見せ、即座に実写映像へ戻る。主人公から巨大な白金色の圧力波が全方向へ解放され、床の粉塵を巨大な円環状に押し広げ、木片を巻き上げ、空気を歪ませ、遠方の柱列まで強烈な光と風圧が届く。カメラは一気に大きく引き、巨大空間の中央上空に浮かぶ主人公と放射光・圧力の渦を超広角全景で見せる。
[END]
空中の強い決め姿勢と壮大な余韻を保ち、黒画面へ切らず自然終了。

[SOUND]
疾走感の強い打楽器主体のBGMあり。超高速移動の風切り・空気の破裂音、急制動、踏み込み、突き・蹴り、衣擦れ、インパクト音、木柱の破砕・倒壊を動作に同期。終盤は重い圧力音、巨大な衝撃音と空間の轟音。台詞・ナレーションなし。

[NEGATIVE]
移動しながらの格闘技、到着前の打撃、長い通常走行、ダンス化、全編スローモーション、残影の別人物化、人物・衣装の崩れ、狭い空間、無関係な柱の破壊、最後の着地、黒画面へのハードカット、文字、ロゴ。

title: Gothic castle wizard duel with reality-bending VFX
prompt:
