author: doctorwasif
title: K-Pop Idol Day Camcorder Montage
prompt:
**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts naturally per location (warm dorm light → cool van light → studio fluorescents → bright stage lights).

**STYLE:**
Fast-paced time-lapse montage feel — quick cuts stitched together across locations, sped-up transitional movement between them. Instead of synced dialogue, her voice plays as reflective voiceover narration over the visuals, tying the day together. Energy builds progressively from sleepy morning to high-adrenaline stage finish.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean idol , 20s. Long straight black hair, elegant yet lovely Korean features, dewy glass skin, coral pink lips, big eyes. Outfit changes naturally per location: cozy loungewear at the dorm, casual comfortable clothes in the van, modest athletic wear in the practice room, and a stage outfit for the final segment — each fully covering arms and torso.

**Setting Progression**

Dorm room (morning) → van interior (daytime) → practice room (afternoon) → backstage/stage (night).

**Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)**

1. *(~2s, dorm, propped camera, sleepy morning light)* She stretches, rubbing her eyes, hair messy. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, dorm, handheld, quick motion)* She moves through her morning routine in fast, sped-up cuts — brushing hair, grabbing a bag. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, van interior, handheld, window light)* She sits by the window, phone in hand, soft daylight passing over her face. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, van, macro insert)* Close-up on her hand adjusting a playlist on her phone, light flickering through the window. No narration — ambient road sound only.

5. *(~2s, practice room, handheld, energetic)* She's mid-movement rehearsing choreography, camera catching quick glimpses of the mirror wall. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, practice room, propped camera, water break)* She wipes sweat, drinks water, breathless but smiling. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, backstage, handheld, quick transition)* Hair and makeup blur past in quick cuts, staff moving around her, adrenaline building. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, stage, wide-to-close, high energy finish)* Bright stage lights, her silhouette stepping out as the camera catches a final glimpse before cutting to black. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."

author: johnAGI168
title: Wuxia Inn Dumpling Duel
prompt:
【风格】武侠电影级动作喜剧（Wuxia Action Comedy），古风客栈实景，8K，达芬奇高级调色，升格慢动作与快剪结合，真实布料与木屑物理，横屏16:9
【时长】30秒
【场景】古风江湖客栈大堂，木桌长凳、红灯笼、蒸笼冒热气，梁柱交错，光从窗棂斜射带浮尘
【角色】女侠A @图1（红衣冷艳，用剑）、女侠B @图2（青衣飒爽，用双筷/软鞭），两人武艺相当

[00:00-00:02] 钩子·同时出手
蒸笼掀开——热气散去，只剩孤零零一个白胖包子。两只手"唰"地同时探向它，在包子上方一寸僵住。镜头拉近两人对视，杀气骤起。
音效：蒸汽"嘶"声，一声兵刃出鞘。

[00:02-00:06] 拔剑·桌面开打
A拔剑挑翻整张桌子腾空，B踩着飞起的长凳跃上房梁，包子被气浪震到空中。碗筷茶壶四散飞溅。

[00:06-00:11] 空中争夺（升格）
包子在半空划弧，两人凌空交手，A剑尖挑、B筷子夹，包子在刀光间被抢来抢去，谁也没碰实，热气还在包子上冒。

[00:11-00:16] 客栈大乱
战场蔓延，两人踩桌翻梁、灯笼被削落、木屑纷飞，其他"食客"抱头躲桌下。包子始终在两人争夺中心悬着不落。

[00:16-00:21] 决胜一击（升格特写）
A与B同时使出绝招，剑气与鞭影在包子两侧交汇——包子被劲气托着高高弹起，两人各自摆出接杀造型，屏息等它落下。

[00:21-00:26] 神反转
镜头跟着下落的包子——一只慵懒的橘猫"喵"地从桌上跃起，在半空一口叼住包子，稳稳落地，当着两人的面吧唧吧唧吃完，舔爪。
音效：所有打斗音效戛然而止，一声"喵~"，乌鸦飞过。

[00:26-00:30] 傻眼收尾（定格）
A和B保持着帅气的接杀姿势僵在原地，剑和筷子还举着，齐刷刷看向吃饱打嗝的猫，表情裂开。
字幕（砸出）：「有些仗，打赢了也没用。」
音效：一记喜剧"咚"，猫满足地打了个嗝。

【导演备注】1.反差铁律：打斗越是天崩地裂、招式越华丽正经，最后被猫截胡的落差越好笑；2.身份锁定：A=@图1红衣用剑、B=@图2青衣用筷/鞭，脸/服装全程一致；3.节奏：2秒对峙→拔剑→空中争夺→大乱→决胜→猫反转，动作段用快剪+关键处升格；4.物理真实：包子热气、木屑、灯笼、布料惯性、猫的重量都要真实，武侠不卡通；5.包子必须全程在画面中心被争夺，是视觉焦点和笑点核心；6.不见血、不伤人，纯招式对拆。
【负面提示词】卡通武侠，塑料CG，换脸，两人身份/武器混淆，包子中途消失，猫出现得太早，血腥伤人，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面糊乱，未成年人形象。

author: jAlpha_create
title: Watercolor Aquarium Octopus Journey
prompt:
【使用プロンプト】
モード：画像動画変換／30秒・16:9・音声ON

参照画像の絵柄・線の細さ・彩色・通路と水槽の配置を厳密に保つ。人物は登場させない。
細い手描きのペン線、水彩の滲みを残した淡い彩色。深いパウダーブルーの光。カット無しの30秒ワンショット。
タコは赤橙色で大きな目。水槽の幅の半分ほどの胴体を最後まで保つ。猫は茶トラでタコより小さい。水は水槽の中のまま、床は乾いている。
カメラ：タコの移動に合わせて右へゆっくりトラッキング。

0-4秒 タコが水槽から流れ落ち床に着地。奥から猫が歩いてくる。
4-9秒 タコがモップに巻きついて化ける。猫が通過。目だけが猫を追う。
9-13秒 猫が去る。タコがほどけて床を滑って進む。
13-19秒 ぬいぐるみ棚に飛び込んで固まる。猫が首をかしげて見る。微動だにしない。
19-23秒 棚から降りて廊下の角を曲がる。
23-27秒 隣のタコ水槽をよじ登って中へ滑り込む。
27-30秒 先住のタコと並んで腕をからめる。会いに来ただけ。止め絵。

音：ピチカート弦の忍び足コメディ曲。化けた瞬間は無音、猫が去るとBGM再開。

author: patrickassale
title: Three A.M. French Nightlife POV
prompt:
A 30 second ultra realistic handheld POV video set in France at around 3 am, outside a busy bar and nightlife street. The camera is the point of view of a young woman filming one handed on an iPhone. We never see the phone itself at any point. The footage must feel like raw, authentic amateur nightlife footage with natural iPhone aesthetics.

It is very late. People are leaving bars, smoking outside, waiting for Ubers, talking too loudly, eating kebabs, laughing in tired, sloppy groups. The mood in the street is a mix of drunken energy and visible exhaustion. Faces look tired, makeup is slightly worn, outfits are a bit messy after a long night. The pavement is slightly wet and reflects neon signs, headlights, and warm bar lights. The air feels cold and heavy. The whole scene must feel intensely real, socially awkward, and uncomfortable.

The camera operator is a woman, and her friend is another young woman walking a few steps ahead of her, visibly angry. The camera follows her in a shaky, one-handed handheld way. The tension is already there from the first second. The argument is about the friend disappearing with a guy inside the bar and leaving the camera operator alone for nearly an hour, which made her miss the last train and feel abandoned. This is the core of the argument.

The friend suddenly turns around while still walking and says in natural French from France:

“Tu vas me suivre encore longtemps comme ça ?”

The woman behind the camera replies, irritated and hurt:

“Bah ouais, parce que tu m’as laissée toute seule comme une conne pendant une heure.”

The friend rolls her eyes, tired and defensive:

“Oh ça va, j’étais pas ‘avec un mec’, on parlait, c’est bon.”

The camera gets a little closer as the woman filming answers immediately:

“Mais arrête, tu m’as complètement lâchée. J’te cherchais partout.”

The friend stops walking and turns fully toward the camera now, angry but exhausted:

“J’allais pas te tenir la main toute la soirée non plus.”

A few people nearby start glancing at them. Someone exits a bar laughing, a smoker looks over, a taxi passes in the background. The world keeps moving around them, but the argument becomes the emotional center of the scene.

The woman filming replies, more intense now:

“C’est pas ça le problème, le problème c’est que t’as disparu sans rien dire. J’ai raté le dernier train à cause de toi.”

The friend laughs bitterly in disbelief:

“À cause de moi ? Sérieux ? T’es incapable de te débrouiller toute seule ?”

The camera jolts slightly from the emotional reaction. The breathing of the woman filming becomes more noticeable. Her voice gets sharper:

“Mais t’abuses en fait. Tu fais toujours ça. Tu penses qu’à toi.”

The friend steps closer, now visibly losing patience:

“Et toi tu fais quoi là ? Tu me filmes en pleine rue comme une malade.”

The woman behind the camera replies immediately:

“Parce que tu racontes n’importe quoi !”

The friend reaches toward the camera, not to grab a visible phone, but clearly trying to push it away from her face. The image jerks sideways hard from the contact.

“Enlève ça de ma tête !”

The camera operator snaps back:

“Me touche pas !”

Now the tension breaks completely. The friend, furious and emotionally overwhelmed, shouts:

“Mais ferme-la un peu !”

The woman filming fires back:

“Sinon quoi ?!”

There is a half-second pause. Heavy breathing. Eye contact directly into the lens. Then the friend lunges.

She pushes into the camera operator. The footage becomes chaotic and violent, shaking hard as the woman filming loses balance. She lets out a shocked cry:

“Putain !”

The camera stumbles backward and drops toward the ground. As it falls, we catch blurred fragments: legs, jackets, streetlights, pavement, people turning around, someone shouting:

“Eh oh ! Ça va pas ou quoi ?!”

The friend jumps onto her as both fall out of balance. The camera lands badly on the ground, still recording for a split second, partly blocked by clothing or the ground. We hear struggling, overlapping voices, panic, and nearby people reacting. Then the video abruptly cuts.

The entire performance must feel spontaneous, messy, and completely believable. Natural interruptions, overlapping dialogue, breath, hesitation, frustration, and tiny realistic body movements are essential. The acting must feel like a real late night argument between two exhausted friends, not a scripted drama. No cinematic polish, no stylized fight choreography, no slow motion, no music, no visible phone, no artificial lighting setup, and no glamorous performance. It must feel like a real one handed iPhone recording captured in the heat of the moment.

author: yachimat_manga
title: Dark-Fantasy Anime Flythrough Opening

author: buraktuyan
title: Turkish Eggs Mini-DV Recipe Vlog
prompt:
Create a 30-second home-video recipe vlog showing a young woman from London in her mid-20s making Turkish eggs in her small, sunlit kitchen. She wears relaxed home clothes, has her hair loosely tied back, and films everything herself with a consumer mini-DV camcorder. Some shots are handheld; others are recorded after she props the camera on the counter. Keep the footage candid and imperfect: gentle camera shake, occasional focus hunting, slightly awkward framing, natural zoom adjustments, subtle grain, mild motion blur, and automatic exposure changes caused by the bright morning light.

Follow this exact sequence:

0–3s: In a propped medium shot, she places a bowl on the counter, looks toward the camera, and says quietly, “Let’s make Turkish eggs.”

3–6s: Overhead close-up as she combines thick yoghurt, finely grated garlic, and a pinch of salt, stirring until smooth. Clearly hear the spoon moving around the bowl.

6–9s: Handheld detail shot as she spoons the garlic yoghurt onto a shallow plate and spreads it into soft, imperfect swirls.

9–12s: Close-up beside a saucepan of gently simmering water. She cracks an egg into a small bowl and says, “Keep the water gentle.”

12–15s: Overhead shot as she carefully slides the egg into the water. The white naturally curls around the yolk; the water never boils aggressively.

15–18s: Macro-style detail of butter melting in a small pan. She adds pul biber, creating a vivid orange-red mixture that blooms and audibly sizzles. No dialogue.

18–21s: Handheld close-up as she removes two softly poached eggs, lets them drain briefly, and places them over the garlic yoghurt.

21–24s: Extreme close-up as she pours the sizzling pul-biber butter across the eggs, creating rich red-orange streaks over the white yoghurt.

24–27s: Warm, propped shot. She adds fresh dill, tears off a piece of crusty bread, and breaks open one egg, revealing the flowing golden yolk. She says, “Look at that.”

27–30s: Handheld finishing shot. She scoops up yoghurt, egg, and chilli butter with the bread, takes a bite, smiles genuinely, and says, “Best breakfast.” She then reaches forward and covers the lens.

Prioritise intimate food sounds: yoghurt stirring, garlic scraping, simmering water, egg cracking, butter sizzling, ceramic clinks, and bread tearing. Dialogue should sound quiet and casually captured through the camcorder microphone. Preserve realistic imperfections such as irregular poached-egg whites, small splashes, messy spoon marks, brief pauses, natural blinking, and exposure shifts. It must look like a genuine personal breakfast vlog.

author: AiMeowing
title: Children and Dragons Picnic Chaos
prompt:
Lock the original artwork completely. Preserve the exact illustration style, brushwork, textures, materials, color palette, lighting, creature proportions, facial expressions, environment, and character designs. Never change the art style or introduce new designs. Keep every dragon and child identical throughout. No text or watermark. One continuous forward-moving story. Begin with motion from frame one. Use cinematic hard cuts, speed ramps, whip pans, dynamic tracking, FPV fly-throughs, overhead drone shots, bullet time where appropriate, volumetric clouds, realistic fire physics, motion blur, depth of field, subtle film grain, debris, feathers, sparks, smoke, expressive facial animation, and seamless transitions.

0-2s

Cold open. The children happily eat while the giant dragon lazily sniffs the food. The baby dragons taste tiny bites, instantly make disgusted faces, stare at each other, then suddenly leap onto the table together. Fast push-in, comedic bass hit.

2-4s

4-6s

title: Obsidian Giant Transformation
prompt:
Multi-shot 30-second cinematic sequence, hard cuts as marked.
Photorealistic 8K, ARRI Alexa large-format character, prime lenses, 35mm
grain, professional grade, 180° shutter motion blur, IMAX-scale VFX.
THE WOMAN: late 20s, long dark hair, deep red silk evening dress,
barefoot. Calm, unafraid.
THE CREATURE (original design): SHE IS THE CREATURE. Not a separate
being. Her own body grows and armors. Obsidian-black interlocking plates
sheathing her limbs and torso, molten orange fissures glowing between
every plate, elongated arms, a crown of jagged back-swept horns, amber
eyes. Human posture and proportions kept, scaled to 90 metres.
TRANSFORMATION PHASES, in strict order:
P1 hairline fractures of orange light open across her skin.
P2 the fissures widen, embers pour upward off her shoulders.
P3 obsidian plates surface through her skin and lock into place, dress
burning away into ash.
P4 she grows upward and outward from her own standing body, feet planted,
weight driving into the ground, horns pushing through last.
LOCATION: dense modern city, wide granite plaza, glass towers all sides,
dusk, empty streets, abandoned cars, streetlights flickering on.
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% cool blue-grey dusk glass and stone / 30% deep
shadow / 10% molten orange fissures and embers.
0–4s | SHOT 1 | 24mm wide, low ground-level, slow dolly in. She stands
alone centre-plaza, wind moving her hair and dress. City silent.
CUT.
4–7s | SHOT 2 | 100mm macro insert. Her hand and collarbone. First
hairline cracks of orange light spread across the skin (P1). No movement
otherwise.
CUT.
7–10s | SHOT 3 | 40mm, low behind her, slight dutch. Fissures widen,
embers stream upward off her shoulders (P2), granite fracturing in a ring
around her bare feet.
CUT.
10–17s | SHOT 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm, locked on her
face at eye level, camera craning upward at exactly her rate of growth so
her face stays centre-frame the entire time. Obsidian plates surface and
lock across her face and shoulders (P3), amber ignites in her eyes, horns
push back through her hair (P4). Her feet never leave the ground. The
camera never loses her face.
CUT.
17–21s | SHOT 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, camera on the street between abandoned
cars. Her colossal foot plants, buckling the road, cars flipping in the
shockwave. Scale reveal.
CUT.
21–25s | SHOT 6 | 50mm aerial, slow helicopter orbit. Full colossus
against the skyline, embers and dust swirling, molten light pulsing in her
plating.
CUT.
25–28s | SHOT 7 | 85mm, camera mounted on a glass tower facing her. Her
arm swings through the facade, curtain wall shearing away in slabs,
camera whip-panning down with the falling glass.
CUT.
28–30s | SHOT 8 | 24mm aerial, rising crane pull-back. She stands amid the
broken skyline, dust rolling outward, molten fissures pulsing.
PHYSICS: her mass increases continuously, granite fracturing radially from
her feet; steel groans and buckles before it fails; glass falls as sheets
that shatter on impact; concrete shears in slabs, not crumbs; dust rolls
in heavy waves; embers ride heat currents upward.
AUDIO: wind and low city hum, a deep bone-crack as the fissures open, a
sustained rising roar through the growth, groaning steel, sheeting glass,
thunderous impacts, settling dust.
HARD LOCKS: the creature is the transformed woman, one continuous being.
Nothing emerges from the ground. No second creature. She never levitates,
floats, or leaves the ground at any moment. Feet planted throughout the
transformation. She never vanishes from frame between shots. No people
visible anywhere.
FORBIDDEN: no levitation, no separate monster, no ground emergence, no
gore or flesh tearing, no franchise creatures, no design drift, no
subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos.

Nostalgic, determined montage feel — younger, rawer energy than her current polished vlogs, evoking a flashback to trainee days. author: Runaway_Rhino
title: Devastated City Continuous Escape
prompt:
Photorealistic 30-second continuous one-shot: no cuts, hidden edits, dissolves or teleportation — every apparent shot change is one unbroken physical camera move around the same man.
A bruised, exhausted man in his early 30s - dirty dark wool coat, torn shirt, muddy trousers - sprints through a devastated European city at cold dawn: wet asphalt, smoke, drifting ash, distant fires, ruined architecture. Keep his face, clothes, injuries and body identical throughout. Dead-serious acting: ragged breathing, fear, slipping boots, pumping arms. He ignores the surreal chaos, fixed on something ahead.
[0s] The camera holds at puddle level beside his boots hammering through black rainwater, spray striking the lens. As he blasts past, it starts a half-beat late, pulling back and rising into a tight frontal track at chest height, his eyes just above center. Behind him civilians flee through smoke; a cathedral-sized shadow moves beneath the street.
[4s] A seam of light splits the buildings on his left. The camera eases around his left shoulder in one slow 90° arc, falling rubble crossing the near plane, landing on his clean left profile. Buildings unzip vertically like fabric, revealing a turbulent ocean suspended behind them; a colossal whale swims between rooftops while cars and rubble fall upward into the clouds. He stays in normal gravity.
[9s] The air ahead fills with suspended glass shards, each showing a different version of the same street: burning, flooded, frozen, abandoned. The camera drops to hip height beside him in a low side track; shards streak past the lens.
[12s] A city bus crashes behind him and bursts into thousands of black birds instead of debris. The flock sweeps across the lens; when it clears the camera is behind him, one continuous move.
[14s] The camera settles into a wide rear track. The street ahead bends upward like a strip of film until buildings stand vertically above the horizon; people, bicycles and wreckage slide across walls; giant concrete hands push through the asphalt on both sides. He leaps a widening fracture, landing with full physical weight. The camera lags half a beat on the jump, then closes back in.
[20s] The sun splits open like a mechanical iris, revealing stars, eclipses and turning planets. The light draws the camera up in one weighted crane arc, rising past his shoulder to a brief top-down beat over him. Flaming debris falls; soldiers run across the sky as if it were solid ground; a train passes vertically between towers.
[23s] The crane carries its momentum down ahead of him, slowing into a tight frontal close-up, his eyes just above center against the burning sky, embers streaking between lens and face. Keep him sharply readable, emotionally central.
[25s] He reaches a small untouched dining table in the middle of the ruined street; a girl of about eight sits calmly beside a tiny birthday cake, one candle burning. He slides to his knees, catches himself against the table, looks into her eyes; terror becomes relief. The camera decelerates with him, easing wider and sinking to table height, nearly stopping for the first time - a faint breath of motion - landing on a two-shot, candle between them.
[28s] Together they blow out the candle. The instant the flame dies, all destruction and cosmic events freeze, then transform seamlessly into the same street on a quiet ordinary morning: intact buildings, soft sunlight, distant birds, no other people, their exact poses preserved. The camera holds; an almost imperceptible push settles on the thin candle smoke rising between them.

Cold blue-grey dawn dominates, dirty amber firelight secondary; the candle is the only warm accent. Volumetric smoke, wet surfaces, pore-level skin, sweat, mud, blood, visible breath, real contact shadows.

When the candle dies, all catastrophic sound stops instantly: one exhale, morning birds, a faint ceramic rattle.
CAMERA: one unbroken physical path, a weighted rig with real mass - every move triggered by the scene, easing in and out, landing on a held composition. author: aimikoda
title: The Elven Princess Greets the Orcs
prompt:
16:9, 30-second photoreal live-action fantasy battle in clear daylight, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, natural textures, clean HDR contrast, one wide lens and one uninterrupted controlled handheld pursuit shot.

The elf princess is tall and slender, with fair freckled skin, blue-gray eyes, long wavy platinum-blonde hair, pointed ears, a silver branch circlet, and a flowing silver battle gown with a scale-textured mantle. Keep one identical princess throughout. She holds one silver longsword in her right hand.

Exactly 36 distinct armored green-skinned orcs enter over time, each with a different weapon, helmet, armor, or silhouette; orc 36 is a heavy captain with a cleaver. Never reuse an orc. Every stroke hits exactly one target. Show 36 separate contacts, green-fluid releases, and individual defeats. No multi-target cut; shockwaves move dust only. Each next orc actively attacks, guards, evades, or intercepts.

Rotate Zornhau, Zwerchhau, Unterhau, Krumphau, Scheitelhau, straight thrust, moulinet reverse cut, draw cut, and pivoting back cut without adjacent repetition. Every relocation uses this rhythm: clean micro-anticipation; a white-silver flash fully hides the princess and she vanishes; the camera continues its normal physical follow with the environment visible; a second local flash reveals her beside the next target in a fully formed attack pose. Show no transit body movement and no whip pan.

The camera stays close, following with smooth handheld sidesteps, retreats, arcs, drops, rises, and pivots. It travels toward each flash destination without snapping, resetting, teleporting, or hiding a cut. Keep princess, orcs, background, debris, hair, cloth, fluid, and particles sharply resolved. No motion blur anywhere.

SEQUENCE: ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT

Beat 1 / 0-3s: Rear 3/4 WS, follow behind the princess into a sunlit battle already in progress. The orcs occupy successive depth pockets, not one flat crowd; only nearby attackers are readable. Orc 1 charges while she forms the opening anticipation pose.

Beat 2 / 3-10s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 1-9. Follow attacks from alternating sides with physical sidesteps and arcs. Perform nine fast but separate vanish, follow, reappear, single-target cycles using different techniques. Preserve each crisp contact, green-fluid release, recoil, and fall before the next attack. End with nine defeated as orc 10 attacks from behind.

Beat 3 / 10-17s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 10-18. Pivot around the princess to catch the rear attack, move ahead, backpedal while leading, then arc around as threats enter from different directions. Show nine more individual attacks and one-orc cuts in a changed order. She appears only in sharp anticipation, contact, and finishing poses. End with eighteen defeated and orc 19 intercepting.

Beat 4 / 17-24s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 19-27. Drop beside timber, rise around a shield, pass behind an axe raider, then turn toward an attacker descending from rubble. Increase tempo across nine distinct parries, evasions, lunges, guards, and single-target finishes. Each relocation uses two local flashes with continuous environment between them. End with twenty-seven defeated as the final nine surround her.

Beat 5 / 24-30s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 28-36. Enter a tight controlled pursuit orbit, changing proximity and height along one physical path. Orcs 28-35 each receive a separate technique, contact, green-fluid release, and fall. The captain attacks last; sidestep his cleaver as one flash hides the princess and the next reveals her beyond him in a sharp Scheitelhau finish. His delayed impact affects only him. End with all 36 individually defeated.

SOUND: No dialogue or subtitles. Daylight battle ambience, sword transients, 36 distinct contact accents, individual orc reactions, dry flash cracks, and accelerating percussion.

VFX: Local white-silver flashes cover only the princess during vanish and reveal. Green fluid begins only at sword contact. Render every effect with crisp edges and zero motion blur.

EXCLUDE: Motion blur anywhere, whip pans, cuts, hidden cuts, lens changes, camera resets or teleports, visible transit, morphing, stretched limbs, extra or smeared anatomy, duplicates, multi-target strikes, low resolution, soft focus, haze, grain, compression artifacts, and night lighting.

author: doctorwasif
title: DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding
prompt:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Slow, gentle montage feel — calmer and more tender than her usual bubbly vlogs. Quiet reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood stays soft and caring throughout, centered on rest and self-care.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long straight black hair, natural and softly tied back, dewy glass skin, minimal to no makeup, tired but peaceful expression. Wearing a modest robe or oversized loungewear throughout — fully covering arms, torso, and legs at all times, including during the bath/shower segment (framed only from shoulders up or via steam/robe coverage, nothing revealing shown).
Setting Progression
Physio/massage clinic (afternoon) → her room, stretching mat (early evening) → bathroom, steamy warm light (night) → bedroom (late night).
Storyboard (20s, 6 cuts)
(~3.5s, physio clinic, propped camera, medium shot) She lies on a treatment table as a therapist's hands (off-camera) work on her shoulder, wincing slightly then relaxing. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some days, taking care of myself has to come first."

author: LudovicCreator
title: Lightning Sorceress Transformation
prompt:
[GOAL]
Generate a 30-second transformation sequence. The core subject is <FIGURE>, a human form kept as a near-total silhouette from the first frame to the last. The main event is <FIGURE> walking out of a dark storm void and assuming a fully formed sorcerer aspect, with the silhouette never breaking.

[STAGE ONE]
Opens with:   a black void of low fog. Forked white lightning crawls horizontally on both sides of frame. <FIGURE> is a small distant shape walking straight toward camera.
Main event:   <FIGURE> closes the distance in an unbroken push; the hair catches light first and begins to burn as iridescent plasma in pink, mint and violet.
Ends with:    a chest-up frame of <FIGURE>, face entirely black, plasma hair fully lit, eyes not yet open.

[STAGE TWO]
Carried over: the same void, the same fog level, the same plasma hair colours, the same total silhouette on the face and body.
Main event:   two narrow white slits ignite where the eyes are and resolve into detailed glowing irises. Armour assembles onto the silhouette from the shoulders down — a high sculpted collar, layered pauldrons, and three crescent marks lit on the chest.
Ends with:    <FIGURE> standing full-length in centre frame, armour complete, one hand open at the side.

[STAGE THREE]
Main event:   <FIGURE> raises the open hand and lightning bends into the palm, twisting into a rigid staff of light; a circular sigil ignites on the ground underfoot; <FIGURE> spreads both arms and releases a radial burst.
Ends with:    the burst at full extension, <FIGURE> centred and still a silhouette, the sigil still lit.

[KEEP CONSISTENT]
Keep the face in full silhouette in every frame — never light the features. Keep the plasma hair colour order, the collar and pauldron shapes and the crescent marks stable once formed. Keep the camera axis frontal throughout; do not orbit.

The image is near-black high-key-on-black: teal and cold white lightning as the only key light, deep haze, no fill, crushed blacks with the subject read purely as edge and rim. Anamorphic flare on each strike.

The camera holds frontal and pushes in step by step across the three stages, from an extreme wide to a face close-up and back out to a full-length wide, cutting only on lightning strikes.

Sound includes low sub-bass pressure that rises across the whole clip, sharp thunder cracks synchronised to each visual strike, an electrical crackle that tightens as the hair ignites, a single ringing tone when the sigil lights, and no dialogue.

author: sailorv321
title: （元はThreadsのdopamin.wxyさんを参考にしています）
prompt:
（元はThreadsのdopamin.wxyさんを参考にしています）

【Seedance 2.5／15秒／9:16】

参照画像を唯一のキャラクター参照として使用する。15秒、9:16縦型、ワンカット、固定カメラ。開始から終了までカメラは完全固定。ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、手持ち、カット、トランジション、リフレーム、スロー、静止演出は禁止。

【構図・立ち位置】

画面左側45％に実写のBBQグリルと骨付き肉を配置する。画面右側30％に2Dキャラクターを配置する。中央にはトングと肉を移動させるための空間を20％程度確保する。

キャラクターは右側の砂浜に立ち、頭から黒いビーチサンダルまで全身を常に表示する。キャラクターをグリルの前、グリル脚の上、テーブルの上には置かない。キャラクターとグリルの間には明確な空間を残し、開始から終了まで立ち位置を維持する。

グリル、肉、人の手、トング、コチュジャンボトルをキャラクターの身体と重ねない。キャラクターが肉やグリルを隠さない。人の手やトングがキャラクターの顔や身体を不自然に横切らない。物体同士の奥行きと前後関係を正確に維持する。

【映像スタイル】

真夏の美しい海辺で行われる実写BBQ映像と、平面2Dアニメーションステッカーキャラクターを組み合わせたコミカルな映像。

青い海、白い波、明るい青空、黄金色の砂浜、遠景の海岸線、風に揺れるヤシの葉を描く。明るい昼の自然光。海風によってヤシの葉、グリルの煙、キャラクターの白いシャツの裾が自然に揺れる。

背景、海、砂、グリル、炭火、煙、炎、骨付き肉、脂、肉汁、コチュジャン、ボトル、人の手、金属トングはすべて高品質な実写表現。白飛び、過度なブルーム、霞、露出のちらつきは禁止。

キャラクターだけは最後まで平面2Dアニメーションステッカーとして維持する。実写化、半実写化、3D化、CGフィギュア化、ゲームモデル化、Pixar風、クレイアニメ風は禁止。鮮明な線画、セル塗り、平面的な陰影、細い白フチを維持する。

【キャラクター固定】

参照画像の男性キャラクターをそのまま使用する。柔らかなアッシュシルバーのウェーブヘア、前髪の形、髪の長さと毛量、灰青色の瞳、若く整った顔、細身で長い手足の体型を固定する。

白いノースリーブインナー、透け感のある白い半袖オープンシャツ、白いドローコード、黒いペイズリー柄ショートパンツ、黒いビーチサンダル、シルバーネックレス、ピアス、ブレスレット、リングを固定する。

顔、髪型、体型、衣装、柄、色、靴、アクセサリーを変更しない。帽子、サングラス、エプロン、手袋、新しい小物を追加しない。キャラクターを複製しない。別の2Dキャラクターを追加しない。

キャラクターは冷たい無表情ではなく、非常に可愛く表情豊かに動く。大きく輝く目、頬の赤み、嬉しそうな笑顔、首を傾げる仕草、肩を小さく揺らす動き、頬を膨らませた拗ね顔、涙目、慌てて手を振る動きを明確に見せる。棒立ち禁止。

【BBQと骨付き肉】

画面左側の実写BBQグリルで、大きな骨付きトマホークステーキを焼く。長い骨が肉に物理的につながったまま明確に見える。肉は十分に焼けており、濃い焼き目、香ばしい焦げ目、艶のある肉汁、溶けた脂、軽い湯気を描く。

肉を生肉、黒焦げ、骨なし肉、変形した肉にしない。肉や骨を複製しない。骨を途中で消さない。

実写の成人女性の手が画面左端から入る。ピンク色のネイルアート、細いシルバーリング、正常な5本指を維持する。金属製BBQトングで肉を返し、持ち上げる。手、指、リング、トング、肉、グリルを融合させない。

【コチュジャン】

ラベル、文字、ブランドロゴのない透明なスクイーズボトルを使用する。中身は濃厚で艶のある深い赤茶色のコチュジャン。ケチャップのような明るい赤色や水っぽい液体にはしない。

コチュジャンはボトルのノズルから太く連続して流れ、肉の表面に直接落ちる。ソースを空中から突然出現させない。ボトルの底や側面から漏らさない。

【00:00–00:03】

固定されたワイド構図で開始する。左側では骨付きトマホークステーキが大きな音を立てて焼けている。女性の実写の手が金属トングで肉を一度ゆっくり返す。脂が炭に落ち、小さな炎が一瞬だけ上がる。薄い煙が海風に流れる。

右側の2Dキャラクターは肉を見つめ、目を大きくキラキラ輝かせる。両手を顎の下で合わせ、肩を上げ、膝を少し曲げて小さく2回弾む。口元に小さな2Dのよだれが一滴だけ現れて消える。

【00:03–00:05】

キャラクターがコチュジャンボトルを見つける。目を輝かせ、首を傾げ、片手でボトルを指さす。嬉しそうにボトルを両手で持ち、胸の前で一瞬だけ抱き締める。

その後、片目を閉じたイタズラっぽい笑顔になり、ノズルを左側の肉へ向ける。キャラクター自身は右側の立ち位置から移動しない。

【00:05–00:07】

キャラクターがボトルを強く絞り、骨付き肉の上へコチュジャンを大量にかける。濃い赤茶色の太いソースがノズルから肉まで連続して伸び、肉の表面に大量のジグザグ模様を作る。

ソースは熱で軽く泡立ち、肉汁と混ざって艶を出す。肉全体を完全に隠さず、骨と焼き目は見える状態を維持する。

キャラクターは得意げに笑い、舌先を少し出し、肩を可愛く左右に揺らしながらボトルを絞る。女性の手はトングを持ったまま驚いて止まる。

【00:07–00:09】

女性の手がトングでコチュジャンボトルを素早く取り上げ、左側へ戻す。その直後、閉じたトングの先端でキャラクターの頭頂部を軽く一度だけ「こん！」と叩く。

トングの先端がキャラクターの髪へ明確に軽く接触する。接触と同時に、頭の上へ小さな黄色い2Dの星形衝撃エフェクトを出す。強く殴らない。痛々しくしない。完全に可愛いカートゥーン式のツッコミにする。

叩かれた瞬間、キャラクターの頭が右へ傾き、銀髪が弾み、肩と胴体が左、右へ大きく揺れる。膝が曲がり、両腕を広げてバランスを取る。足は砂浜から離れず、グリル側へ移動しない。

頬を膨らませ、目をぎゅっと閉じ、小さな涙を一滴だけ出す。頭だけではなく、全身が可愛く揺れる動きを約1秒間はっきり見せる。

【00:09–00:11】

女性の手がトングをグリルへ戻し、コチュジャンの付いた焼き肉を一口サイズに持ち上げる。持ち上げた肉には焼き目、肉汁、繊維、濃いコチュジャンが見える。

トングは中央の空間を通り、肉をキャラクターの口の前まで運ぶ。キャラクターは頭を叩かれたことに拗ね、腕を組んで顔を横へ向け、頬を膨らませる。

すぐに目だけで肉をちらっと見る。目が再び輝き、腕をほどき、両手を背中へ回し、上半身を少し前へ傾ける。口を大きく開け、肉へ近づく。

【00:11–00:12】

キャラクターが肉を明確に一口食べる。開いた口をトングで持った肉へ近づけ、肉を口で挟み、頭を後ろへ引いて一口分を噛み取る。

トングに残った肉には、はっきりした一口分の欠けた跡を残す。肉を見るだけ、匂いを嗅ぐだけ、舐めるだけは禁止。

キャラクターは2回はっきり噛む。頬を少し膨らませ、最初は非常に幸せそうな表情になる。目を閉じ、両手を頬へ当て、片足のかかとを上げて嬉しそうに小さく揺れる。

【00:12–00:13.2】

突然、激辛に気づく。噛む動きを止め、目を大きな丸に見開き、瞳孔を小さくする。顔全体が頬から額まで急速に赤くなる。頭の周囲に小さな汗マークを複数出す。

両手で口元を高速にあおぎ、左右の足を交互に小さく上げて慌てる。膝、肩、胴体を細かく震わせ、両目に大きな可愛い涙をためる。右側の立ち位置から出ない。

【00:13.2–00:14.4】

キャラクターが上半身を少し前へ倒し、口を大きく開ける。口の中から、明確な平面2Dコミック炎を一度だけ勢いよく吹き出す。

炎はキャラクターの口から始まり、画面右上の何もない空間へ向かう。炎をグリル、肉、人の手、トング、ボトルへ向けない。

炎は黄色い中心、オレンジ色の本体、赤い輪郭を持つ平面2Dイラスト。炎の中に小さな赤唐辛子マークを数個混ぜる。実写の危険な炎にはしない。物を燃やさない。爆発させない。

キャラクターは涙を流しながら両腕を慌てて振り、炎の反動で上半身だけ少し後ろへ揺れる。足は砂浜の同じ位置を維持する。

【00:14.4–00:15】

2Dの炎が小さく縮み、可愛い白い煙の「ぷすっ」という一粒のエフェクトに変わる。

キャラクターは最後に全身を一度だけ左右へふらつかせる。膝が震え、肩が落ち、髪が一度弾む。両手で口を押さえ、真っ赤な頬、涙目、腫れたような小さな唇、恥ずかしそうな表情になる。

頭の上を小さな赤唐辛子アイコンが回転する。女性の手は左側で、一口分が欠けた肉をトングで持ったまま困惑して停止する。

キャラクター全身は右側、グリルと肉は左側に明確に分離した状態で終了する。フェードアウト禁止。タイトル表示禁止。

【音】

海の波音、海風、ヤシの葉の揺れる音、遠くの鳥の声、炭火の音、肉の強い焼ける音、脂が落ちる小さな炎の音、コチュジャンを絞る音、軽いコミカル音、頭を叩く明確な「こん！」という音、全身が揺れる弾む音、一口噛む音、2回の咀嚼音、激辛に気づく上昇音、可愛いコミック炎の「ボワッ」という音、最後の小さな「ぷすっ」という煙の音。

明るく可愛いテンポのBGMを小さく流す。台詞、ナレーション、歌声、字幕、テロップ、歌詞、画面内文字は禁止。

【禁止事項】

キャラクターとグリルの重なり禁止。キャラクターをグリル脚の上へ立たせない。肉をキャラクターで隠さない。人の手やボトルでキャラクターを隠さない。トングをキャラクターの身体へ貫通させない。前後関係の崩壊禁止。

頭を叩く動作の省略禁止。全身が揺れる動作の省略禁止。一口食べる動作の省略禁止。肉の一口跡の省略禁止。咀嚼の省略禁止。激辛リアクションの省略禁止。口から炎を吹く動作の省略禁止。

カメラ移動禁止。カット禁止。画面転換禁止。スロー禁止。静止画化禁止。キャラクターの棒立ち禁止。キャラクター複製禁止。顔変化禁止。髪型変化禁止。衣装変化禁止。足の消失禁止。全身のクロップ禁止。実写化禁止。3D化禁止。

手の変形、指の増減、トングとの融合、物体の浮遊、ボトルの消失、ソースの空中発生、ケチャップ化、生肉化、骨なし肉化、骨の分離、肉の複製、危険な実写炎、火傷、爆発、ブランド、ロゴ、字幕、白飛び、ちらつきを禁止する。

author: LudovicCreator
title: Red Hooded Mech Soldier In Desert Ruins
prompt:
@image1 supplies <SOLDIER>'s armour design, colour breakdown and silhouette: chipped bone-white and gunmetal plating, a heavy respirator faceplate with a single narrow red visor slit, and a sun-bleached crimson hood and cape frayed at the hem. Do not take the background of the reference; do not take any pose from it.

<SOLDIER> walks alone through a bombed-out mud-brick settlement at the flat hour before noon, crossing open sand, passing between collapsed walls, and continuing down the main street without stopping.

The image is anamorphic live-action science fiction: heavy suspended dust, ochre and bleached-bone grade, hard overhead sun with deep contact shadows, sand grain caught in the armour joints, real cloth weight in the cape, and a shallow depth of field that keeps the ruins soft.

The camera works in five moves. It opens at ground level behind <SOLDIER>'s boots as sand collapses under each step and the cape drags through frame. It cuts to a slow push-in on the faceplate, the red visor the only saturated colour in the frame. It tracks laterally past a broken wall so the wall wipes the lens. It follows over the shoulder down the ruined street with the horizon shimmering. It ends on a locked-off wide, <SOLDIER> a black silhouette walking into a blown-out sun at the end of the street.

Keep the armour damage pattern, hood shape, cape length and the position of the visor slit identical in every shot. Keep one figure in frame at all times.

Sound includes wind across open sand, grit under armoured boots, servo movement in the joints, the low filtered rasp of breathing through the respirator, distant loose metal, and a single sustained low drone with no melody.

author: tanabe_fragm
title: Cinematic Story Study 915882
prompt:
Duration: 10s | 9:16 | 24fps

[SUMMARY]
Five beautiful women in five countries greet the viewer on the same morning.
Each looks into the camera at selfie distance, says good morning in her native
language, then covers the lens with her palm — and the next country appears as
it pulls away.

[GLOBAL SETTINGS]
Early morning everywhere, soft low natural sunlight, warm and fresh.
Photorealistic, candid. 35mm, shallow depth of field, selfie distance, natural
film grain. No studio polish, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing.
Camera: chest-up close-up, locked off, eye level, one setup per beat — the
only movement is the woman and her hand.
Each woman is genuinely beautiful in the way her own country reads as
beautiful, but real: keep true fine pores and real skin texture, light natural
makeup or none. Genuine unforced brightness, not a posed smile. Every face
completely different from the other four.

[TRANSITION]
MASK TRANSITION at every cut: the palm advances toward the lens, fills and
blackens the frame, then pulls away to reveal the next woman already in place.
Prohibit hard cuts. Prohibit objects appearing out of thin air. Keep the
camera's breathing and timing in harmony, leaving enough time for each switch.

[TIMESTAMP STORYBOARD]

0-2s | JAPAN
25-year-old Japanese woman, elegant classical beauty. Cool-toned fair skin,
translucent, true fine pores. Slender double-eyelid almond eyes, cool clear
gaze, small straight nose, delicate jawline. Glossy jet-black hair past the
shoulders, curled softly inward, wispy see-through fringe. Cream ribbed knit
top. Slim shoulders, quiet grace.
By a bright bedroom window in Tokyo, white curtains behind her.
Her reserved face opens into a bright smile: 「おはよう！」
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

2-4s | UNITED STATES
25-year-old American woman, healthy open all-American beauty. Warm sun-kissed
skin with real freckles across nose and cheeks, true pores. Large round hazel
eyes creasing at the outer corners, high cheekbones, wide unguarded smile.
Voluminous honey-blonde beach waves gathered over one shoulder. Grey marl
sweatshirt slipping off one shoulder.
In a sunlit kitchen, a coffee mug on the counter behind her.
Brightly in English: "Good morning!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

4-6s | BRAZIL
25-year-old Brazilian woman, radiant sunlit beauty. Warm deep-brown skin with
a natural sheen, true pores. Large dark almond eyes, long thick lashes, high
cheekbones, full lips, broad open-mouthed smile. Abundant voluminous curls,
dark brown with caramel and honey highlights, wide around her shoulders. Small
gold hoops. Marigold-yellow strappy top.
On a balcony, tropical plants and morning haze behind her.
Brightly in Brazilian Portuguese: "Bom dia!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

6-8s | SPAIN
25-year-old Spanish woman, striking dark-eyed Mediterranean beauty. Olive
skin, warm and matte, true fine pores. Deep dark almond eyes under strong
brows, straight defined nose, sharp cheekbones, clean jawline, calm confident
half-smile that opens as she speaks. Long centre-parted deep-chestnut hair
with reddish warmth, thick and slightly wavy. Fine gold hoops. Crisp white
linen shirt, top button open. Upright poised posture.
In a whitewashed courtyard, terracotta pots and hard morning sun behind her.
Brightly in Spanish: "¡Buenos días!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

8-10s | INDONESIA
25-year-old Indonesian woman, warm sweet-featured beauty. Golden-brown skin,
smooth and luminous, true fine pores. Large round dark eyes, gentle open gaze,
softly rounded cheeks, small nose, wide easy smile that reaches her eyes.
Glossy very dark brown hair in a sharp chin-length blunt bob. Small gold
pendant. Sky-blue collared blouse. Petite, friendly.
On a wooden terrace, broad tropical leaves and soft morning light behind her.
Brightly in Indonesian: "Selamat pagi!"
She holds her smile and the frame ends on her face — she does NOT cover the
lens. The film finishes here.

[GLOBAL CLOSING]
Throughout: same chest-up framing, same eye-level camera height, same fresh
morning light, same warm mood in all five countries. Every woman looks
straight into the lens the whole time.
Five different faces, five different skin tones, five different hair colours
and lengths — jet-black long, honey-blonde waves, caramel curls, deep-chestnut
long, dark-brown bob. Never repeat a look, never blend two faces.
Each greeting is spoken clearly and completely within its two seconds, with
accurate native pronunciation and matching lip movement.
Pure video. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no BGM, no
watermark. Only the five voices and quiet morning room tone.
Prohibit: a sixth person, two people in one frame, the same face twice,
plastic or airbrushed skin, doll-like faces, hard cuts, objects appearing from
nothing, the hand entering before the greeting is finished, mixed camera
moves, jitter, flicker.

author: tanabe_fragm
title: Sports Film Study 255212
prompt:
卓球・オリンピック決勝 × カンフー映画の高速バトル

【SUMMARY】
10 seconds, 16:9. The final point of an Olympic table tennis final, shot like a Hong Kong
kung fu duel. Two players, one ball, a dark arena, one column of light on the table.
Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, one burst of pure hyper-speed.

【SET】
A packed arena, the crowd sunk into near-blackness — silhouettes and tiny out-of-focus
highlights. A hard column of white light falls onto a dark blue table with crisp white
lines. Fine dust drifts inside the beams. Extremely realistic physical texture: paddle
rubber, sweat-soaked fabric, the matte ball. High contrast, deep shadow, hard rim light
from above and behind, shallow depth of field around f/2.0.
A physical LED scoreboard hangs in the darkness behind the table, orange digits reading
10 - 10, sharp and correctly formed, never changing. It is the only lettering in the film.

【PLAYERS — two people, never more】
RED: a 24-year-old East Asian man, lean, heavy shoulders and forearms. Cropped black hair
soaked to his forehead. Sharp narrow eyes, high cheekbones, hard jaw. Cool-toned skin with
real pores, wet with sweat. Plain solid red sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo
or number. The aggressor.
BLUE: a 26-year-old East Asian man, taller and rangier. Longer black hair pushed back,
dripping. Thick brows, square jaw, steady unblinking stare. Warm-toned skin with real
pores. Plain solid blue sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo or number. The
counter-puncher.
Neither shows fear: two masters at the end of a long duel, calm and spent. The violence is
in the ball, not their faces.

【TIMELINE】

0.0-2.5s SERVE — deep slow motion.
RED tosses the ball straight up. It climbs through the light, turning slowly, dust around
it. He exhales, drops his shoulder, loads his arm. At 2.2s he strikes: real time snaps in
and the ball tears out of frame.
Camera: low angle just above the table surface, looking up past the net. Locked off.
Audio: near silence — his breath, shoes creaking, a low hush. Then one sharp crack.

2.5-4.3s HYPER-SPEED RALLY — no slow motion at all, the fastest passage in the film.
Fourteen exchanges in under two seconds, faster than any real rally. The ball stops
reading as an object and becomes a white streak cutting a line through the dust. Paddle
arms blur into afterimages, shoulders whip, feet smear. Sweat is thrown off both men in
sheets. The table shudders.
Camera: side-on at net height, one smooth horizontal slide along the table — the camera
stays calm while everything inside the frame is violent.
Audio: the cracks run together into a hard stutter like a drum roll, over squealing shoes
and a rising crowd.

4.3-5.5s THE BREATH — the speed drops out.
One exchange stretched into deep slow motion. RED drives the ball low across the net,
sweat lifting off his forearm and floating, dust turning around the ball. BLUE's eyes
track it. At 5.4s his paddle meets it and real time cracks back in.
Camera: the same side-on slide, now crawling.
Audio: everything falls to a muffled rumble and one long breath, then the crack.

5.5-8.0s THE ANSWER — the deepest slow motion in the film.
BLUE pushes off the floor and leaps sideways, body fully extended, back arched, paddle arm
cocked behind his head. He hangs there. Sweat droplets float around him. Dust turns in the
beam. His eyes lock on the ball. At 7.8s the paddle connects and real time slams back with
the loudest crack yet.
Camera: low angle, looking steeply up at him against the black arena roof. Locked off.
Audio: sound drops muffled and distant while he hangs, then the crack at full volume.

8.0-10.0s THE POINT — real time.
The ball skips off the far corner and away into the dark. RED is caught frozen mid-reach,
unable to follow it. BLUE lands hard, skids on one foot, and roars, head back, fists
clenched. Behind them the crowd erupts, thousands of silhouettes rising at once.
Camera: wide on the table and both men, pushing in 5% at most. Hold to the last frame.
Audio: the crowd explodes, his roar cutting through it, the ball still bouncing underneath.

【RECAP — all 10 seconds】
Dark arena, one hard column of light on the dark blue table, drifting dust, a near-black
crowd of silhouettes.
Only two people in frame. Their faces, hair and clothing stay identical in every shot,
every garment a single solid colour with no logo, number or pattern.
One camera movement per shot, never two. Hard clean cuts on impact. The ball stays inside
the frame at all times.
Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, switching instantly, with one
sustained hyper-speed burst where the ball is a streak.
The scoreboard reads 10 - 10 and never changes, and it is the only lettering.
The sound is the ball, the shoes, the breathing and the crowd — keep the mix free of music
and commentary.

CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm **vertical 9:16** daily vlog footage optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode, speaking directly to the lens while casually walking through the gym. LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around overhead lights, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. The footage should feel authentic and completely unstaged, like a real creator documenting her workout on her phone.

STYLE: An intimate daily fitness vlog filmed in a mostly empty boutique gym. Casual, relaxed, and conversational. Small laughs, pauses, fixing her ponytail, wiping sweat with her towel, catching her breath, looking away while thinking, and talking naturally to the audience instead of delivering lines. She speaks in short, natural sentences with frequent pauses. Never rush dialogue. Leave quiet moments between lines.

She wears a fitted black long-sleeve workout top, high-waisted black leggings, white socks, white sneakers, and a white towel loosely resting around her neck.

"...okay."
"I definitely earned dinner."
She laughs quietly and adjusts the towel around her neck.
"I almost skipped today."

"Glad I came."

"My legs are done."

She laughs.

Walking toward the exit in selfie mode, she smiles into the lens.

author: johnAGI168
title: 声音：演员现场原声，精准口型同步
prompt:
时长：30秒
画幅：16:9
语言：自然美式英语
声音：演员现场原声，精准口型同步；无旁白、无字幕、无背景音乐
影像：高端欧美现实主义爱情电影质感，克制、冷峻、浅景深，真实皮肤纹理，摄影机运动极轻微
人物均为原创虚构角色，不参考任何演员、名人或影视作品。
【人物设定】
男方 NOAH：28岁，英俊、身材挺拔，深棕色短发，白衬衫袖口卷起。他怀疑女友爱上了一个更富有的男人。表面愤怒，实际害怕自己不值得被爱。
女方 CLAIRE：26岁，漂亮、气质冷静，金棕色长发，黑色简约连衣裙。她确实曾被另一个男人吸引，但真正动摇她的不是金钱，而是长期被男友忽视。
全程保持两人脸部、发型、服装、声线和空间位置一致。
【核心情绪曲线】
怀疑压制 → 讽刺防御 → 直接逼问 → 短暂坦白 → 男方受伤 → 女方说出关系早已结束的真相。
两个人不是从第一秒就大吼。真正的情绪峰值出现在女方说出：
“No. But I wanted to.”
最终一刀则是：
“We just kept calling it love.”
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头一｜0.0—7.0秒】
双人中近景。NOAH站在前景，CLAIRE站在几步之外。摄影机缓慢向两人靠近。
0.0—2.4秒
NOAH的目的：逼她主动承认。
他先盯着她沉默半秒，嘴唇压紧，下颌轻微咬住。眉毛向内下压，眼睑收紧，但音量保持克制，不要立刻咆哮。
他缓慢说道：
“Tell me the truth. Is it him?”
“truth”略微加重；说到“him”时才抬起眼睛直视她。
说完后保持静止，不提前流泪，不移开视线。
2.4—4.4秒
CLAIRE的目的：用讽刺挡住羞耻。
她没有立即回答。鼻腔短促呼气，嘴角出现不足一秒的苦涩微笑，目光扫过他的衬衫，然后重新看回他的眼睛。
她轻声反问：
“You mean the man with the car?”
“car”没有炫耀意味，而是故意刺中他的自卑。
说完后笑意立刻消失。身体没有后退。
4.4—7.0秒
NOAH被刺中，眉间压力增强，向前走半步，但不触碰她。
声音第一次抬高：
“Don’t make this a joke. I saw you leave with him.”
“saw”短促加重；最后的“him”压低声音，像在努力控制失态。
CLAIRE听他说话时不翻白眼、不抢话。她的眼神短暂变软，随后重新封闭。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头二｜7.0—20.0秒】
切到CLAIRE肩后拍NOAH，再缓慢转为两人的交替近景。
7.0—9.3秒
CLAIRE的目的：让他明白“离开”和“背叛”不是同一件事。
她停顿半秒，平静说道：
“And I came home.”
语速慢，音量低。“home”说得很轻，像提醒他自己曾经选择回来。
她说完后等待他的反应，不继续解释。
9.3—12.0秒
NOAH的愤怒开始失去保护作用。
他的嘴唇张开，却有半秒没有声音。目光从她的眼睛移到嘴唇，又迅速回到眼睛。胸口出现一次明显但受控的吸气。
他问：
“Did you kiss him?”
不要吼叫。声音比前面更轻、更不稳定，像他真正害怕听见答案。
12.0—16.0秒
CLAIRE先保持眼神接触一秒。
她回答第一个词：
“No.”
停顿约0.8秒。她的目光第一次落下，嘴角轻微绷紧；再次抬眼时，攻击性完全消失。
随后坦白：
“But I wanted to.”
“wanted”说得很轻，不能喊。声音尾部出现轻微气息断裂，但不哭。
这是全片最重要的转折。NOAH听到“wanted”后才出现反应：眼睑轻微抬起，下颌松开，身体像失去支撑一样后移半步。反应不能提前。
16.0—20.0秒
NOAH试图用金钱解释这一切，重新保护自尊。
他短促吸气，眉毛向内收紧，声音突然抬高一次：
“Because he can give you everything?”
“everything”达到男方全片最高音量，随后立即降下来。
说完后他闭紧嘴唇，眼神已经不再愤怒，而是在等待一次能够拯救自己的否认。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头三｜20.0—30.0秒】
CLAIRE面部特写，随后轻微转焦到她身后的NOAH。摄影机保持克制，不环绕、不快速推进。
20.0—23.2秒
CLAIRE终于说出真正原因。
她的眉毛内侧轻微抬起，眼眶开始湿润，但眼泪不能落下。下巴轻微绷紧，呼吸变浅。
她直视他说：
“Because he listened when I spoke.”
“listened”轻微加重；“spoke”几乎成为耳语。
这句话不是报复，而是她已经疲惫到不想再争辩。
23.2—25.0秒
NOAH所有攻击性消失。
肩膀下降，目光短暂离开她。他想说更多，却只能低声问：
“So that’s it?”
“it”尾音轻微发虚。不要哭，不要做夸张痛苦表情。
25.0—30.0秒
CLAIRE轻轻摇头一次。
她先说：
“No.”
停顿0.6秒，像是在决定是否还要给这段关系留下体面。
随后平静说道：
“It ended months ago. We just kept calling it love.”
“ended”保持冷静；说到“love”时声音第一次轻微破裂。
最后一个词结束后，她仍然直视他约1秒。眼泪停留在下眼睑，不落下来。随后她缓慢移开目光。
NOAH站在失焦背景中，没有追上去，也没有说话。
结尾保持两人之间的静止和距离至少1秒，不恢复中性表情，不增加额外对白。
【表演限制】
- 不要从第一秒开始吼叫或哭泣。
- CLAIRE在20秒前眼眶不能明显湿润，全程不连续流泪。
- NOAH的核心不是暴怒，而是用愤怒掩盖自卑和恐惧。
- CLAIRE不是冷酷反派，她是在承认一段关系早已被忽视耗尽。
- 所有停顿都有心理行动，避免机械停顿。
- 手势克制，不摔东西、不推搡、不发生身体冲突。
- 保留准确英文对白、角色分配、自然呼吸和精准口型。
NEGATIVE:
subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, background music, theatrical overacting,
constant shouting, premature tears, instant emotional switch, random gestures,
physical violence, frozen listener, robotic delivery, lip-sync drift, double mouth,
warped face, extra fingers, identity drift, wardrobe drift, abrupt camera movement

author: AIwithYazdan
title: The Paper Boat
prompt:
Create a 60-second premium cinematic short film titled “THE PAPER BOAT.”

STYLE:
Photorealistic live-action cinematic realism, emotionally restrained, award-winning short-film cinematography, premium theatrical production quality, natural performances, physically accurate environments, realistic water simulation, authentic atmospheric perspective, subtle film grain, natural HDR, realistic lens behavior, no artificial CGI appearance.
CORE CONCEPT:
The entire film follows one ordinary handmade paper boat on an impossible journey. There is exactly ONE impossible element in the world: this small paper boat can travel wherever connected water flows, no matter how far. Everything else obeys real-world physics.

The audience should initially believe they are watching an ordinary child's paper boat experiment. Only gradually should the journey become extraordinary.
CHARACTER 1:
A quiet 9-year-old South Asian boy with warm medium-brown skin, expressive dark eyes, slightly messy short black hair, slim build, wearing a faded mustard-yellow T-shirt, worn blue shorts and simple sandals. His appearance, clothing, hairstyle, proportions and facial identity remain perfectly consistent whenever he appears.

CHARACTER 2:
An elderly South Asian man around 70 years old, weathered expressive face, silver hair, simple cream shirt, dark trousers and worn sandals. Natural elderly movement, subtle expressions, realistic skin and hair.

THE PAPER BOAT:
One tiny handmade white paper boat folded from slightly creased school notebook paper. Imperfect folds, tiny graphite pencil marks and one faint blue crayon line on one side. It is ordinary paper, not magical-looking. No glow, no symbols, no supernatural appearance. The exact same boat must remain visually recognizable throughout the entire film, becoming slightly damp and worn during its journey.
STORY AND CAMERA:

0–5 SECONDS — THE HOOK
Extreme macro close-up with an 85mm macro lens.

A tiny handmade paper boat floats perfectly still inside a shallow rain puddle after a monsoon shower.
Raindrops strike the water around it.

One large raindrop lands directly inside the boat.

The boat rocks dangerously.

For a moment it looks like it will sink.

Instead, it rights itself.

Rack focus from the rippling water to the boy's reflection in the puddle.

The boy is crouched beside it, silently watching.

Natural breathing, blinking and tiny eye movement.

5–10 SECONDS

Low 35mm tracking shot beside the boy.

He gently pushes the boat forward with one fingertip.

He gives a tiny, genuine smile and quietly whispers:

“Ja... dekhte hain kahan jaati hai.”

Natural child delivery, soft voice, tiny pause between words, no theatrical acting.

The boat begins drifting through a thin stream of rainwater running along the street.

The boy follows it.

His sandals splash naturally through shallow water.

His shirt moves with his running.

Small droplets strike the camera lens.

10–18 SECONDS

The camera drops almost to water level and begins following the paper boat.

The boat enters a narrow concrete drainage channel.

The boy runs alongside it for a few seconds before stopping.

His expression changes from excitement to concern as the boat disappears into the channel.

The camera does NOT cut.

It continues following the boat through the drainage channel.

The narrow concrete environment gradually becomes a larger natural stream.

Use foreground leaves, flowing water and a curtain of dripping vegetation to create a seamless hidden transition.

No teleportation.

No magical transformation.

18–26 SECONDS

The stream becomes a wide river.

The camera slowly rises from water level into a graceful crane movement.

Reveal an enormous realistic river surrounded by countryside.

The tiny paper boat remains the visual anchor.

Warm sunlight begins breaking through clouds.

Wet vegetation glistens.

Birds move naturally through the distant sky.

The boy is now barely visible far behind on the riverbank.

The boat is carried faster by the current.

26–34 SECONDS

The river becomes progressively wider.

The camera remains physically connected to the boat, tracking its movement naturally.

The landscape gradually changes as the river approaches the coast.

The boat enters increasingly turbulent water.

Realistic ripples, foam, reflections and paper deformation.

The camera passes behind a large foreground tree trunk, creating a natural dark-frame transition.

When the camera emerges, the river has reached the ocean.

Reveal a vast open sea.

The tiny boat floats into the enormous expanse.

34–42 SECONDS

The camera tracks directly behind the paper boat at water level.

Ocean waves gently lift and lower it.

The boat is now slightly damp and softened but remains intact and recognizable.

Subtle environmental progression communicates distance and time:

changing cloud formations,
changing sunlight,
changing ocean conditions,
different coastlines appearing and disappearing in the distance.

Use wave spray and foreground water to conceal seamless environmental transitions.

No artificial time-lapse.

No teleportation.

Everything remains physically believable except the boat's impossible ability to continue traveling.

Seabirds occasionally cross the frame.
One bird briefly skims the ocean surface near the boat.
42–48 SECONDS
The ocean gradually approaches a quiet rocky coastline.

The camera moves from behind the boat into a graceful side profile.

A gentle wave carries the boat toward a narrow natural channel leading into a peaceful inland lake.

The soundscape becomes quieter.

The boat enters the lake.

Late-afternoon sunlight now creates warm natural reflections across the water.

Reveal the elderly South Asian man sitting alone beside the lake, sketching quietly in a small notebook.

He hears the water.

He looks up.

48–54 SECONDS

50mm medium close-up.

The elderly man notices the tiny paper boat approaching the shore.

He doesn't react dramatically.

First curiosity.

Then confusion.

Then recognition.

His breathing pauses for a moment.

His eyes soften.

He slowly stands.

The boat gently touches his sandal.

He bends down and carefully picks it up using both hands.

He examines the tiny graphite marks and faint blue crayon line.

A quiet emotional smile appears.

No dialogue.

The emotion must be communicated entirely through micro-expression, eye movement, breathing and body language.

54–60 SECONDS — EMOTIONAL CALLBACK

The elderly man takes a fresh sheet of paper from his notebook.

He begins folding a new paper boat.

Close-up on his hands.

His fingers make the first fold.

MATCH CUT:

The exact same hand movement becomes the 9-year-old boy's hands from the opening scene.

The boy is back beside the original rain puddle.

He places another handmade paper boat onto the water.

The new boat begins drifting.

The camera slowly pulls backward.

The puddle reflects the sky.

The reflection gradually fills the frame.

The reflection visually resembles the enormous lake where the elderly man was sitting.

Hold for one quiet beat.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Professional theatrical cinematography throughout. 35mm and 50mm cinema lenses for narrative shots, 85mm macro for intimate details, natural depth of field, subtle lens breathing, realistic focus pulls, physically motivated camera movement, restrained handheld micro-movement around the child, smooth stabilized tracking around the boat, gradual crane and aerial reveals only when motivated by geography.

The camera must always feel physically present in the environment.

No impossible camera movement.

No random drone shots.

Every camera movement must reveal geography, emotion or scale.

LIGHTING:
Begin with cool, soft post-rain daylight.

Gradually transition into warm sunlight as the boat reaches the river.

Move naturally toward late-afternoon golden light when the elderly man discovers the boat.

Maintain physically consistent shadows, reflections and exposure throughout.
ENVIRONMENTAL REALISM:
Wet concrete, puddles, water droplets, muddy edges, paper fibers, damp clothing, realistic reflections, atmospheric haze, leaves reacting to wind, grass bending naturally, birds responding to the environment, subtle dust and moisture in sunlight, realistic ocean spray, accurate water interaction, natural cloth movement and hair movement.

AUDIO:
Primarily natural diegetic sound.

Rain droplets.
Flowing water.
Footsteps.
Child's breathing.
Distant traffic.
Birds.
Wind.
River current.
Ocean waves.
Paper folding.

Use a restrained cinematic score that gradually builds as the journey expands, then becomes almost silent when the elderly man discovers the boat.

No dialogue after the boy's single sentence.

EMOTIONAL ARC:
Curiosity → excitement → uncertainty → wonder → vastness → quiet discovery → emotional connection → circular beginning.
The film must NOT explain who the elderly man is or why the boat reached him.

Let the audience interpret the connection.

VISUAL RULE:
Everything in the film must look completely real except for the single impossible rule governing the paper boat.

NO:
dragons,
magic particles,
glowing objects,
portals,
fantasy environments,
cyberpunk,
giant objects,
supernatural effects,
text,
subtitles,
logos,
watermarks,
exaggerated acting,
cartoon physics,
unmotivated camera movement,
teleportation,
morphing characters,
duplicate boats,
changing boat design,
character inconsistency,
artificial-looking CGI.

FINAL FEELING:
The film should feel like a real cinematic short that quietly contains one impossible event.
The viewer should finish with the feeling:

“Wait... how did that paper boat get there?”

Then the final image should make them want to watch the entire journey again.

VISUAL PRIORITY:
Photorealism > spectacle.
Emotion > exposition.
Physics > VFX.
Story > technical demonstration.
Subtlety > exaggeration.
Make every frame feel intentionally photographed by a world-class cinematographer rather than generated by an AI model.

6-9s：徐長今在灶台前忙碌，快速料理蒙太奇：切年糕、炒辣醬、燉高湯，動作熟練快速，裙襬隨動作輕晃。
9-12s：徐長今試味道，微微出汗，甜美妖豔的臉龐帶著專注，碎髮貼在臉側。
12-15s：時間緊迫，徐長今加快翻炒，辣炒年糕色澤紅亮香氣四溢。
15-18s：閔政浩因擔心快步跑進御膳房，焦急尋找徐長今。
18-21s：他從拿著長木筷正在攪拌辣炒年糕的徐長今身後輕輕抱住她，低聲：「長今，別怕，我陪妳。」
21-24s：徐長今受驚，舉起沾了紅色辣醬的長木筷想反擊，轉身時被政浩壁咚壓在紙窗邊。
24-27s：紙窗透光映照兩人身影，政浩憂鬱深情的丹鳳眼注視徐長今。
27-30s：政浩低頭曖昧親吻徐長今，徐長今先驚訝，隨後慢慢閉眼。

30-33s：在紙窗邊，兩人深情擁吻，政浩一手扶她腰，背景鍋中辣炒年糕繼續冒熱氣。
33-36s：長今輕推政浩，喘息說中文道：「大人……現在不是時候……」
36-39s：政浩微笑幫她整理碎髮，長今迅速完成擺盤。
39-42s：長今端著辣炒年糕與政浩快步前往中宗寢殿。
42-45s：中宗用筷子夾起辣炒年糕試吃一口後，突然露出滿意表情，身體輪廓微微發亮，頭旁邊飄出各種可愛emojis，搭配「WOW～」搞笑音效。
45-48秒：長今與政浩低頭謙卑並肩站立聽訓，中宗說中文誇獎道：「果然好吃！朕決定赦免你今日之罪。」
48-51秒：中宗繼續說：「長今，妳果然是宮中第一奇女子。」
51-54秒：身後，政浩偷偷抓住長今一隻手緊握，長今突然害羞低頭微笑，甜美妖豔的臉頰微紅。
54-57秒：周邊皇宮老臣們看到這一幕，也竊竊私語、掩嘴偷笑。
57-60秒：中宗察覺兩人異樣，忍不住大笑出聲，畫面在溫馨笑聲中緩慢淡出。

author: tanabe_fragm
title: Sports Film Study 274971
prompt:
15s | 16:9 | 24fps | Olympic 100m final, night. One sprinter in lane 4 —
the tallest man in the field — starts level with the pack, then unfolds and
runs away from them, winning in 9.4 seconds roughly four meters clear.
Photoreal broadcast cinematography, heat-soaked stadium air, explosive crowd
energy.

=== GLOBAL SETUP ===

ENVIRONMENT & TEXTURE
Night. Olympic stadium, 80,000-seat bowl packed to the roof. Humid summer
air. Heat haze shimmering off the blue mondo track. Emphasize extremely
realistic physical texture: sweat beading and running, muscle fiber shifting
under skin, spike plates biting into the rubber, grit kicking up behind the
blocks.

VISUAL STYLE
Photoreal live sports broadcast. Shallow depth of field on close shots, deep
focus on wides. Hard key from stadium floodlights overhead. Strong rim light
separating the runners from the dark crowd. Thousands of camera flashes
popping across the stands as a moving field of white specks.

CAMERA LANGUAGE
Broadcast telephoto and trackside rail cameras. Exactly ONE camera move per
time slice. Never combine moves.

RUNNERS
Lane 4 (hero): 26-year-old African-American male sprinter, 192cm tall —
visibly the tallest man on the track, a clear head above the shortest runner
in the field. Deep brown skin with a wet sheen under the floodlights — keep
the real fine pores and natural skin texture. Long neck, broad flat
shoulders, very long legs, narrow hips, deep chest, long muscle bellies
rather than bulk. Sharp cheekbones, jaw clenched at the start, eyes locked
dead ahead on the finish line, never glancing sideways. Short cropped hair
with a close fade. Yellow-and-green singlet, bib number 4. Veins raised on
the forearms.
  Stride signature — this must be readable on screen: he takes FEWER strides
  than anyone else, about 41 to their 45. Each stride is visibly longer and
  covers more ground per contact. Because of his height he needs more
  distance to reach full upright posture, so he is NOT ahead early.
Chasing pack: seven other sprinters, treated as ONE group. Never featured
individually, never in focus. Shorter, more compact builds. Higher stride
frequency, choppier. Mixed dark and light singlets.
Crowd: an undifferentiated mass, out of focus, rising to their feet in a wave.

PERFORMANCE CORE
The story is the delay and the release. He is level with the field for the
first third, then unfolds and eats the gap alive. Show dominance through
stride length and empty track, not through slow-motion tricks.

FORBIDDEN
No subtitles. No captions. No on-screen graphics, scoreboard, timer, or any
legible text or numbers. No commentator voice. No dialogue of any kind. No
background music. No runners appearing or vanishing — exactly eight on the
track for the entire 15 seconds. Hero's face, hair, height, and singlet must
not change between shots. No flickering limbs, no duplicated arms or legs,
no warped feet.

=== TIMESTAMPS ===

0-2s / Frame 0-48 — THE STILLNESS
Action: Eight sprinters in the set position, hips high, fingertips on the
  line. Hero in lane 4, center frame — even folded into the blocks he is
  obviously the longest body in the row, knees stacked higher than anyone
  else's. A single bead of sweat crawls down his temple and hangs at his jaw.
  Absolute stillness. Crowd noise drops to a low hum.
Intent: Compress the energy. The stiller this is, the more violent the start
  reads.
Camera: Low-angle trackside rail, side-on. LOCKED OFF, no movement.
Sound: Low crowd hum, one distant whistle, the hero's held breath.
Negative: no subtitles, no music.

Frame 48 (2.0s) — THE GUN
The starter's pistol cracks. The report slaps off the stadium bowl and comes
back as an echo.

2-5s — LEVEL (0-30m)
Action: All eight fire out of the blocks. Footplates kick backward. Spikes
  tear at the track. The seven shorter runners snap upright fast, legs
  churning at high frequency. The hero stays low and long, still folded
  forward, unwinding one huge stride at a time. Through 30 meters he is dead
  level with the field — for a beat he even looks a fraction behind.
Intent: Hold the audience. Make them doubt him.
Camera: Side tracking rail matching race speed. ONE lateral move, left to
  right.
Sound: Crowd roar detonating, spikes ripping rubber, explosive breathing.
Negative: no subtitles, no music, no commentator.

5-8s — THE UNFOLDING (30-60m)
Action: He finally comes to full upright posture, later than everyone else —
  and the stride opens to its full length. Each contact now swallows the
  ground the others need two steps for. At 45 meters he draws level and goes
  past. Sweat flies off his shoulders in visible droplets, catching the
  floodlights. By 60 meters he is two body lengths clear.
Intent: The moment the race stops being a race.
Camera: Long telephoto, head-on from the finish line. ONE slow push in.
  Compressed perspective stacks the pack behind him.
Sound: Sustained roar building, a rolling wall of sound.
Negative: no subtitles, no music.

8-11.4s — ALONE (60-100m)
Action: His face settles into the top-end sprint mask — jaw loose, cheeks
  vibrating with each footstrike. Enormous, unhurried strides. Behind him the
  pack is contorted, straining, taking far more steps to cover the same
  ground. Clean empty track between him and the nearest rival, about four
  meters. Heat haze distorting the air in that gap.
Intent: Let the empty track do the work.
Camera: Low tracking rail alongside the hero. ONE steady lateral move.
Sound: Crowd at a continuous peak, breathing, spikes.
Negative: no subtitles, no music.

Frame 274 (11.4s) — THE LINE
Action: Chest hits the line. Torso dips hard. Long arms flung back. The
  timing beam breaks.
Camera: Side-on at the finish. Drop to slow motion for a beat, then return
  to real time.
Sound: The roar cresting into a single detonation.

11.4-13s — THE REST ARRIVE
Action: The chasing pack crosses roughly four-tenths of a second later,
  strung out, gasping, hands on heads. The hero is already past them in the
  frame, decelerating, towering over them as they slow around him.
Camera: Wide, ONE slow pull back to reveal the full straight.
Sound: Roar, then a ragged edge of disbelief in it.

13-15s — ECSTASY
Action: He wheels around, both long arms flung wide, mouth open in a roar
  that is swallowed by the crowd. Camera flashes storm across the stands in
  waves. He drops to his knees on the track, head tipped back, chest heaving.
Intent: Release everything the first two seconds held down.
Camera: Handheld, tight, moving with him. ONE move, following.
Sound: Crowd at maximum. A solid wall of sound with no gaps in it.
Negative: no subtitles, no music, no commentator voice.

=== CLOSING ===
Throughout all 15 seconds: night stadium under floodlights, humid heat haze,
telephoto broadcast look. Hero in lane 4 always weighted toward frame center,
always the tallest figure on the track, always taking longer strides than
anyone around him. Keep his face, hair, build, and yellow-and-green singlet
identical in every shot. Keep exactly eight runners on the track the entire
time. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text or numbers, no commentator
voice, no dialogue, no background music. Sound is crowd, spikes, breathing,
and the starter's pistol only.

author: rahulnanda86
title: Making of movie - Titanoboa - Behind the scenes!!
prompt:
Ultra-realistic behind-the-scenes film set footage, slightly high vantage point, shot like a real making-of video on a professional handheld camera from the side of a soundstage. The set is dressed like a dense Amazon jungle location: wet muddy ground, artificial trees and vines, haze in the air, hanging rigging, practical lights, camera tracks, crew members standing off to the side, and a giant hyper-realistic animatronic anaconda dominating the set. The snake looks absolutely massive, with detailed scales, wet reflections, huge fangs, and mechanical realism.

The clip begins with the director shouting, “Action!” A female actor in adventure-film costume stands in front of the giant snake, backing away nervously as if in a creature movie scene. The snake suddenly lifts its head, opens its mouth wide, and gives a loud threatening hiss. The woman starts stepping backward and says “No, no, no!” in character. The snake lunges, coils upward, lifts her, throws her into the air so she spins once in a full 360, then catches her cleanly in its mouth and appears to swallow her whole. Everyone watching is stunned for a beat.  Then immediately someone off camera yells “Cut! Cut! Cut!” The illusion breaks. The animatronic snake lowers its head and its mouth section is mechanically opened downward by the crew.

The actress casually climbs back out of the snake’s mouth, laughing and dusting herself off. She smiles and says, “I think that was a good shot.” Hair and makeup artists and crew members quickly walk in around her, checking on her and resetting the scene. The tone becomes playful and clearly behind-the-scenes. Keep it fast, clear, believable, and very realistic — like a real BTS clip from a big-budget Titanoboa-style jungle creature film. No fantasy look, no cartoon look, only grounded practical-movie-set realism.

author: johnAGI168
title: 日本大型综艺水上闯关特别节目（Japanese TV Game Sh
prompt:
【风格】日本大型综艺水上闯关特别节目（Japanese TV Game Show，Live-Action Broadcast），多机位实时转播，4K真实摄影（Photorealistic），高饱和夏日色彩，全片实时无慢动作

【时长】30秒

【场景】晴天户外大型休闲泳池闯关赛道，五关从左到右一字排开。第一关：5米高木制起跳台，头顶缆绳挂带滑轮的泰山绳。第二关：水面上一块直径3米的红黄配色圆形浮盘，装在水下轴上持续匀速自转，表面湿滑。第三关：四块间距不等的方形跳板浮块，随水波上下起伏。第四关：一面倾斜的蓝色湿滑爬坡墙，顶端垂下几根抓绳。第五关：横架在水面上的巨大黄色圆柱管道，湿润反光的乙烯基表面印红色火焰纹，靠电机持续匀速自转，粗细刚好能被手臂和双腿环抱，右端连着小型终点台，正下方是清澈泳池、无安全垫。背景棕榈树、大型水滑梯、灯架、解说席、坐满观众的临时观众席。全片推进方向一律从左到右。

【角色】挑战者（成年日本女性，结实健康的运动体型，穿衣服）

【固定项】五关的位置尺寸颜色与连接关系全片不变；画面中始终只有一名挑战者；开场头发和衣服是干的，只有落水后才自然湿透；圆形浮盘和黄色管道在出现的所有镜头中都必须是持续转动的

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：泰山绳蹬出（Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back，ENG Camera）

画面：她双手握住绳子站在5米高台边缘，脚趾扣住台沿。

台词：「絶対クリアします！」（我一定要通关！）

动作：蜂鸣器一响，她用力向前蹬出，滑轮沿缆绳向右滑行，身体在水面上方划出钟摆轨迹，头发被风向后带起。

解说：「まずはターザンロープ！」（首先是泰山绳！）

音效：起跳蜂鸣器、滑轮滑行声、全场欢呼。

[00:03-00:07] 镜头2：转盘落地（Fixed Side Shot）

镜头：浮盘侧面固定机位，人、绳、转盘同框。

画面：红黄配色的圆形浮盘正在水面上持续匀速自转，湿滑表面反光。

动作：她松开绳子落上转盘，双脚一沾就被转盘带着向侧后方滑开，她张开双臂原地小碎步反向蹬踏抵消转速，膝盖弯曲重心压低，晃了两下站住。

表情：眉毛猛地扬起，牙关咬紧，随即咧嘴笑。

解说：「回転盤だ！耐えた！」（是转盘！撑住了！）

音效：转盘轴的低频嗡嗡声、鞋底摩擦声、爆发的欢呼。

[00:07-00:12] 镜头3：跳板连跳（Dolly Track L→R）

镜头：轨道摄像机与前进方向平行，从左向右跟移。

画面：四块方形浮块随水波上下起伏，间距不等。

动作：她从转盘边缘起跳，连续四次单脚点跳跨过浮块。第二块踩偏，浮块猛地下沉，她上身前扑双臂大幅画圈找平衡，右脚在水面拍出一片水花后勉强蹬上第三块，最后一跳双脚落上第四块。

台词：「危なっ……！」（好险……！）

解说：「二枚目で崩れた！でも繋いだ！」（第二块踩崩了！但接住了！）

音效：浮块入水的闷响、水花声、观众此起彼伏的惊呼。

[00:12-00:17] 镜头4：湿滑爬坡墙（Front 3/4 Medium Shot）

镜头：正面斜前方中景，人、坡墙、顶端抓绳同框。

画面：蓝色倾斜坡墙表面淌着水，反着光。

动作：她助跑冲上坡墙，跑了三步鞋底打滑往下溜了一截，她立刻扑倒身体双手扒住墙面，指尖抠住表面纹路，再次蹬腿爬升，右手抓到顶端垂下的抓绳，双臂发力把自己拽上顶端。

表情：脖子绷出线条，额头挤出横纹，大口喘气。

台词：「よいしょ、よいしょ……！」（嘿咻、嘿咻……！）

解说：「滑る壁！腕だけで登った！」（打滑的墙！全靠手臂爬上去了！）

音效：湿墙面的摩擦声、绳子绷紧声、全场掌声。

[00:17-00:21] 镜头5：抱上转动的柱子（Rear Side Fixed Shot）

镜头：稍靠后的固定侧机位，能看清管道正在转。

画面：黄色圆柱管道靠电机持续匀速自转，湿润的乙烯基表面上有一层水膜，红色火焰纹随转动不断卷过画面。

动作：她从坡顶跳下俯身跨上管道根部，胸腹、双臂、双腿同时箍住。管道的自转立刻把她整个人往右侧带过去，她跟着管道的转向反向调整重心，交替小幅挪动手臂和双腿往终点蹭。

台词：「えっ、回ってる！？」（诶，它在转！？）

解说：「回転丸太だ！これが最難関！」（是转动的圆木！这是最难的一关！）

音效：电机低频转动声、湿乙烯基的摩擦声。

[00:21-00:26] 镜头6：被转翻·终点前极限（Front Close-up → Medium Pull-back）

镜头：终点侧正面特写缓慢拉到中景，机位轴线不变。

动作：管道持续转动，把她的身体一点点往右侧带翻，她的重心越过管道最高点后再也压不回来。右腿先脱开在空中扑腾一下，接着右手也脱开朝终点台伸出，全身重量吊在左臂和左腿上，随管道继续向右转。

表情：太阳穴青筋鼓起，手臂肌肉发抖，眼睛瞪圆。

台词：「もうダメ、待って……！」（不行了，等等……！）

解说：「回転に負けた！あと少し！」（被转动打败了！就差一点！）

承接：右手指尖距终点台约20厘米，左手仍贴着仍在转动的管道。

[00:26-00:28] 镜头7：终点前落水（Fixed Side Shot）

镜头：管道侧面固定机位，管道、伸出的右手、终点台、正下方水面同框。

动作：管道再转过一点，支撑的左手被转到管道下侧后滑脱，她身体保持侧向顺重力直坠入泳池，砸起大片水花。管道在她落下后仍在原位持续自转。

台词：「あーっ！」（啊——！）

解说：「落ちた！丸太に回されたー！」（掉下去了！被圆木转翻了！）

音效：豪爽的入水声、观众的惊呼。

[00:28-00:30] 镜头8：水面反应收尾（Water-level Close-up，Static）

镜头：水面高度正面特写，机位静止，优先表现脸部。

动作：她从水里探出脸和肩膀，湿发一缕缕贴在脸颊上，抹了一把脸，看向终点方向皱起眉，双手拍了一下水面。

台词：「悔しい！」（好懊恼！）

动作：视线转回镜头，皱着的眉松开，转成害羞的笑，肩膀缩了一下。背景里黄色管道仍在慢慢转。

音效：全场大欢呼和掌声推到最高点。

【音响】

全片薄铺一层日本大型综艺特别节目风格的快节奏游戏秀BGM。观众欢呼、掌声、笑声、起跳蜂鸣器、滑轮滑行声、转盘和电机的低频转动声、浮块入水声、湿墙面摩擦声、湿乙烯基摩擦声、水滴声、入水声，各自与对应动作同步。解说和挑战者说自然清晰的日语，除指定说话者外不让任何人出声，台词与口型同步。台词期间BGM和欢呼自然压低，不盖过人声，不加多余旁白。

【机位与剪辑】

自然多机位电视转播，只用硬切。混用ENG摄像机、钢丝摄像机、轨道摄像机、水面高度摄像机、长焦画角，每个区间只用指定的那一种机位运动。转盘和管道所在的镜头必须选用能明确看出转动方向的构图。维持180度轴线规则和从左到右的推进方向。禁止超高速运镜、剧烈旋转、冲击变焦、过度变焦、无人机式急转弯，禁止慢动作、重播、定格、时间跳跃。

【全片禁止】

全片保持脸部、发型、体型、服装、肤色、体格、左右手脚数量一致。手脚与各关卡的接触和脱离严格按时间线顺序发生，真实表现重力、惯性、打滑、自转、水花。转动的道具不得出现静止帧或忽然停转。不出现瞬移、位置倒退、空中静止、身体变形、手脚增减、物体增殖、穿透道具、背景替换。以健康清爽的运动综艺风格呈现，服装不脱落、不破损、不透明、不过度位移。不出现真实存在的节目名、电视台名、企业名、赞助商名、商标，不出现字幕、节目logo、台标、水印、无意义文字、乱码。

Create a complete 30-second vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D animated short titled “The Cloud That Followed One Sad Boy.”

The energy blade retracts rapidly into the hilt with a sharp electrical sound.  Hard cut to the contestant’s face.  He is briefly stunned. The master activates the lightsaber one final time. The stable blue-white blade extends from the hilt, revealing a sharp white core and controlled blue glow.  Cut to the deep, smoking wounds in the three hanging albacore. Every cut has a continuous black charred edge matching the path of the previous strikes.
