title: REN Menswear Kinetic Typography
prompt:
Create an exactly 10-second premium vertical 9:16 photorealistic Japanese menswear fashion commercial using the attached REN character sheet　@[Image 1](image_1) as the absolute visual reference.

CORE OBJECTIVE:
Combine luxury menswear advertising, dynamic cinematic camera choreography, and sophisticated Adobe After Effects-style kinetic typography. Every shot must feel like a professionally directed, photographed, edited and motion-designed fashion commercial, never a static character sheet animation.

CHARACTER AND REFERENCE CONTROL:
The MID SHOT 3 VIEW section defines REN's face, natural messy center-parted dark hair, facial proportions and appearance. The HEADLESS FULL BODY 3 VIEW section defines the exact clothing silhouette, proportions and outfit from front, side and back. The DETAIL & ACCESSORIES section defines the silver pendant necklace, silver metal wristwatch, white sneakers and black blazer materials. The MOOD BOARD defines the muted monochromatic palette and typography direction, not the filming location.
Render REN as a believable live-action Japanese male fashion model in his late twenties, with realistic skin pores, natural hair strands, authentic fabric texture and physically accurate lighting.
Maintain precisely the same face, haircut, body type and outfit in all shots.

Outfit: relaxed black tailored blazer with casually pushed-up sleeves, white crewneck T-shirt, loose black wide-leg trousers, clean white low-top sneakers, a slim silver pendant necklace and one silver wristwatch worn exclusively on REN's LEFT wrist.
The RIGHT wrist must remain completely bare. Do not mirror or duplicate the watch.
Maintain the correct left and right sides of the character during frontal, three-quarter, profile and moving shots.
Do not treat the headless outfit images as actual headless characters. Reconstruct the complete character using the facial references.

ART DIRECTION:
Luxury European editorial fashion campaign meets contemporary Tokyo street-style advertising. Minimal architecture, elegant neutral studio space, sculptural lighting, charcoal black, warm ivory, light grey, muted taupe and cool silver. Premium contrast, refined highlights, realistic shadows and subtle atmospheric depth.

MOTION GRAPHICS:
High-end Adobe After Effects-style kinetic typography, precision motion design, bold condensed sans-serif typography, advanced animated masking, shape-layer transitions, geometric line animations, 2.5D parallax, text tracking, variable text scale, rapid scale transitions, smooth easing, motion blur and perfect beat synchronization.
Typography must interact spatially with REN: massive letters moving behind his body while smaller labels float in front, elegant silhouette masking, thin tracking lines following clothing details and graphic elements attached accurately to the garment.
Clean, editorial, sophisticated. Bold enough to create instant visual impact, but never visually chaotic.

EXACT 10-SECOND SEQUENCE:
0.0–1.5s — IMPACT INTRO:
Begin with an extreme photorealistic close-up of REN's eye and textured dark hair. Execute an explosive cinematic crash zoom backward, transitioning into a full-body front hero shot. Huge white kinetic typography reading URBAN MINIMAL rapidly assembles behind his silhouette. A fine graphic outline briefly traces his figure. Strong synchronized impact sound.

1.5–3.5s — THE BLAZER:
Whip-pan around REN to a dynamic three-quarter camera angle. Push into a highly detailed close-up of the black blazer's shoulder, lapel and relaxed sleeve. Smooth slow-motion fabric motion contrasts with rapid typography.
Display exactly: 01 / OVERSIZED JACKET.
Animated vector lines trace the jacket structure. Typography follows the moving garment with precise tracking.

3.5–5.0s — THE WHITE T-SHIRT:
Use a precise match cut into the white crewneck T-shirt and visible silver pendant necklace. Camera performs a fast lateral slide with natural depth separation. Bright white geometric masks transition into the text:
02 / CLEAN WHITE.
Briefly highlight the contrast between white innerwear and black tailoring.

5.0–6.5s — THE SILHOUETTE:
Execute a fast cinematic tilt and descending camera move toward the black wide-leg trousers and clean white sneakers. Transition into a dramatic low-angle tracking shot following REN taking one confident natural step.
Display exactly: 03 / WIDE SILHOUETTE.
Thin animated contour lines emphasize the flowing trouser shape. Preserve accurate shoe and fabric details.

6.5–8.0s — STYLE COMPOSITION:
Three extremely polished fast match cuts: front view, three-quarter view and side profile. Each camera angle must remain consistent with the reference character sheet. REN makes subtle natural model movements. A large typographic composition reading BALANCE IS KEY appears with layered masking, animated tracking and synchronized geometric shapes.
If the wristwatch becomes visible, it must be on his LEFT wrist only.

8.0–10.0s — HERO FINALE:
Fluid cinematic camera orbit transitions to a dramatic full-body hero shot. REN casually places his RIGHT hand into his trouser pocket while his LEFT wristwatch remains anatomically correct. He looks confidently toward the camera.

Large dramatic typography reading LESS IS MORE rises behind him, partially hidden by his silhouette. Minimal thin lines complete the composition like a luxury fashion magazine cover.
Finish on a visually powerful locked hero frame with a clean music impact.

CAMERA DIRECTION:
Use true cinematic camera movements, not digital zoom applied to a static reference image. Fast crash zoom, low-angle dolly, lateral tracking, whip-pan, short orbit, dynamic tilt and coherent movement across cuts.
Alternate explosive camera movement with very brief moments of clarity. Strong foreground-background separation, believable perspective, natural lens distortion, premium motion blur and controlled speed ramps.
Never make the video feel like a slideshow or a sequence of unrelated AI images.

TYPOGRAPHY RULES:
Display only these exact phrases:
URBAN MINIMAL
01 / OVERSIZED JACKET
02 / CLEAN WHITE
03 / WIDE SILHOUETTE
BALANCE IS KEY
LESS IS MORE

Typography must be clean, perfectly spelled, properly aligned, crisp and readable. Use the reference mood board to inspire the editorial style. No random text, malformed letters, extra slogans, captions or logos.
Give each phrase a brief readable hold even when entering or exiting dynamically.

SOUND DESIGN:
Modern luxury-fashion electronic soundtrack, approximately 120 BPM feel. Editorial percussion, subtle bass pulses, refined whooshes, shutter sounds and precisely synchronized graphic impacts. No dialogue, no narration.

FINAL OUTPUT:
Exactly 10 seconds, 9:16 portrait video, photorealistic live-action aesthetic, premium fashion advertising quality, highly dynamic cinematography, refined After Effects-inspired motion graphics, impeccable character and wardrobe continuity, elegant color grading, professional editing.
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:

title: Cyberpunk Transformer Bike Crash and Vehicle Flight
prompt:
Two helmeted riders on massive armored bikes race toward each other on a rain-soaked neon runway at night. They collide in a violent high-speed impact. Immediately after the crash, both bikes begin a dramatic mechanical transformation and fuse together into one heavy Tesla Cybertruck-style vehicle. The newly formed Tesla ignites thrusters and lifts off the runway, flying into the stormy cyberpunk sky.

Cinematic photorealistic next-level Transformers sci-fi cyberpunk sequence, ultra-detailed, IMAX-style, 4K. Nighttime on a wet futuristic airport runway under heavy rain, with a glowing neon megacity skyline in the background featuring holographic ads, flying vehicles, and cyberpunk atmosphere.

Two massive, heavily armored cyberpunk motorcycles (dark matte black with exposed chrome hydraulics, glowing cyan and magenta energy lines, intricate Transformers-style mechanical detailing) speed toward each other from opposite ends of the runway. Both riders wear full-face high-tech helmets with reflective visors and subtle HUD glow, bodies leaned aggressively forward as tires spray water and engines roar.

They collide head-on in a brutal, high-impact crash at the center of the frame — metal crumples, sparks explode, energy arcs crackle, and debris flies in slow motion. Right after the impact, both bikes begin a spectacular mechanical transformation sequence: panels shift and lock, components reconfigure with hydraulic precision, glowing seams light up, and the two wrecked bikes fuse and reassemble into a single massive heavy Tesla Cybertruck-inspired vehicle — angular, industrial, matte black with brushed metal surfaces and red accent lighting.

The newly formed Tesla powers up, its undercarriage thrusters ignite with bright blue-white plasma, and it lifts powerfully off the runway. It banks and accelerates forward into the rainy night sky, leaving trails of light, steam, and water spray as the neon city stretches below.

Dynamic camera work: low tracking shots following the bikes, dramatic crash close-up with debris flying toward the lens, then a rising aerial pull-back as the Tesla transforms and takes off. Volumetric lighting, heavy rain streaks, lens flares from neon and thrusters, photorealistic metal, water, sparks, and particle effects. Epic high-energy mood with cinematic color grading (deep blues, neon magentas, warm engine glows).

prompt:

Total length 11.20 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen, 30fps, single continuous shot. Character centered, facing the camera directly, movements light, playful, natural smile. Strictly execute the following dance sequence without adding new moves or extending preparation/hold times.

Body turns, palm pushes, knee lifts, and hand gestures follow the actual beat of this audio; do not set a conflicting BPM. Maintain natural smile and breathing; do not add obvious lip-sync speech.

[Segment-by-Segment Action, Expression, Gaze]
00:00–00:01.10 | Alternating Palm Push:
Legs naturally apart, knees relaxed, hips shifting weight left/right on beat. Left hand behind left ear, left elbow open outward; right arm extends toward camera, fingers spread, palm forward, forming a clear "stop" gesture. Then right hand returns to right ear side, left palm pushes forward, then retracts. Smooth hand exchange, palms do not touch lens.

00:01.10–00:02.20 | Hands Behind Ears Rhythm:
Following palm push, both hands move behind ears and back-of-head sides, elbows open naturally. Torso relaxed, shoulders slightly rebounding, hips continuously swinging left/right. Head tilts gently then straightens, hair sways naturally with shoulder movement.
Expression: Smile softens to playful, focused slight smile.

00:02.20–00:03.40 | Single Knee Lift:
Right hand stays behind right ear, left hand descends along outer body side, stops in front of left thigh. Weight stable on right leg, left knee lifts forward/upward, opens slightly left, left hand hovers above lifted thigh; then left leg returns to ground along same path. Complete one continuous knee lift only, no kicking, no pulling clothes. Torso tilts slightly for balance.
Expression: Light lip press, playful seriousness.
Gaze: Looks at left leg during lift, back to camera upon landing.
Landing: Highest knee point hits beat, landing immediately transitions to next gesture.

00:03.40–00:04.40 | Chest Fingertip Frame:
Left foot planted, both hands return to chest, palms angled toward camera; thumb and index finger approach, briefly forming small triangle frame. Then hands expand from center to sides, descend in arc to waist. Body maintains slight left/right rhythm.
Expression: From restrained smile to bright smile.
Gaze: Looks at central fingertips, raises eyes to direct camera view as hands open.

00:04.40–00:07.20 | Low Hands, Continuous Hip Swing:
Elbows slightly bent, hands relaxed into small fists, positioned at body sides, slightly below waist, knuckles facing front-inside. Keep hands low, rely on slight knee flexion/extension for continuous left/right weight shifts, hips thrust shortly through center then switch; shoulders counterbalance slightly, forearms bounce naturally with rhythm. Continue low hands and left/right hip swing, amplitude consistent with previous segment. Head tilts gently to one side then straightens; shoulders produce fine rebounds with beat, body does not move significantly forward/backward.
Expression: Smile naturally recedes, lips close lightly, forming brief calm state; then corners of mouth rise again.
Gaze: Briefly looks aside, returns to camera, maintaining interaction.

00:09.20–00:11.20 | Smile Return, Natural End:
Continue original left/right weight shifts, hands remain at body sides, wrists relaxed. Head tilts lightly with beat, finally returning to front, hip movements naturally reduce.
Expression: Reveals bright smile again, ending in relaxed, happy state.

Landing: Follows final rhythm of track to settle naturally, no sudden stiff freeze.

prompt:
[Basic Settings]
Thoroughly analyze the attached reference image and SNS profile, design a 'small room where the character would actually live' completely originally, and generate a video.
- Aspect Ratio: 9:16 (Vertical)
- Duration: Approx. 10 seconds (Continuous seamless one-cut video without cuts or teleportation)
- Style: Photorealistic macro cinematography combined with handcrafted miniature diorama aesthetics.

[Profile Analysis and Interior Conversion Rules] (*Design instructions for AI*)
Extract the following elements from the reference materials and reflect them directly in the room's interior design.
1. Color Design (Color Palette):
Extract the character's hair color, eye color, main and sub colors of their costume, and the tone of the profile picture, and reflect them in the shades of wallpaper, rugs, curtains, bedding, and lighting.
2. Architectural/Interior Style:
Translate the character's atmosphere and costume taste (Modern, Retro, Fantasy, Japanese, Cyber, Natural, Gothic, etc.) into furniture shapes and wall/floor materials.
3. Symbolic Items (Select 3-5):
From the profile text content (occupation, hobbies, likes, skills, worldview) and belongings, select only 3-5 items that symbolize the personality and place them in visually prominent positions within the room. (*Avoid stuffing too many small objects; maintain a balance where hobbies naturally seep into the living space.*)

[10-Second Video Composition (Continuous One Cut)]
■ 0-2 Seconds (Introduction):
Real indoor setting. A human hand carefully removes the wall outlet cover. Realistic live-action macro photography capturing textures of plastic, wallpaper, and fingertips. From behind the cover, a small warm light tinged with the room's theme color leaks out.
■ 2-4 Seconds (Intrusion):
The camera slowly approaches the opening and peers inside. A deep small residential space gradually appears, and the camera scales down while naturally intruding into the miniature world.
■ 4-8 Seconds (Daily Life):
The camera fully enters the room. The resident reference character is living doing 'the single most fitting daily action inferred from the profile (creation, reading, cooking, playing instruments, plant care, tidying, etc.)'. Avoid excessive posing; emphasize natural daily life as if accidentally peeked upon.
■ 8-10 Seconds (Afterglow):
The character notices the camera, looks at it briefly, and gives a small, charming reaction. End with a lingering feeling that makes you want to peek again, leaving the warm room atmosphere and small movements.

[Character and Craft Material Feel]
- Strictly maintain the original identity (facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, costume, accessories) and unify with the room scale. Characters are miniature residents; animals/mascots are not forcibly anthropomorphized but move naturally in their original form.
- The miniature world has the texture of exquisite handmade crafts. Combine craft materials appropriate for each item, such as wood/clay furniture, fabric/yarn textiles, transparent resin bottles, dried flowers, etc., evoking fibers, knits, and the warmth of handiwork.
- Express with shallow depth of field, natural bokeh from macro lenses, and soft warm indoor lighting.

[Audio/BGM]
- Voice: High-pitched, cute child-like small voice. Speak modestly in short fictional words that convey emotion rather than existing languages.
- BGM: Gentle, warm music-box-style instrumental matching the room's atmosphere. Naturally mix faint daily sounds like small footsteps and rustling cloth.

[Prohibited Items]
Mixing real-sized furniture, normal wiring depiction, overstuffing small objects, character alteration/dehumanization, adding unnecessary people/animals, displaying subtitles/text/logos/watermarks, excessive magic effects, unnatural cut changes, flashy BGM.

author: AIwithWania
title: Pumpkin-lit midnight enchantment short
prompt:
-

Create a cinematic, ultra-realistic 30-second Halloween romance video with a dreamy, mysterious atmosphere.

Scene 1 (0–5 seconds): The Mysterious Room
A young woman with long, dark hair sits quietly in a vintage Halloween-themed room. Antique furniture, warm table lamps, dried autumn leaves, and carved pumpkins decorate the space. She notices a glowing jack-o'-lantern on a wooden table and slowly reaches toward it. The camera captures the flickering candlelight and intricate pumpkin details.

Scene 2 (5–10 seconds): A Picture of Someone Special
She picks up an old, ornate photograph frame containing a portrait of a handsome young man. She gazes at his picture with a shy smile, her eyes reflecting the warm candlelight. The camera slowly moves closer to capture her emotional expression.

Scene 3 (10–15 seconds): A Magical Transformation
She rises and walks toward a mysterious doorway surrounded by glowing amber lights. Her dark outfit and flowing hair move naturally as she steps forward. The doorway opens into a beautifully illuminated Halloween setting, creating a seamless transition into the next scene.

Scene 4 (15–20 seconds): The Unexpected Meeting
She arrives at a cozy outdoor dining area decorated with carved pumpkins, candles, autumn flowers, and vintage lanterns. The young man from the photograph is waiting at a wooden table, wearing a stylish teal sweater and round glasses. She sits across from him, and they exchange warm, slightly nervous smiles.

Scene 5 (20–25 seconds): A Sweet Pumpkin Moment
A small glowing jack-o'-lantern sits between them. The woman gently reaches toward the pumpkin and playfully adjusts its position while the man watches her with an affectionate smile. Their hands briefly meet near the pumpkin, creating a natural, charming romantic moment.

Scene 6 (25–30 seconds): A Fairytale Ending
The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the couple sitting across from each other beneath warm hanging lights, surrounded by pumpkins and autumn decorations. They exchange a happy smile as the candlelight flickers. Finish with a beautiful wide shot of the glowing Halloween setting.

Visual Style: Cinematic realism, warm amber lighting, deep forest-green shadows, detailed textures, shallow depth of field, natural facial expressions, realistic hand movements, subtle camera motion, and atmospheric Halloween lighting.

Character Consistency: Keep the woman's face, hairstyle, clothing, and physical appearance consistent throughout every scene. Maintain the same male character's face and appearance in the photograph and the final date scenes. Ensure realistic transitions and natural movements.

Avoid: Face morphing, inconsistent characters, distorted hands, unnatural expressions, sudden outfit changes, cartoon styling, excessive visual effects, and unrealistic movement.

Mood: Romantic, mysterious, cozy, magical, and cinematic—a Halloween date that feels like a scene from a romantic fantasy film.

author: Diplomeme
title: THE RIDGE extreme skiing film
prompt:
“THE RIDGE”

30 SECONDS | 9:16 | PHOTOREALISTIC EXTREME SKIING DOCUMENTARY | SEEDANCE 2.5 | MULTISHOT

CAMERA

The entire video captures a lone professional skier descending a steep, remote alpine mountain, launching from a natural snow ridge, performing a controlled mid-air 360-degree spin, landing on the slope, and carving through deep powder directly toward the camera.

It feels like authentic extreme-sports documentary footage captured by a mountain film crew positioned around the descent.

Aerial establishing shot.

Long-lens mountain coverage.

Handheld follow camera.

Low ski-level tracking shots.

Close-up of ski boots and bindings.

Extreme close-up of ski edges cutting through powder.

Rear-follow downhill footage.

Side-profile tracking.

Wide shot of the complete jump.

Low-angle landing shot.

Close-up of body position and leg compression.

Camera operator reacts naturally to the skier’s speed and approaching snow spray.

Natural handheld shake.

Realistic tracking errors.

Brief focus adjustments.

Snow crystals striking the lens.

Natural motion blur.

Occasional partial obstruction by flying powder.

Realistic exposure changes between bright snow and dark mountain shadows.

No impossible camera positions.

No weightless floating camera movements.

No videogame camera.

No polished fantasy sports cinematography.

CHARACTER

SKIER:

One experienced adult professional skier.

Athletic build.

Dark forest-teal technical shell jacket.

Deep charcoal-teal ski trousers.

Black insulated gloves.

Matte dark helmet.

Reflective goggles with a subtle teal tint.

Black ski boots.

Two dark skis with realistic bindings and visible metal edges.

Two ski poles held naturally during the descent.

Realistic body proportions.

Natural fabric movement.

Visible frost and fine snow particles on clothing.

The skier moves with trained confidence but remains physically grounded.

Knees flex over uneven terrain.

Hips shift naturally during turns.

Arms adjust for balance.

The skier compresses at takeoff and landing.

No exaggerated superhero posture.

No unnecessary tricks.

No facial or equipment changes between shots.

The same skier, clothing, skis, bindings, and poles must remain consistent throughout the entire video.

SETTING

Remote high-altitude alpine mountain range.

A narrow snowy summit overlooking a steep, untouched powder slope.

A prominent natural snow ridge forms the jump.

Vast layered mountain peaks extend into the distance.

Deep winter atmosphere.

Cold morning daylight.

Thin windblown snow crossing the summit.

Dark rock formations partially exposed along distant ridgelines.

Soft atmospheric haze.

No ski resort.

No buildings.

No groomed trails.

No artificial ramps.

No other skiers.

The terrain must remain geographically consistent throughout the descent, with the same ridge, slope direction, and landing area.

COLOUR PALETTE — USE THE UPLOADED REFERENCE IMAGE:

Deep charcoal brown.

Near-black forest teal.

Dark evergreen.

Blue-green petrol.

Deep teal.

Saturated turquoise.

Muted jade.

Pale mint.

Soft icy sage.

The darkest colours define the shadowed mountain terrain, equipment, and distant rock formations. Petrol teal and turquoise appear subtly in the mountain shadows. Muted jade and pale mint guide the transition into the snow highlights. Snow remains naturally white with restrained cool teal shadows.

The entire film follows this palette without making the snow appear artificially coloured.

No purple shadows.

No orange-and-teal blockbuster grading.

No neon colours.

STORY

00:00–00:02.5 — THE SUMMIT

Ultra-wide aerial documentary shot of an immense alpine mountain range.

The camera glides toward a narrow snowy peak where the lone skier stands near the beginning of a steep descent.

The skier appears small against the enormous landscape.

Wind pushes loose powder across the ridge.

Cut to a wide side-profile shot of the skier standing still, looking down the mountain.

The terrain drops sharply ahead.

The skier plants both poles into the snow and studies the line.

The scale, isolation, and steepness of the mountain establish the challenge.

00:02.5–00:05 — PREPARATION

Medium handheld shot from behind the skier’s shoulder, looking down the slope.

The skier shifts their weight forward and bends their knees slightly.

Extreme close-up of a gloved hand tightening around a ski pole grip.

Cut to a foot-level close-up of the ski boots secured firmly inside the bindings.

The metal ski edges rest against the powder.

Fine snow moves across the skis in the wind.

The skier pushes both poles into the snow.

A brief pause.

Then the body moves forward.

⸻

00:05–00:07.5 — THE DROP

Low-angle foot shot from beside the skis.

The skier pushes off forcefully.

The ski edges release from their stationary position and begin cutting into the slope.

Powder sprays backward as the skier accelerates.

Cut to a wide downhill shot showing the skier committing to the steep descent.

The camera begins tracking from a parallel position slightly above the skier.

The first turn starts immediately.

The sound of the wind rises as speed increases.

⸻

00:07.5–00:10 — BUILDING SPEED

Low ski-level tracking shot.

The ski tips move rapidly across the lower frame as the skier carves through the first deep section of powder.

Cut to a medium side shot showing the skier shifting from one edge to the other.

The knees flex naturally.

The torso remains balanced over the skis.

A large plume of powder rises behind the outside ski and disperses downwind.

The camera briefly struggles to keep pace, allowing the skier to move toward the edge of the frame before catching up.

⸻

00:10–00:12.5 — THE RIDGE

Wide long-lens shot from across the mountain.

The skier descends toward a prominent natural snow ridge.

The ridge becomes larger in the frame as the skier approaches.

Cut to a rear-follow tracking shot, close enough to see the skier lowering into a compact stance.

The slope steepens.

The skier makes one final controlled adjustment to the line.

Both skis point toward the ridge.

The camera pans with the movement, keeping the takeoff point visible.

⸻

00:12.5–00:15 — TAKEOFF

Low-angle side shot positioned beside the natural ridge.

The skier reaches the lip at speed.

The legs extend naturally as both skis leave the snow.

A burst of powder erupts from the takeoff point.

Cut immediately to a wide side-on shot capturing the skier fully airborne against the distant mountain range.

The skier rises above the ridge with knees bent and arms positioned for balance.

Both skis remain attached and aligned with the body.

The camera pans smoothly enough to follow the trajectory while retaining natural operator movement.

⸻

00:15–00:17.5 — MID-AIR SPIN

Three-quarter side tracking shot of the skier rotating through one controlled 360-degree spin.

The rotation begins through the shoulders and hips.

The legs and skis follow naturally.

The skier maintains a compact position during the rotation, then begins extending the body to prepare for landing.

Cut to a longer side-profile view showing the complete rotation against the mountain landscape.

The distant ridgelines move naturally behind the skier.

The skis return toward the downhill direction before contact.

No excessive airtime.

No floating.

No additional spins.

⸻

00:17.5–00:20 — THE LANDING

Low-angle shot positioned downhill and slightly to the side of the landing zone.

The skier completes the rotation and reconnects with the slope on both skis.

The knees compress deeply to absorb the impact.

The torso pitches forward slightly, then stabilizes.

A dense cloud of powder erupts beneath the skis.

Cut to a close-up of the ski edges cutting into the snow as the skier transitions directly into the next turn.

The skier remains balanced and continues downhill without stopping.

The camera operator reacts to the burst of snow with a small handheld shake.

⸻

00:20–00:22.5 — THE CARVE

Front three-quarter tracking shot of the skier entering a powerful downhill carve.

The skier leans into the turn.

The outside ski cuts a clean arc through deep powder.

The inside ski follows naturally.

A wall of snow rises beside the skier and begins travelling toward the camera.

Cut to an extreme close-up of the ski edge slicing through granular snow.

Individual snow crystals catch the cold daylight.

The mountain background remains visible through the expanding plume.

⸻

00:22.5–00:25 — POWDER EXPLOSION

Low camera positioned close to the slope.

The skier passes across the frame at speed, driving into a deeper bank of powder.

The skis displace a large volume of snow, which rises in a physically believable arc.

The camera pans after the skier.

Flying powder partially obscures the lens.

Focus briefly shifts from the skier to the foreground snow crystals, then returns to the moving figure.

The skier continues carving downhill without losing control.

The action feels immediate and unplanned, as if the camera operator is struggling to keep the shot.

⸻

00:25–00:27.5 — THROUGH THE WHITEOUT

Rear-follow documentary shot.

The skier emerges from the drifting powder cloud farther down the slope.

The mountain opens ahead into a broad, untouched snowfield.

The skier makes another controlled turn, leaving a curved track across the powder.

The camera follows from behind and slightly above.

Wind carries loose snow across the frame.

The skier becomes briefly obscured again before reappearing against the pale mint and icy-sage snow highlights.

⸻

00:27.5–00:30 — SNOW INTO THE LENS

Dynamic low-angle tracking shot as the skier initiates one final aggressive carve across the camera’s field of view.

The skier passes close to the lens without making contact.

The ski edges throw a powerful wall of powder toward the camera.

The operator instinctively pulls back and tilts the camera.

Snow crystals strike the lens, and the image becomes partially obscured.

For a brief moment, the skier remains visible through the moving veil of snow, continuing downhill into the enormous alpine landscape.

The powder fills the frame.

The recording ends naturally within the snow cloud, with the sound of rushing snow and wind continuing into the final instant.

LIGHTING

Authentic cold alpine daylight.

Soft directional sunlight grazing the snow surface.

Deep forest-teal shadows.

Dark petrol-teal mountain layers.

Muted jade midtones.

Pale mint and icy-sage highlights.

Realistic white snow.

Natural atmospheric haze.

Subtle light scattering through airborne powder.

Strong but believable contrast between the bright slope and shaded terrain.

The skier’s clothing remains readable in both sunlight and shadow.

Snow crystals catch the light naturally during the jump, landing, and final carve.

No artificial glow.

No fantasy lighting.

No exaggerated lens flares.

No studio lighting.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE

The skier behaves like a trained professional navigating real mountain terrain.

They study the slope before committing.

They push off with believable force.

Their knees absorb terrain changes.

Their hips and shoulders coordinate naturally during turns.

Their body compresses at takeoff and landing.

The mid-air spin is controlled and physically plausible.

The landing produces visible compression and a realistic spray of snow.

The skier continues moving after landing without an unnatural pause.

Every movement has a clear physical cause.

The skier never looks directly into the camera or performs for it.

No exaggerated gestures.

No superhero movement.

No weightless floating.

No unnatural body twisting.

AUDIO

RAW EXTREME-SKIING DOCUMENTARY AUDIO.

Cold mountain wind.

Loose powder moving across the summit.

Ski poles contacting the snow.

Ski edges scraping and hissing against the surface.

Increasing wind rush during acceleration.

Deep powder spraying behind the skis.

Natural fabric movement.

Ski bindings and boots moving under pressure.

A brief, solid snow impact during landing.

The heavy rush of displaced powder during the final carve.

Snow crystals striking the camera.

The camera operator’s subtle movement and handling noise may be audible.

An original restrained cinematic instrumental score builds gradually from low atmospheric tones and subtle percussion.

The score intensifies during the approach to the ridge and the mid-air spin.

During the landing, the impact and snow sounds take priority.

The final powder explosion is dominated by rushing snow and wind.

No dialogue.

No voice-over.

No lyrics.

No artificial explosions.

No exaggerated action-movie sound effects.

VISUAL CHARACTER

Photorealistic extreme-sports documentary footage.

Large-format camera image quality.

Natural 24fps motion.

Realistic shutter blur.

24mm wide-angle landscape coverage.

35mm tracking shots.

50mm athlete coverage.

85–135mm long-lens mountain shots.

Natural handheld movement.

Purposeful tracking pans.

Realistic autofocus adjustments.

Fine film grain.

Restrained highlight roll-off.

Subtle atmospheric haze.

Realistic snow particles and powder density.

Natural depth of field.

Physically believable snow displacement.

Realistic motion and gravity.

No artificial slow motion except for a restrained emphasis on the aerial rotation if needed.

No perfect, frictionless camera movement.

No CGI-looking snow.

No videogame aesthetics.

No excessive sharpening.

No artificial teal overlays.

The reference palette must guide the image while preserving the natural appearance of snow, skin, and mountain terrain.

CONTINUITY

Same skier throughout.

Same helmet, goggles, jacket, trousers, gloves, boots, skis, bindings, and poles.

Same mountain and weather conditions.

The skier begins at the summit, pushes off, descends toward the visible ridge, launches from that ridge, performs one complete 360-degree spin, lands on the descending slope, and continues into the powder carve.

The takeoff and landing must occur on the same continuous mountain terrain.

The skier’s direction of travel remains consistent across cuts.

The ski edges respond correctly to each turn.

The body position changes naturally with speed, terrain, and impact.

Snow spray follows the direction of travel and disperses according to gravity and wind.

Tracks left in the snow remain visible when the camera returns to the same terrain.

Lighting and the colour palette remain consistent.

The final snow cloud must originate directly from the skier’s final carve.

NO TELEPORTATION.

NO DUPLICATED SKIER.

NO CHANGING EQUIPMENT.

NO IMPOSSIBLE SPINS.

NO FLOATING.

NO UNREALISTIC LANDINGS.

NO ARTIFICIAL SNOW PHYSICS.

NO FANTASY MOUNTAIN ENVIRONMENT.

NO MUSIC VIDEO.

NO VIDEOGAME CAMERA.

NO CGI LOOK.

NO AI-SLOP.

FINAL INTENT

A 30-second photorealistic extreme-skiing documentary that begins with silence and scale, builds through acceleration and commitment, peaks during a controlled aerial spin, and finishes with an explosive close-range powder carve.

Every shot must communicate either the scale of the mountain, the physical mechanics of skiing, the danger and precision of the jump, or the immediate impact of the snow.

Use authentic documentary camera angles: ultra-wide establishing shots, medium follow shots, close-ups, extreme close-ups, foot-level shots, long-lens coverage, side-on aerial coverage, low-angle landing shots, and a final powder-to-lens moment.

The entire film must follow the uploaded dark-teal-to-pale-mint colour palette while retaining natural alpine realism.

The final result should feel like a genuine professional mountain-sports documentary captured in extreme conditions—not a music video, not a fantasy film, and not a conventional sports advertisement.

title: Dragon helps Annie dry laundry (chaos)
prompt:
Photorealistic fantasy film. Warm golden-hour sunlight, medieval village backyard, wooden clothesline with white linen sheets and blouses, stone wall, thatched cottages in the background. Annie: young woman, long wavy blonde hair in small braids, small gold crown, cream blouse with rolled sleeves, dark corset bodice, blue skirt. Leo: young dragon, blue-purple scales, amber-gold eyes, small horns. Realistic fire, fabric textures, natural physics.
0-5s: Annie hangs wet laundry on the line, looking tired. Leo watches curiously. Annie sighs: "Leo, these will take hours to dry. Could you warm them up? A tiny bit of heat, please."
5-10s: Leo takes a deep breath and blasts a huge flame. The sheets catch fire instantly. Annie jumps back: "Wait, that's way too hot!"
10-17s: Burnt, smoking scraps hang on the line. Leo hides his head under his wing, looking guilty. Annie holds up a blackened sleeve, then tries not to laugh: "Leo, I asked for warm, not toast!"
17-23s: Leo carefully releases a tiny, gentle breath of warm air. A fresh wet sheet sways and dries softly in the sunlight. Annie smiles: "Yes! Just like that. Perfect!"
23-30s: Leo nuzzles Annie happily, his tail wagging. She laughs and hugs his snout: "Next time, let's just use the sun." Wide sunset shot, warm and funny.
Cinematic lighting, detailed scales, realistic flames, expressive acting. No subtitles, narration, logos or watermark.

title: Boxing · Counter EP 2
prompt:
制作一段完整30秒的高品质电影级风格化3D拳击动作动画短片。严格参考输入视频中的两名拳击手、人物外貌、肌肉比例、拳击手套、服装、擂台环境、动作设计、摄影机运动、灯光氛围和美术风格。整段视频呈现一场发生在昏暗地下拳击竞技场中的激烈重量级拳击比赛，两名身体极其强壮的拳击手展开充满力量、速度、技巧与压迫感的近距离对抗。动作必须具有真实的拳击运动力学、强烈的身体重量感、精准的拳击技术和电影级的打击反馈。

【核心人物设定】

拳击手A：年轻的黑人男性重量级拳击运动员，拥有极其强壮的身体、宽阔的肩膀、发达的胸肌、厚实的手臂、明显的腹部肌肉和结实的双腿。深棕色皮肤，黑色短卷发，头顶带有清晰的短发束造型，两侧头发较短。脸部轮廓硬朗，眉骨突出，眼神锐利，鼻梁宽厚，下颌线清晰，带有短胡须。

他穿着白色无袖拳击训练上衣，深海军蓝色宽松拳击短裤，腰部有明显的运动腰带结构，双手佩戴鲜艳的红色专业拳击手套，脚穿白色高帮拳击鞋。

拳击手A的动作风格灵活、快速、具有爆发力，擅长利用敏捷步伐、身体闪躲、连续刺拳和快速组合拳寻找进攻机会。

拳击手B：一名体型更加庞大、肌肉极其发达的成年男性重量级拳击手，拥有深棕色皮肤、接近剃光的短发、浓密的眉毛、强壮的颈部、巨大的斜方肌、宽厚的胸肌和极其粗壮的双臂。

他的上半身赤裸，肌肉轮廓非常明显，肩部、胸部、背部和手臂呈现出夸张但符合人体解剖学的力量感。

他穿着深海军蓝色拳击短裤，宽大的白色腰带，双手佩戴纯白色专业拳击手套，脚穿白色拳击鞋。

拳击手B的战斗风格更偏向力量型，使用厚重的直拳、强力摆拳和持续向前的压迫式进攻。他的动作虽然沉重，但具有职业重量级拳击运动员的速度和爆发力。

两名拳击手始终保持清晰的外观区别：拳击手A穿白色无袖上衣、戴红色拳套；拳击手B赤裸上身、戴白色拳套。

【场景与环境】

故事发生在一座巨大而昏暗的室内地下拳击竞技场。

建筑拥有高耸的深灰色工业风拱形天花板、厚重的石质立柱、巨大的金属桁架、暗色墙壁以及高处模糊的观众席。

拳击擂台位于竞技场中央，拥有明亮的米白色拳击地板、四周围绕的白色拳击围绳、深蓝色角柱和黑色金属支撑结构。

擂台地板具有柔和的织物纹理，运动员移动时可以看到鞋底与地板之间的轻微摩擦。

擂台上方悬挂着一组巨大的工业金属吊灯，暖白色聚光灯垂直照射在拳击擂台中央。

周围空间笼罩在深蓝灰色阴影与轻微的空气雾气中，灯光穿过空气中的细小尘埃，形成具有体积感的光束。

远处观众席处于阴影之中，可以看到模糊的观众轮廓和少量环境灯光。

整个竞技场具有地下拳击比赛的压迫感、庄严感和史诗级体育电影氛围。

【0–3秒｜激烈拳击对抗开场】

画面直接从两名拳击手正在擂台中央交锋的中景开始。

拳击手A位于画面左侧，拳击手B位于画面右侧。

两人保持标准拳击站姿，双脚前后错开，膝盖微屈，身体重心稳定，双手举起保护面部。

拳击手A迅速向前移动，左手红色拳套快速打出一记刺拳，直奔拳击手B的面部。

拳击手B立刻抬起白色拳套，利用前臂与拳套挡住进攻。

prompt:

Character: A young woman in her mid-20s, shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain dark baseball cap with no logo, a black windbreaker jacket, baggy black track pants, white ankle socks and chunky white-and-grey sneakers, white fitted arm sleeves under her jacket. Brave, focused and breathing hard from running. Keep face, hair and outfit identical in every shot.

Long almond-shaped nails with a neat pink, yellow, green, orange and purple candy-inspired manicure. No gloves. Her ponytail has a simple pink tie. Keep the same garment, neckline, accessories, hairstyle and manicure in every shot.

ONE CONSISTENT CANDY WORLD

An extravagant pink-and-peach candy metropolis beneath a bright cyan-blue sky with soft pink clouds. A glossy candy-pink tiled floor creates beautiful reflections. Rounded candy palaces, spiral candy towers, oversized peach gummy rings and delicate sugar-crystal details fill the background. Small metallic confetti pieces catch the light.

The central landmark is a monumental UPRIGHT PEACH GUMMY RING PORTAL, approximately four meters tall. Its thick rounded body has orange-red and golden-yellow gummy coloring, a pale creamy-yellow rear layer and sparkling sugar crystals, matching an enlarged version of Reference 2. Its lower arc is recessed into the pink floor so the large central opening reaches floor level. MILA stands on the floor just behind this opening, framed by the ring. The camera can move through the open center toward her.

Beside the portal stands a second, smaller giant peach gummy ring approximately MILA's height. Its lower edge is secured in the floor. It stays in the same place, and its outer side is accessible for MILA to lean against later. Both giant rings are fixed architectural set pieces. Their surfaces glow softly at the colored gummy edges, with crisp sparkling sugar grains.

Ordinary loose peach rings remain small relative to MILA's hands and mouth. Giant candy architecture is deliberately oversized scenery. Keep the portal, smaller ring, floor and surrounding towers spatially consistent across the sequence.

LIGHTING AND CAMERA

Bright, high-end commercial lighting: a broad soft key on MILA, controlled glossy highlights on her outfit, luminous peach-colored reflections through the gummy edges and crisp highlights on individual sugar crystals. Strong separation between the woman, product and colorful background. Saturated pink, peach-orange, warm red and golden yellow with cyan in the sky and reflections. Dreamy highlight bloom without washing out the MILA POP logo, candy texture or facial detail.

Use an ultra-wide low-angle opening, a rapid controlled push-in, energetic whip transitions, extreme macro close-ups, brief slow-motion candy flight and clean match cuts motivated by rings crossing the lens. Keep MILA's face and body realistically proportioned. Macro depth of field should isolate each candy while keeping its open hole, rounded thickness and sugar coating readable.

The camera is operated externally, with polished commercial movement. Every shot should feel deliberate, vivid and expensive. Keep the woman photorealistic even when the environment and transitions are fantastical.

15-SECOND SHOT SEQUENCE

0:00–0:03 — MILA'S PEACH-RING HERO ENTRANCE

Open immediately on a dramatic ultra-wide low-angle view of the candy metropolis. MILA is already standing confidently just behind the enormous peach-ring portal, framed inside its opening, with the smaller giant ring beside it. Her complete silhouette, pink outfit and the scale of the world are immediately clear. A few ordinary peach rings and tiny confetti pieces drift through the foreground.

Perform a fast, smooth push-in through the portal's open center, moving from the establishing view to a flattering waist-up hero shot. MILA shifts her weight naturally onto one hip, looks directly into the lens and gives a mischievous half-smile. She raises one MILA POP Peach Loops pouch beside her face, with its front facing the camera. Her fingers hold the edges without covering the main logo.

End this beat with her face and the recognizable pouch sharing the frame. The high ponytail moves lightly with her body.

0:03–0:06 — OPEN THE PACK, RELEASE THE PEACH RINGS

Use a fast whip transition into an extreme close-up of the same pouch and MILA's hands. She holds the upper left and upper right edges and tears open the top seam in one clear outward motion. Show the flexible material stretching and the seam separating; her fingers remain outside the pouch.

At the exact moment the opening appears, push toward it and transition through it into a spectacular macro burst of peach gummy rings. The tear motivates this fantastical advertising transition. Orange-red and golden-yellow rings rush toward and past the lens in controlled slow motion, surrounded by a few sparkling sugar particles.

Track through the flying rings with a quick shallow arc. Some face the lens, revealing their open centers; others rotate to show their rounded gummy thickness and pale-yellow undersides. The sugar crystals catch tiny flashes of light. Keep the rings separate and individually readable, without fused chains or interlocking loops.

The macro burst briefly opens up to reveal MILA and the same candy world behind it. One ring rotates until its hole aligns with the lens. Push through that open hole in a seamless match transition into the next close-up.

0:06–0:10 — PLAYFUL CANDY BEAUTY MONTAGE

Build four short, rhythmic shots, each approximately 0.7–0.9 seconds, followed by a fast transition:

1. Extreme macro of one small peach gummy ring held delicately by its outer edge between MILA's thumb and index finger. Its hole is unobstructed. Her colorful manicure, individual sugar crystals, orange-red upper surface and pale-yellow lower layer are sharply visible.

2. Close-up of MILA holding that same ring a short distance in front of one eye. The camera aligns with the center hole so her eye is visible THROUGH THE HOLE. She looks directly into the lens with a teasing expression. The ring stays outside her face and does not touch her eye.

3. Extreme close-up of her glossy lips and fingertips as she brings the ring to her slightly parted lips and bites a small piece from its outer edge. The gummy compresses slightly at the bite, then separates cleanly. Her hand withdraws with the remaining ring showing a visible bite missing. No long sticky strands or unnatural stretching.

4. A slightly wider beauty close-up as she closes her lips, makes one subtle chewing movement and gives a pleased, cheeky smile. If the candy remains in frame, retain the same visible bite. Keep the performance quick and understated.

A glossy translucent pink sugar bubble from the surrounding fantasy environment sweeps across the foreground, expands until it covers the lens and pops into the next shot. This is an external candyland transition element, not chewing gum blown from MILA's mouth. Complete the pop by 0:10.

0:10–0:13 — GIANT GUMMY RING, CANDY RAIN

Reveal a flattering three-quarter full-body view of MILA leaning lightly with one hip and forearm against the fixed smaller giant peach ring beside the main portal. Her pink outfit, narrow waist and full rounded silhouette remain clearly readable. Three or four ordinary peach rings are already visible in her free hand.

She straightens slightly and tosses the rings upward in one playful motion. The camera follows with a rapid upward tilt. The rings spread apart, reach the tops of their arcs and begin falling. One passing ring moves very close to the lens; its sugary outer edge sweeps across the frame and creates a motivated wipe.

Reveal MILA again in a medium close-up beneath a stylized shower of small peach rings. Keep her face unobstructed. She laughs, looks into the lens and gives one quick playful wink as the camera makes a short dolly-in. Her ponytail swings naturally. The giant ring portal and candy towers remain recognizable behind her.

0:13–0:15 — MILA POP PRODUCT HERO ENDING

A peach ring sweeps directly across the lens, transitioning into a separate polished advertising product shot on a glossy candy-pink display surface within the same world.

One pristine, unopened MILA POP Peach Loops pouch matching Reference 1 drops a very short distance onto the center of the surface and settles upright with believable weight and a small flexible crinkle. This is a fresh product insert; do not show the previously torn pouch magically resealing. There is only one visible pouch in this final shot.

Several small peach gummy rings land around its base with soft, brief bounces, slight gummy compression and short rolls before settling. The pouch remains stable, with the MILA POP logo and Peach Loops name facing the camera. The monumental peach-ring portal glows behind it, with the environment simplified through shallow depth of field.

MILA stands farther behind the product, framed by the portal, slightly offset so she does not block the package. She holds one whole small peach ring beside her lips and smiles confidently. She remains recognizable but secondary to the hero product.

Finish with a short, smooth push toward the pouch while a few tiny confetti pieces and peach rings pass through the outer edges of the frame. Keep the central branding unobstructed. Let the final composition settle for the last half-second: sharp pink-and-coral pouch, clearly shaped sugar-coated rings, pink reflective surface and softly glowing candy world.

AUDIO AND RHYTHM

An energetic, playful pop/electropop instrumental with bright synths, a punchy beat and sparkling accents. Synchronize the major visual beats to the music: pouch reveal, tear, candy burst, beauty cuts, bubble pop, upward toss and final product landing.

Add crisp pouch crinkling and tearing, short airy transition whooshes, soft gummy landing sounds, delicate sugar-particle ticks and one clean playful bubble-pop sound. Keep the mix polished and lively. No spoken dialogue, narration or sung lyrics.

PACING

Exactly 15 seconds. Start inside the candy world immediately, with no title card or slow introduction. A new visual beat roughly every 1–2 seconds, with faster cuts during the beauty montage. Use brief slow motion only to showcase flying rings; keep MILA's gestures lively. Preserve the scheduled final two seconds for the product ending.

CONTINUITY AND PRODUCT ACCURACY

One consistent adult MILA, one dark-brown high ponytail, one pink outfit with the same deep neckline and the same body proportions throughout.

Keep all recognizable packaging graphics faithful to Reference 1. Perspective, natural folds and the visible tear may change the physical pouch, but the artwork must not morph, migrate or become a different brand. Keep hero logos legible.

Keep ordinary candies faithful to Reference 2: peach gummy rings with open center holes, orange-red and golden-yellow upper surfaces, pale creamy-yellow undersides and fine sugar coating. No printed letters, hard candy shells, solid discs, gummy bears, gummy worms or unrelated candy colors. Keep the center holes open as the rings turn; only the bitten ring may have its circular outline interrupted.

Hands must maintain believable finger positions and object contact. The pouch tears at its upper seam. The bite removes a small piece and leaves a visible missing section. Tossed rings separate and follow coherent arcs. The final pouch is supported by the surface.

Maintain one coherent candyland design and geography. No sudden wardrobe or hairstyle changes, no face drift, no extra fingers, no fused hands, no duplicate MILA, no warped anatomy and no unrelated backgrounds.

No captions, subtitles, extra advertising slogans, watermarks or invented on-screen text. The only visible lettering belongs to the reference packaging. The loose candies and giant ring sculptures have no lettering.

author: DeepBlueX0
title: Magic academy girl · 360° bullet time
prompt:
主题：魔法学院少女 Cosplay × 360° Bullet Time × 时间冻结 × 俏皮表情

以新参考图片作为视频第一帧及唯一视觉参考，严格保留人物面容、金色长发、学院制服、跪坐姿势、双手叉腰、室内陈设与初始俯拍构图。

10-second continuous ONE-TAKE VIDEO.

核心效果：TRUE 360° PHYSICAL CAMERA ORBIT × ABSOLUTE BODY FREEZE × LIVING FACIAL EXPRESSIONS × STRONG 3D PARALLAX.

【360°摄影机环绕｜最高优先级】

摄影机从参考图的近距离高机位俯拍视角出发，以人物躯干为固定中心，沿水平圆形轨道向左连续完成完整360°环绕。

Physical camera dolly × True 3D circular orbit × Full 360-degree revolution.

10秒内完成整整一圈，平均角速度36°/秒，近似匀速运动。

完整轨迹：

0° → 45° → 90° → 135° → 180° → 225° → 270° → 315° → 360°。

摄影机高度、俯视角度与环绕半径基本恒定，镜头持续朝向人物头部与躯干中心。

环绕过程中依次呈现人物的正面、左右侧面、背面，以及地毯、家具与周围环境的真实三维视差。

人物始终保持原有朝向，绝不随摄影机旋转。

禁止原地摇镜头、人物旋转、背景旋转、假3D转场及镜头切换。

10秒结束时摄影机准确返回第一帧的空间位置、视角与构图，完成360°闭环。

【人物与身体冻结】

一位成年女性，金色长发略显凌乱，穿着黑绿色魔法学院长袍、白色衬衫、绿色条纹领带、灰色百褶裙与黑色长袜。

人物坐跪于复古花纹地毯上，双膝分置身体前侧，两条小腿向身体两侧自然折叠，双手叉腰，双肘向外展开。

保持参考图中的身体重心、腿部折叠方式、手掌位置、头部整体朝向与制服褶皱。

头骨空间位置、肩背、躯干、双臂、双手、双腿与脚部完全静止。

金色发丝、长袍、领带、裙摆及整个室内环境完全冻结。

The body and world are frozen. Only the eyes and facial expressions remain alive.

【10秒摄影机运动 × 面部表演】

0–2.5秒｜0° → 90°｜傲娇生气

摄影机从正面高机位向左环绕。

人物保持参考图中的皱眉鼓腮表情，眼神发现摄影机移动，眉毛微微上挑，露出疑惑又不服气的神情。

眼球在自然视野范围内跟随摄影机。

2.5–5秒｜90° → 180°｜偷偷得意

摄影机继续经过人物侧面，逐渐进入后侧视角。

人物嘴角轻轻上扬，鼓起的脸颊逐渐放松，浮现短暂俏皮笑意，轻轻眨眼一次。

摄影机进入视野之外时，眼球停止追踪。

5–7.5秒｜180° → 270°｜假装严肃

摄影机从人物背后继续向左环绕。

金色长发、学院长袍、地毯及古典家具形成明显空间视差。

人物身体维持绝对静止。面部表情自然过渡为故作严肃，嘴角收敛。

7.5–10秒｜270° → 360°｜再次鼓腮

摄影机继续向左环绕，逐渐回到最初的高机位俯拍视角。

人物重新发现镜头，眼神短暂对视，微微挑眉，露出俏皮神情。

最后0.5秒重新鼓起脸颊、轻轻皱眉，恢复参考图中的初始表情。

摄影机完成完整360°环绕，准确回到初始机位，形成首尾自然闭环。

【面部活动规则】

只允许眼球、眼睑、眉毛、嘴角、脸颊与局部面部肌肉活动。

允许自然眨眼、挑眉、鼓腮、抿嘴、轻笑、假装生气等细腻表情。

面部表情变化保持同一人物的五官比例、骨骼结构与真实皮肤质感。

头部整体位置和朝向始终锁定，不转头、不点头、不晃动身体、不张嘴说话。

【空间与摄影质感】

保留参考图中的复古魔法学院卧室：深色木质家具、古典书籍、金属装饰、复古箱柜、床铺与繁复花纹地毯。

所有物体保持固定三维空间位置，不随镜头移动而重新排列。

采用真实CCD直闪摄影质感，近距离广角俯拍，直射闪光、明显明暗反差、自然皮肤纹理、少量高光过曝与轻微数字噪点。

摄影机环绕时，人物与家具的透视、遮挡及可见表面随观察位置自然变化。环境光源固定在真实空间中，保留直闪摄影的视觉基调。

真实人体比例，真实服装材质，自然未经精修的生活抓拍质感。

禁止AI塑料皮肤、人物变脸、肢体变形、服装结构变化、场景漂移及额外人物。

左下角保留参考图签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后，固定在画面坐标中。

9:16竖版 × 10秒 × 一镜到底 × 真实360°向左环绕 × 身体与环境冻结 × 灵动面部表情 × 首尾闭环。

FINAL PRIORITY: The physical camera must complete exactly one full 360-degree leftward orbit around the stationary subject within 10 seconds, returning to its original elevated position and framing. Strong genuine 3D parallax. The entire body and environment remain frozen. Only natural facial expressions and eye movements are allowed，9:16

title: Baseball prompt on the Bundy family
prompt:
Original prompt by @ElsaSofia__AI

VIDEO PROMPT — 27.2 seconds, 16:9, live-action cinematic realism, gritty desaturated teal-grey color grade, overcast cold daylight, anamorphic shallow depth of field, mostly handheld energy with a few whip pans. Dark-comedy superhero tone played straight. Keep faces, costumes and locations identical in every shot.  CHARACTERS (repeat in every part) PITCHER: blond man with slicked-back hair, a tight smirk, in a skin-tight royal-blue superhero suit with a gold belt, gold eagle-shaped epaulettes on the shoulders, a long red-and-white-striped cape with a blue star field at the top, red gloves with brown-red wristbands, and red boots. WOMAN BATTER: blonde woman with a white headband, in a white-and-gold superhero costume with a gold star emblem and a small black ribbon on the chest, gold belt, gold gauntlets, gold boots, and a gold cape. LEATHER-JACKET BATTER: man with a short beard, in a brown-maroon leather jacket over a black shirt. TEAM BEHIND THE PLATE: a tattooed bearded man in a navy sleeveless top with a gold chain, a lean man in a yellow tank top and blue patterned trousers carrying a bat across his shoulders, and masked soldiers in black tactical gear, balaclavas and helmets (one squatting as the catcher). BEARDED FIELDER: man with a full black beard and swept-up dark hair, in a long dark-navy coat over a dark shirt. YOUNG FIELDER: young man with short brown hair, a teal graphic T-shirt, a green jacket, blue jeans, white sneakers and backpack straps. LOCATION: a baseball diamond with a dirt mound and a grass outfield, surrounded by tall bare trees and evergreen woods, a long lawn with clipped hedges and a fallen log, a stormy sky with dark clouds and lightning.  ===== PART 1 (00:00-00:08) =====  SHOT 1 (00:00-00:00.4) — Smirk Close-up of the pitcher with both hands clasped behind his head, a tight smug smirk. Blurred woods behind. Speed: REAL TIME.  SHOT 2 (00:00.4-00:01.4) — The Leg Kick Wide static shot of the pitcher on the mound, hands still behind his head. He lifts one leg high, boot toward the sky, cape swinging. A dark figure stands far back along the fence.  SHOT 3 (00:01.4-00:02.1) — The Stride Wide shot with a slow push-in. He swings his arm back, turns his torso and strides forward, cape billowing.  SHOT 4 (00:02.1-00:03.0) — The Throw Close-up. The baseball is held high in his red-gloved hand, then he whips his arm forward and releases it with a fierce, focused face.  SHOT 5 (00:03.0-00:03.7) — Ball at the Lens The baseball flies straight at the camera, large and sharp, with the pitcher a blurred figure behind it.  SHOT 6 (00:03.7-00:04.1) — At the Plate The woman batter, in side view, holds the bat cocked back, her eyes on the pitch. The tattooed man stands behind her on the left, and the leather-jacket man stands lower in the center holding a bat low. Evergreen hedge and trees behind.  SHOT 7 (00:04.1-00:05.4) — The Swing A white blur of the ball whips past the lens, then she swings the bat across the frame with her hair flying and follows through hard. Speed: slightly SLOW MOTION (about 50% speed).  SHOT 8 (00:05.4-00:06.4) — The Ball Flies The hit ball flies away and upward over the green outfield and the tree line, shrinking against the trees.  SHOT 9 (00:06.4-00:08.0) — Forest Run Tracking shot in a bare forest. The bearded fielder sprints through the trees with bark and trunks blurring in the foreground, glaring up with one arm reaching forward.  ===== PART 2 (00:08-00:19.7) =====  SHOT 10 (00:08.0-00:08.6) — Empty Lawn Static shot of an empty lawn with a clipped hedge and a fallen log.  SHOT 11 (00:08.6-00:09.6) — Sprint Low tracking shot. The woman in the white-and-gold costume sprints along the tall hedge with her gold cape streaming behind her.  SHOT 12 (00:09.6-00:11.7) — Pointing the Bat The leather-jacket batter, in the foreground, holds a baseball bat out at arm's length, pointing it toward the camera with a calm stare. Behind him are masked soldiers in black helmets and the lean man in the yellow tank top with a bat across his shoulders. A bare tree with thin branches behind. Speed: REAL TIME.  SHOT 13 (00:11.7-00:13.3) — Batting Stance He draws the bat back behind his shoulder in a batting stance, glaring forward. A masked catcher squats at the left, with the masked soldiers and the tattooed man behind.  SHOT 14 (00:13.3-00:14.2) — Second Wind-Up Low-angle shot of the pitcher with both hands raised above his head holding the ball, then the leg kick, boot toward the camera, cape swinging.  SHOT 15 (00:14.2-00:16.5) — Second Pitch Low angle. He rotates, brings his arm back and whips the throw forward, ball leaving his hand near the top of the frame. He glares after it.  SHOT 16 (00:16.5-00:17.5) — The Swing Close-up of the leather-jacket batter swinging the bat through the frame and following through, grim and focused.  SHOT 17 (00:17.5-00:18.7) — Run Wide view from behind the masked catcher. He swings, drops the bat, which falls to the dirt, and sprints off toward the bases. A tiny pale figure stands far away on the mound.  SHOT 18 (00:18.7-00:19.7) — Eyes on the Sky Low angle against stormy dark clouds. The bearded fielder looks up, tracking the ball, jaw tight. Lightning flickers in the clouds behind him.  ===== PART 3 (00:19.7-00:27.2) =====  SHOT 19 (00:19.7-00:21.8) — The Dash Wide shot across a lawn with hedges and dark woods. The young fielder sprints toward the camera, passes it in a blur, and then the bearded fielder runs in at the right edge and blurs past the lens, his coat sleeve whipping across the frame.  SHOT 20 (00:21.8-00:24.0) — Sky Collision Extreme low angle against a stormy sky with treetops along the bottom. Both men leap up into the air, the young fielder on the left, the bearded fielder rising vertically. They collide in mid-air as a bolt of lightning strikes at the right, then tumble together downward. Speed: SLOW MOTION (about 30-40% speed).  SHOT 21 (00:24.0-00:25.5) — The Crash Ground-level shot. The two crash onto the grass, the bearded fielder's legs flying up and tumbling over the young fielder, who lies flat on the lawn.  SHOT 22 (00:25.5-00:27.2) — Aftermath Ground-level close shot. The bearded fielder lies on his back, grimacing, one hand pressed on his chest. The young fielder pushes himself up on his arms and sits up in his green jacket, glancing down at him. Hold, then end.  MASTER EFFECTS INVENTORY 1. Pitcher wind-up with high leg kick and cape swing (Shots 2-4, 14-15). 2. Ball-at-the-lens POV (Shot 5). 3. Slowed bat swing (Shot 7). 4. Ball flight over the outfield and forest tracking run (Shots 8-9). 5. Stormy sky with lightning and the slow-motion mid-air collision (Shots 18, 20). 6. Ground-level crash and tumble (Shots 21-22).  SPEED SUMMARY Slow motion: Shot 7 (about 50%), Shot 20 (about 30-40%). Everything else: real time.  ENERGY ARC Part 1 (0-8s): the pitch, the big hit, the sprinting fielder. Part 2 (8-20s): second batter, second pitch, the hit into the stormy sky. Part 3 (20-27s): the leap, the lightning collision, and the crash. AUDIO / SOUND DESIGN (synced to the on-screen action; no spoken dialogue)  GLOBAL: a continuous low, tense sound bed under the whole video (cold outdoor wind and a deep, quiet ambient hum). No singing, no spoken words. Hard-hitting sports and impact effects at the peaks, tense and quiet in between.  PART 1 (00:00-00:08) SHOT 1-2 (00:00-00:01.4): wind in the woods, soft cape flutter, a faint creak of leather as the pitcher lifts his leg. SHOT 3-4 (00:01.4-00:03.0): rising tension, the whoosh of the arm swinging, a sharp snap as the ball leaves his glove hand. SHOT 5 (00:03.0-00:03.7): a fast whoosh as the ball flies at the lens, the sound growing closer. SHOT 6 (00:03.7-00:04.1): near-silence, a held breath, a creak of the bat handle in her grip. SHOT 7 (00:04.1-00:05.4): the sound builds, then a huge bat crack with a deep bass thump at about 00:04.5, followed by a long, stretched, slightly slowed whoosh as she follows through, and a ringing tail. SHOT 8 (00:05.4-00:06.4): the ball whistling and fading away over the field. SHOT 9 (00:06.4-00:08.0): fast footsteps crunching on dead leaves, branches whipping past, heavy breathing, low tension rumble.  PART 2 (00:08-00:19.7) SHOT 10-11 (00:08.0-00:09.6): wind on the lawn, light running footsteps and cloth flapping as she sprints. SHOT 12-13 (00:09.6-00:13.3): quiet and tense, a bat creak, a wooden knock as he raises it, distant wind. author: ai_lifehack55
title: HACH MODE Thirteen Shot Fashion Typography
prompt:
【入力項目】ここだけ書き換える。値は英語の大文字、1語ずつ（3〜9文字がおすすめ）。
WORD_1 = "FASHION"
WORD_2 = "EDITORIAL"
WORD_3 = "DESIGN"
TITLE_1 = "HACH"
TITLE_2 = "MODE"

[DECLARATION]
総尺15秒、アスペクト比16:9。
KINETIC TYPOGRAPHY × EDITORIAL FASHION FILM。
同じ1人の人物を主役にした、ハイエンドなファッション誌のティーザー映像。実写のファッション撮影のカットと、特大の文字が主役のグラフィックカードが、ハードカットで交互に切り替わる。文字カードでは、まず文字がはっきり読め、そのあと主人公が文字に重なる、横切る、または前に立つ。後半は短いカットで加速し、最後だけ長いタイトルカードで完全に静止して締まる。

[REFERENCE]
@image1 は主人公のキャラクターシートで、同じ1人の正面、横、後ろの全身と顔のアップが並んでいる。全カットで、主人公の顔、髪型、体型、服装、服の色と柄を保つ。主人公の服は、深緑の身頃・マスタードの肩・セージグリーンの袖とリブの袖口のオーバーサイズのナイロンジャケット（前は開けている）、白いクロップトップ、マスタードのタック入りワイドパンツ（左右の脚が分かれたパンツ）、白いスニーカー。シートの白い背景、並び、区切り線は映像に出さず、画面に出る主人公は常に1人。シートのポーズは使わない。

[CONDITION]
画風：実写のファッション撮影。スタジオ照明、自然な肌と布の質感。全カットで同じ画風。
色：背景と図形の色は、赤、マスタード、深緑、白、黒だけ。撮影のカットの背景は、継ぎ目のない明るいグレーのスタジオ。Shot 2、4、6、9〜13 の背景は、必ず指定の色で塗り、グレーにしない。主人公の服と肌の色は、背景や円の色に染めず、常にシートどおりに保つ。
服の形：動いても、ジャケット、クロップトップ、ワイドパンツの形と丈はシートどおりで変わらない。
文字カード（Shot 2、4、6）：指定の色で塗られた単色背景。指定の英単語1語を、文字数にかかわらず画面の幅いっぱいに収まる大きさで、極太のサンセリフ体の大文字で、正しい綴りで、画面の中央の高さに表示する。文字の色は、背景に対して最も読みやすい黒か白で、透かさない（Shot 13 も同じ）。カットの開始直後に文字が素早く現れ、はっきり読める状態になってから主人公が重なる。カードの構図とグラフィックは、各 Shot の START で指定する。グラフィックの層は常に動き、手前の層ほど速く動く視差がある。
画面に出る文字は、入力項目の WORD_1、WORD_2、WORD_3、TITLE_1、TITLE_2 の値の英単語だけで、変数名そのものは表示しない。Shot 2、4、6、13 以外の Shot には文字を一切出さない。カットが切り替わった瞬間に、前のカットの文字は完全に消える。

[SHOT FLOW]
[Shot 1｜0.00~1.10秒]
[START] 明るいグレーのスタジオ。主人公の顔の超クローズアップ。髪が顔の一部にかかり、目線は下を向いている。
[MAIN EVENT] カメラがゆっくり寄り、主人公が目線を上げて、カメラを静かに見つめる。浅い被写界深度。
[END] カメラを見つめる主人公の顔の超クローズアップ。
[Shot 2｜1.10~2.20秒]
[START] 赤の単色背景。画面の中央に、画面の高さいっぱいの深緑の大きな円。円の中に、主人公の顔の大きなクローズアップが薄く透けて重なる。背景の全面に粗いハーフトーンの網点。その上に、WORD_1 の英単語が画面の幅いっぱいに現れる。
[MAIN EVENT] 文字がはっきり読めたあと、主人公の上半身が右から勢いよく滑り込み、文字の右半分に大きく重なって止まる。滑り込みに合わせて、太いブラシストロークが斜めに走る。
[END] 文字の右半分に、主人公の上半身が大きく重なった構図。
[Shot 3｜2.20~3.10秒]
[START] 主人公のジャケットの襟元のマクロのクローズアップ。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公の手が襟元を整える。生地の質感と縫い目がはっきり見え、カメラが横へ滑る。
[END] 手が襟元から離れ、生地の質感が画面いっぱいに残る。
[Shot 4｜3.10~4.20秒]
[START] 深緑の単色背景。画面の左半分を占めるマスタードの大きな円と、その周りの細い同心円。画面の右側に、主人公の目元の大きなクローズアップが薄く透けて重なる。背景の全面に粗いハーフトーンの網点。その上に、WORD_2 の英単語が下からせり上がる。
[MAIN EVENT] 文字がはっきり読めたあと、主人公の黒いシルエットが、手前を左から右へ素早く横切る。細い直線が斜めに走る。
[END] シルエットが画面の外へ抜け、文字だけが残る。
[Shot 5｜4.20~5.60秒]
[START] 明るいグレーのスタジオ。床すれすれの低い位置から見上げる、遠くに立つ主人公の全身。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公がカメラに向かって堂々と歩いてくる。ジャケットと髪が歩みに合わせて揺れ、ワイドパンツは左右の脚が分かれたまま歩く。カメラは後ろへ下がりながら追う。
[END] 主人公の全身が画面いっぱいに近づいた構図。
[Shot 6｜5.60~6.70秒]
[START] マスタードの単色背景。画面の高さいっぱいの赤の大きな円。画面の端から端まで、太いブラシストロークが2本、斜めに横切る。背景の全面に粗いハーフトーンの網点。その上に、WORD_3 の英単語が現れる。
[MAIN EVENT] 文字がはっきり読めたあと、主人公の後ろ姿の全身が文字の前に立ち、ジャケットの背中の配色を見せる。細い同心円がゆっくり回る。
[END] 文字の前に、主人公の後ろ姿が立つ構図。
[Shot 7｜6.70~7.80秒]
[START] 明るいグレーのスタジオ。主人公が背中を向けて立つ全身。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公が勢いよく振り返り、髪とジャケットの裾が大きく翻る。カメラは横から素早く回り込み、振り返る瞬間に、背景が横に流れて線になるほどの速いホイップパンが入る。
[END] 振り返った主人公が、カメラを見据える。
[Shot 8｜7.80~8.60秒]
[START] 明るいグレーのスタジオ。主人公の足元のクローズアップ。白いスニーカーとワイドパンツの裾。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公がその場で体をひねる。カメラは足元から腰まで素早くなめ上げる。
[END] 腰の高さの、ジャケットの裾とワイドパンツ。
[Shot 9｜8.60~9.00秒]
[START] 赤の単色背景。主人公の後ろに、画面の高さいっぱいの深緑の大きな円。背景の全面に粗いハーフトーンの網点。円の前に主人公の全身。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公が片手を腰に当てて、ポーズを決める。文字なし。
[END] 円の前で、ポーズを決めた主人公。
[Shot 10｜9.00~9.40秒]
[START] 深緑の単色背景。画面の左半分に、主人公の顔の大きなクローズアップが薄く透けて重なる。画面の右側に主人公の全身。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公が体を斜めに向けて、肩越しにカメラを見る。文字なし。
[END] 顔のクローズアップの層の横で、肩越しにカメラを見る主人公。
[Shot 11｜9.40~9.80秒]
[START] マスタードの単色背景。主人公の後ろに、赤の大きな円が2つ、少しずれて重なる。円の前に主人公の全身。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公が両腕を下ろし、まっすぐカメラを見据える。文字なし。
[END] 重なった円の前で、カメラを見据える主人公。
[Shot 12｜9.80~11.00秒]
[START] 赤の単色背景。主人公の後ろに、画面の高さいっぱいのマスタードの円と、細い線の同心円。背景の全面に粗いハーフトーンの網点。円の前に主人公の全身。
[MAIN EVENT] 主人公がその場で速く一回転し、髪とジャケットの裾が大きく翻る。ワイドパンツはパンツの形のまま。回転に合わせて、太いブラシストロークが主人公の後ろを弧を描いて走る。正面に向き直って片手を腰に当て、カメラを見据える。決まった瞬間に、カメラも円も止まる。文字なし。
[END] 円とブラシストロークの前で、決めのポーズの主人公が膝上の構図で静止する。
[Shot 13｜11.00~15.00秒]
[START] 最初のコマから、すべての層がそろっている：赤の単色背景。画面の右寄りに、画面の高さいっぱいの深緑の大きな円。円の中に、主人公の顔の大きなクローズアップが明るく透けて重なる。円の周りに細い白い同心円の弧。背景の全面に粗いハーフトーンの網点。円の前に、主人公の全身が立つ。
[MAIN EVENT] 画面の左半分に、縦長の極太の白い大文字で TITLE_1 と TITLE_2 の英単語が上下2段で現れ、2段で画面の高さの3分の2を占める。文字は主人公の左側にあり、主人公に隠れず、すべての文字がはっきり読める。画面の左上の角に、短い細い白い縦線が伸びる。文字がはっきり読めたあとも、同心円の弧と網点の層はゆっくり回り続け、カメラはゆっくり寄り続ける。終わりの直前に、主人公が体を斜めに向け、片手を腰に当て、もう一方の手でジャケットの襟をつかみ、片脚に重心をかけた全身の決めポーズをとり、決めた瞬間にカメラも円の層も止まる。
[END] 主人公、文字、円、縦線、カメラがすべて完全に静止したまま、最後の約1秒を保って終わる。

[SOUND]
BGM：ミニマルなエレクトロ・ハウス、約120 BPM。0秒からキックが入り、後半の短いカットで勢いを増し、最後のカットで一拍止めて余韻を残して終わる。
効果音：文字が現れる瞬間に短いヒット音、撮影のカットでカメラのシャッター音、振り返りと裾の揺れに布の音。

[NEGATIVE]
ロゴ、透かし。綴りの崩れた文字、指定以外の文字。人物の顔の変形、別人への入れ替わり。服の形や丈の変化（パンツがスカートになるなど）。

author: Iancu_ai
title: Anime Evening Seven Shot Star Direction
prompt:
STYLE FIRST: a real Japanese TV anime, like a scene from a seasonal anime opening. Hand-drawn character animation on twos and threes, hand-inked lines that change weight, flat cel color with one hard-edged shadow tone, painted anime background art with soft brush texture. Anime compositing only: gentle backlight bloom, light leaks at sunset, depth-of-field blur on painted layers, rain drawn as thin streaks. No 3D, no CG, no glossy skin or hair, no AI polish. This applies to every shot.

CHARACTER: use @[image1] as the character design sheet and match its hand-drawn look. Keep her face, violet eyes, very long straight pink hair with blunt bangs, white cropped high-neck top with black collar, oversized off-shoulder white techwear jacket with orange panels, black harness belt with white hip pouch, orange baggy cargo pants, one orange fingerless glove, white and orange sneakers. Her face stays on-model in every shot.

MAIN GOAL: a 30-second calm slice-of-life showcase, no fighting. One evening in a Japanese city from golden hour to the first star. 7 shots, each about 4 seconds, each a different classic anime shot type with one slow camera move. Hard cuts. Let every shot breathe, no rushing. Her hair and jacket always move in the wind.

(0–4.5s) SHOT 1, extreme wide: a city rooftop at golden hour, she sits on the railing edge, skyline and long orange sky behind her, wind lifting her hair. Slow push-in from far away.
(4.5–8.5s) SHOT 2, extreme close-up of her violet eyes, the sunset reflected in them, a strand of pink hair crossing her face. Rack focus from the hair strand to her eyes, then she blinks once.
(8.5–13s) SHOT 3, inside a commuter train: she stands by the window holding a strap, orange sunlight strobing across her face through passing poles. The camera tracks sideways with the train.
(13–17s) SHOT 4, insert close-up: her gloved hand on the train window as the first raindrops hit the glass, city lights blurring behind. Slow push-in on the hand.
(17–21.5s) SHOT 5, medium wide at a rainy bus stop at dusk: she is large in frame under the shelter beside a glowing vending machine, rain falling past the streetlight. She shakes rain off her sleeve and looks down the street. Slow pan toward her.
(21.5–25.5s) SHOT 6, low side angle from the ground: her reflection in a puddle, her sneaker steps in and sends ripples. The camera tilts up from the side and stops on her face.
(25.5–30s) SHOT 7, the rain stops. Side profile: she slowly tilts her head back and looks up, her chin lifting, as the clouds part and the first star appears in a deep blue sky. Slow crane up from her face to the sky and hold on the single star until the end.

Sound: city ambience only, wind, train, rain, the rain fading to quiet in the last shot. No music, no voice, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no other characters.

author: AnkitKumar65837
title: Arctic Pink Pebble Six Shot Dialogue
prompt:
Cinematic, hyper-realistic 15-second film, 16:9, 24fps, shot on ARRI Alexa with 35mm and 85mm anamorphic lenses, natural film grain, shallow depth of field, smooth professional camera work.

CHARACTER (keep identical to reference, do not change the face): young woman, early 20s, fair skin with natural freckles across nose and cheeks, soft grey-green eyes, auburn copper-red hair in a loose low ponytail with wavy strands framing her face, forest-green cable-knit crew-neck sweater, dark charcoal straight-leg jeans, brown leather belt with brass buckle, tall knee-high brown leather riding boots. Same face, same facial structure, same freckles, same hairstyle and same outfit in every shot. Natural skin texture, no makeup look.

ENVIRONMENT (match scene reference): a magical arctic shoreline covered in smooth polished pink, rose, cream and white pebbles, a small clear tide pool in the pebbles, crystal turquoise water with gentle foaming waves, a huge blue-white glacier wall across the bay, snow-covered jagged mountains, dark rock spires draped in golden kelp, small floating icebergs. Soft champagne-gold sunlight, warm golden-hour glow mixed with cool glacier blue, high clouds glowing champagne color, a beautiful blend of pink, turquoise, gold and white, sparkling light on water and wet stones, light sea breeze moving her hair. Vibrant, colorful, dreamy but fully photorealistic.

SHOT 1 (0–4s) — Wide establishing shot, [Tracking shot, slow push in]: she walks in from the left side of frame onto the pink pebble beach with relaxed, natural steps, pebbles shifting and clicking under her boots, hair gently moving in the breeze. She slows down and stops, slowly turns her head from the mountains to the glacier, eyes wide with wonder, lips parting into a soft amazed smile.

SHOT 2 (4–5.5s) — Cut to medium close-up from the front, [Static]: golden light on her freckled face, she exhales in amazement and says clearly with natural lip sync: "Wow, it's very beautiful."

SHOT 3 (5.5–8s) — Cut to medium shot, side angle, [Slight tilt down]: she walks two steps to the edge of the tide pool, bends her knees and crouches down naturally, balancing on her boots. She reaches out and gently touches a glossy wet pink stone with her fingertips, then carefully picks it up and looks at it with curiosity.

SHOT 4 (8–10s) — Cut to extreme close-up, [Slow push in]: the smooth wet pink stone resting in her freckled fingers, tiny water droplets sliding off, marble-like rose and cream veins, champagne sunlight glinting on its polished surface. Her thumb slowly rubs across the stone. Background softly blurred into turquoise and gold bokeh.

SHOT 5 (10–12.5s) — Cut to medium-wide shot from behind at a three-quarter angle, [Tracking shot]: she stands up holding the stone, walks toward the sea and steps slowly into the shallow crystal-clear water up to her ankles, small ripples and gentle splashes around her boots, ponytail swaying, glacier glowing ahead, sunlight sparkling across the water.

SHOT 6 (12.5–15s) — Cut to medium close-up from the front, [Slow pull out]: standing in the shimmering water with the glacier and snowy mountains behind her, holding the pink stone close to her chest, she looks up at the view with a joyful, emotional smile and says with natural lip sync: "Wow, I really love this place." The camera keeps pulling back to show her small in the vast colorful landscape.

Realistic human movement, natural weight shifts, correct balance when crouching and standing, realistic hand and finger anatomy, realistic water physics, smooth cinematic cuts, consistent lighting and the same character in every shot.
